tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'dir mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso nyer bsdus bzhugs so/ /oṃ swā sti/bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal
༄༅/ /'dir mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso nyer bsdus bzhugs so/ /oṃ swā sti/bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dir mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso nyer bsdus bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag thung tsam 'di ni/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug la sogs pa yang nges par snang bar mdzad do/ / hūṃ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ /'phrin las drag po'i gdug pa tshar spyod cing*/ /ha hā rgod pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ /zhing skyong chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /myur mgyogs sde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad tsa na/ /te se'i gangs ri gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gdong bzhi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed tsa na/ /po ta lha yi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i gtso bo mdzad tsa na/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas gshegs su gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs tsa na/ /dar lung gnyan gyi gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa skyong tsa na/ kha'u brag rdzong gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsa na/ /ri khrod jo nang gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyi ji ltar khas blang zhing*/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi las la spyan 'dren na//sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /hūṃ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /rta mchog rin chen rgyan gyi brgyan pa dang*/ /g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar stibs pa dang*/ /lug nag spyi dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba dang*/ khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar phyo ba dang*/ / mthing nag dar gyi cod pan mang pos brgyan/ /lha mchog mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ /zhing skyong gzigs ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*/ /bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /las mdzad gtum po ljang khu'i thugs dam bskang*/

/ser nag seng ga gling ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chags sos gyur cig /skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ hūṃ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang*/ /dri ldan me tog gsar snying nag po dang*/ /tshil chen mang pos spos kyi dud sprin dang*/ /zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba'i snang gsal dang*/ khrag zhag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dri mchog dang*/ /zhal zas bshos bu dmar nag ri rab tsam/ khrag zhag sha rus : stam [ gtams ] pa tshom bus bskong*/ /rkang gling rnyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing*/ /lha mchog mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*/ / zhes pa nas/ skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol du gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar gong dang 'dra/ lha mchog mahā ka la mthu bo che/ khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dang*/ /'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho dang*/ /dza gad phud kyi btung ba sna tshogs dang*/ / bza' dang btung ba ri dang rgya mtsho tsam/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho 'di/ /lha mchog mahā ka las thugs dam bskang*/ /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ /zhing skyong gzigs ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*/ /bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu'i thugs dam bskang*/ /ser nag seng ga gling ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyi thugs dam

bskang*/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chags sos gyur cig /skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gdong bzhi dregs pa 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /zhi rgyas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / zhes pa 'di ni tā ra nā thas nye gnas dar ma seng ge la gdams pa'o/ /bkra shis// ༄༅/ /zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gi gtor ma chen po sgrub 'phen gyi lag len cho ga las bzhi lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra dh+ri ka ār+ya tā rā ye/ 'dir dpal ldan nag po ha ha sgrog pa'i zhing skyong chen po zhal bzhi pa'i gtor chog las rim gyi man ngag mdo tsam bshad par bya'o/ /de yang gnas dang dus 'dzom pa na/ dang por/ sgrub pa po dam ldan yi dam gyi bsnyen pa 'thems por song ba zhig nges par dgos la/ de yang gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor lta bu'am/ dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje khro bo'i rigs gang gis kyang rung zhing*/ khyad par du 'di la rgyud 'jam zhing 'khul che ba'i gnad yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i rigs kyi bsnyen pa tshar gcig song na gnad du che bar bzhed/ de yang brgyud pa gcig pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ gnyan sgrol nyid bsngags par grags la/ gzhan ku ru kul+le la sogs pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de ltar yi dam gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ dpal mgon po 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa yang*/ /lan gsum skyar ba lta bu byung na rab/ tshar gcig song ba zhig med du mi rung ste/ 'on kyang bod 'dir phyis dang da lta'i lag len ltar chog grwa ngom pa gtso bor byed na/ tshogs kyi gtso bo de dpal mgon 'di'i bsnyen pa'ang song ba med du mi rung la/ gzhan rnams ni yi dam gang rung re'i bsnyen pa song na/

'di'i chog grwa la 'jug rung tsam yin no/ /chos skyong 'di la gong gnon gyi mgon po gzhan dgos sam mi dgos snyam na/ spyir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin te/ yi dam khro bos gcun zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das mas gnad nas bskul bas chog pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang bod yul 'di na/ sgrub pa po gcig gis chos skyong rigs mi gcig pa du ma bsten pa'i srol yod pas/ de'i dbang gis man ngag gi yi ge rnams na/ gong gnon re mdzad par gda' ba/ bla chen sa skya ba man chad nges par gur mgon gyis mdzad pas legs par byung la/ spyir de ltar byed par 'dod na/ de kho nar ma zad dpal mgon po bzhi sbrag gam/ sgang ston lugs kyi gri gug can nam/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi drug sogs/ mgon chen gang la brten kyang rung ngo*/ /de lta na yang*/ spyir mgon po 'di kho na sgrub pa gcig yod dgos la 'di rang gi sgrub thabs dngos rnams kyang de lta bu'i dbang du byas pa yin dgos pas de gtso bor 'chad do/ / de la gtor sgrub gtor skyong tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ yi dam legs par bsnyen na chos skyong gi sgos bsnyen ma song kyang mi rung ba ma yin la/ gtor chen 'phen pa la ni 'di rang gi sgos bsnyen ma song na/ rang gzhan thams cad phan pa ma yin pa skyed par byed do/ / da ni ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa bshad par bya ste/ gnas der bla bre yol ba sogs mdzes byed ci rigs par bya/ stegs bu mtho ba la bla ma'i gtor ma dang yi dam spyi dang*/ chos skyong dngos dang mkha' 'gro spyi dang*/ gzhi bdag gi bar gyi gtor ma lnga tshar rnams bshams/ yang na yi dam la gcig /rigs drug gi gtor ma ste lnga'o/ /sgrol ma sogs yi dam sgos kyi gtor ma dang bskang gtor dkyus ma nor gzugs bshos phran zur gsum bzhi thod gzugs bzhi dang ldan pa bshams/ 'grub na rten rdo'i steng du chos 'byung gru gsum dbus nag la/

mu ran dmar ba/ de la dbus dang phyogs bzhir nyi gdan la/ 'bru nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'am/ yang tshom bu bcu bdun 'god pa ltar na/ chos 'byung 'bri mi dgos/ de'i steng du dar nag gi gur phub pa'o/ /rten rdo med kyang*/ gtor chog 'di dag la dgos nges ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang ltar na'ang*/ yi dam gtor ma'i mdun gyi phyogs sa gzhi stabs bde ba zhig tu/ stegs bu gru bzhi dngos su yod pa'am/ med na rdul tshon sogs kyis dmar po'am/ nag po gru bzhi pa bri/ der pad+ma 'dab brgyad chen po lte ba nag / 'dab ma sngo/ mu khyud ljang khur bya/ lte ba'i steng du mañji sogs stegs mtho ba la/ lcags snod yangs par/ sran nag gi chan dang*/ me tog nag po rnying pa dang*/ mi rus kyi phye ma btab pa'i sgrub gtor snying gzugs ma phyogs bzhir bshos phran zur gsum can mtshams rnams su mtheb kyu nyer bdun re brtsegs pas mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /de la sha khrag sogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ zas phud sna tshogs kyis bskor ro/ /pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du/ stegs bu cung zad dma' ba re bzhag ste/ mdun ma la rak+ta'i snod/ gzhan bdun la bshos bu gru gsum re re bshams/ de thams cad la ling rkyang re 'dzugs/ mtha'i stegs du rnams dbus kyi stegs bu'i phyed dang gtor phran rnams dbus kyi gtor ma'i phyed du sleb pa byed gsung na de las mtho ba mi rung ba'i don yin/ gzhan tshad nges pa med/ de dag gi mtha' drag po'i mchod gtor spyi dang mthun pas bskor ba las/ zhal zas bshos bu dmar nag gru gsum lnga tshom mam lnga sgrengs byas kyang rung dbus ma mtho tsam byed/ phyi rten rta lug g.yag khyi sogs nang rten zhwa nag gos nag phyag mtshan gsang mtshan gri snying 'khor lo can sogs/ dngos su yod na legs/ med na gzugs yas sam sogs thung tsam gyis kyang rung bar 'dod/ sgrub khang gi steng du rnga thug re yang 'dzugs/

de yang lnga tshom byed pa'i srol yod spyan 'dren pa'i brda yin zer/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs sna tshogs/ /g.yab dar/ rdo dril/ ḍā ru thod pa rol mo sna tshogs 'grub na tshogs kyi yo byad rnams kyang bsham mo/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed yi dam gtor bsngo yan chad nges par sngon du 'gro bar bya/ de nas gong gnon byed na/ de'i gtor chog tsam mam/ bskang ba rnams kyang bya/ mi byed na der zad/ dkyus kyi yi dam la med/ cho ga'i yan lag rang ma yin kyang bar 'dir gnyan sgrol gyi gtor bsngo bzlas pa dang bcas pa re byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nas dpal mgon po nyid kyi cho ga la 'jug ste/ gtor ma thams cad la thun mong du yi dam gyi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'byung bzhi las kyi gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rdo rje brag ri dmar nag 'jigs shing lhun chags pa'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya dang tshad chad pa med pa/ mi ro'i gdan dang*/ zhing gi 'phan gdugs/ skra'i rnga yab/ mi mgo'i phreng ba/ tsit+ta'i phon tho/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi sogs 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyi nang thams cad du zhing chen gsar rnying*/ aṃ sa'i lhu dum/ keng rus chal chol/ rak+ta'i lteng ka bya dang*/ gcan gzan mi bsrun pa'i tshogs dang*/ gdug pa'i sbrul nag sogs srog chags ma rungs pas gang ba/ sha za/ srin po/ ma mo/ mkha' 'gro bdud dang*/ gshin rje ro langs kyi tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing gar byed pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ros khyab pa/ phyi rol dur khrod chen pos kho ra khor yug tu bskor ba/ de'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag chen po'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i phyogs bzhir yang*/ e khraṃ gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi ste/

thams cad kyang 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa'o/ /dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ yig mthing nag las rdo rje gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ nag po chen po zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhis/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba nyi ma stong dus gcig tu shar ba dang mtshungs pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ches cher khros pas/ bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mi ro cham chom du gsol ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po rgya cher bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa/ /steng zhal dud nag ya sos ma mchu mnan pas mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ zhal nas ha ha dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ dang*/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ gi sgra drag po bsgrags pas/ srid gsum 'dar bar mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gis log par lta ba thams cad kyi mgo lus gcod pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la gnod byed kyi khrag gis gang zhing*/ dam nyams kyi snying dang bcas pa thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'phyar bas bdud sde ma lus pa 'joms par mdzad cing*/ la lar dgra la la lar mdung thung bsnun pa/ g.yon 'og mas mdung rtse gsum pa dang*/ rus 'phreng 'gag thabs su 'phyar ba/ mchan khung du gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i stabs kyi gyad kyi 'dor stabs chen pos dgra bgegs thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo bam chen bsnol ba'i lus la nyed pa/ zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags bskyod pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mchu 'phyang zhing*/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/

stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs dang mi mgo skam po dbu rgyan/ rlon pa'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya/ tshangs pa'i skud pa gdug pa'i sbrul chen po/ dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dai ltar gtso bo bzhengs pa na lus dang grib ma'i tshul du/ e khraṃ gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi la/ las byed rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang srog gcod bshan pa lnga sogs kyang grub par gyur pa ni/ g.yas su yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu/ mdun du dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ rgyab tu ser nag sing ga gling ma rnams khro zhing gtum pa lang tsho la bab pa/ gcer bu rgyan med pa/ rab tu gril zhing*/ drag shul chen mo/ pho nya mo'i cha lugs can/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dbu skra khams ser lhug par grol ba mun ltar gtibs pa/ khams gsum gyi srog la mnga' mdzad pa'o/ /gzhan yang bshan pa nag po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ bshan pa ser po zhags pa 'phen pa/ bshan pa dmar po lcags sgrog skor ba/ bshan pa ljang khu ral gri 'debs pa/ bshan pa sngon po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ thams cad kyang srin po'i lus la mon bu lings pa chen po'i cha lugs can/ dgra bgegs kyi bla tshe skad cig la 'gugs shing gsod pa'i shwa na khrid pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi phyi rol du bdun gcod kyi bshan pa nyer gcig

/srid pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le srin mo ral pa gcig ma/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag nyi khri chig stong*/ dmag dpon chen po gshin rje khro tshogs sogs pa dregs pa lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs sa gzhi bar snang mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba 'khod par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ sogs dkyus dang 'dra/ sbyar spos sreg cing*/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ hūṃ £© lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ / nas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /lha mchog mahā kā la gshegs su gsol/ lha chen nag po= zhing skyong gzi ldan= bram ze'i gzugs can= yum chen= las mdzad= dmar nag= ser nag= 'khor gyi= dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon bdag la dgongs/ /rnal 'byor nyams chags bskang phyir gshegs su gsol/ / yang na/ bstan dgra gnod byed 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ / zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang bab dang sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /nye snying gi mthar/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ sdom ni/ mchod bstod gtor bsngo mchod bstod dang*/ /bshags bstod gtor bshags lan bdun dang*/ /slar yang bskangs shing mchod bstod do/ /de yang mchod bstod/ gtor bsngo/ slar yang mchod bstod/ bshags bstod/ yang gtor bsngo sngon du 'gro ba'i bshagasas pa lan bdun/ slar yang bskang ba mchod bstod rgyas pa ste/ don tshan drug go /dang po ni/ bskang rdzas ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ gtor skyong skabs 'di'i mchod phreng 'di la rnga tshigs byed de/ 'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs rnams/ /bsgral ba'i khrag gi ar+ghaṃ 'di/ /zhal bzhi gnyan po'i spyan sngar 'bul/ / de rjes khrag gi ar+ghaṃ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ dbang lnga me tog 'di/ spyan sngar 'bul gyi dod du dbu la 'bul/ de bzhin du/ tshil chen bdug spos/ shangs la/ zhun chen mar me che/ spyan la/ 'khris pa'i dri chab/ thugs kar/

sha rus zhal zas/ zhal du/ rkang gling rol mo/ snyan la/ zhes brjod/ rol chen gyi sgra la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi sngags brjod/ lnga lnga lnga yi dam rdzas 'di/ /ye shes bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /'dod yon rnam lnga rdzogs par sprul/ /stobs 'phrog nag po'i zhal du 'bul/ /mchod sprin ri la maṃ sa'i thang*// phyogs bcur rba klung g.yo ba yi/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho bcud kyi mchog /stobs 'phrog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /nyams chags bskang phyir bzhes su gsol/ / rol mo'i skabs/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags/ sku gsum mngon gyur rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /rnam gsum bstan pa spel zhing bsrung ba'i phyir/ /dug gsum bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /'phrul gsum mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khams gsum me lce dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus/ /stong gsum zil gnon zhing skyong rgyal po'i sku/ /sa gsum 'dar byed khro gtum rngam brjid che/ / srid gsum dbang gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo bla ma dang*/ /sgo gsum rdo rjes bsrungs pa bdag cag la/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdang bas rab 'khrugs pa'i/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren rnam gsum tshar gcod mdzod/ / ces so/ / oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta sa ma ya sma ra sa ma ya/ ma ti kra ma ye/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa pho nya bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi bka' dang dam las ma mda' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod khyad par du bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/

bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang*/ /dbye ba dang*/ sdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzod du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten du bde legs rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ 'di'i sngags kyi skabs rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ston te dam la 'jog go /gnyis pa ni/ de nas dbus kyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dgra bgegs ma lus pa bsgral ba las byung ba'i maṃ sa'i sa gzhi/ rus pa'i ri bo/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ye shes rnam pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥs kha gso'o/ /'di thob thang gtor chen gyi yin yang*/ gtor skyong la yang byed do/ /de nas sngags ring tshar gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo yab yum rnams la phul/ gtor ma gzhan rnams a kā ro 'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dregs pa pho mo mtha' dag la bsngo/ gsum pa ni/ hūṃ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang*/ khyad par byang shar 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /bsil ba'i tshal sogs thams cad nas/ /chos skyong mgon po zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan 'dren gnas su da tshur byon/ khyad par do nub gnas 'dir byon/ /'phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams 'dzugs/ /mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*/ /rol mo bla bre 'phan dang gdugs/ /shes rab ma da na yi chang*/ /thabs mchog maṃ sa bā liṃ sha /dam rdzas rgyan gyi tshogs phud 'di/ / dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs khang na/

/sa nag steng na thod nag snod/ /mi nag sha la khrag phyung ba/ /bsur nag dri la dar nag phod/ dkar gsum dngar gsum rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar ldan pa'i/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /gnyis med bdud rtsir byin rlabs nas/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /stsol zhig dgongs shig dges mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bar chad bdud dang 'gal rkyen spongs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ / zhes rol chen dang bcas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brjod/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las sprul pa'i sku/ /thugs rjes drag tu khros pa rngam pa'i sku/ /sdig can tshogs rnams thal bar mdzad pa'i sku/ /ye shes gzi 'od phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i sku/ /nag po chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/ khyed sku lhun po'i dpal ltar rab tu brjid/ khyod gsung 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i hūṃ sgra sgrog khyod thugs rgya mtsho nam mkha' lta bur yangs/ khyod kyi yon tan bsam 'phel rin po che/ /'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yum chen bzhi dang las kyi bshan pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor bcas rnams la'ang bstod pa 'bul/ / bzhi pa ni/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /rtsa ltung dang pos gos pa rnams/ /mthol lo bshags so dag par mdzod/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /rtsa ltung gnyis pas gos pa rnams/ /mthol lo bshags so dag par mdzod/ / ces pa nas/ shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /bcu bzhi pa yis gos pa rnams/ /mthol lo bshags so dag par mdzod/ /mthu chen sdang ba dgra yi dgra/ /phas rgol mu stegs bdud kyi bdud/

/zhal bzhi mnga' ba lha yi lha/ khyed la bdag gis bstod pas bstod/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon dam la mnos/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon mchod pa bzhes/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon 'phrin las mdzod/ /'dir gshegs 'dir byon bzod par bzhes/ / bdag cag dam ldan slob mar bcas/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ / nag po chen po khyod kyis srungs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/ / de ltar bshags pa dang bstod pa sbrel ba de tshar gsum bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gtor ma rnams kha gsos byin rlabs gong ltar byas te/ 'bul tshul yang snga ma dang 'dra/ slar yang bskang ba'i dkyus na yod pa bzhin/ £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡·+ hūṃ £© rtsa rgyu da bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ / zhes pa nas/ dag tshangs chen po mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod nas yig brgya tshar gsum bzla/ de ltar na gtor ma kha gso/ byin rlabs/ gtor 'bul bshags pa yig brgya rnams khrigs chags su byas pa de lan bdun bya'o/ /drug pa slar yang bskang ba mchod bstod ni/ bskang rdzas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs pa nas gzung*/ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las mdzod cig / ces pa'i bar bskang ba rgyas pa nyid bya la/ yang gong du bskang ba byas zin na/ stobs chen shugs drag nas/ rnal 'byor skyong phyir bsnams su gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar du/ phyag mtshan dang rten phul/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ nang mchod phul/ bar 'dir slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad zer ba'i bstod pa de mdzad par snang ngo*/ / rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgos pa'i/ / sogs dang*/ rgyal ba kun sogs kyis kyang bstod de/ de nas bar 'dir gtor bsngo gzhan dgos pa rnams dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs btang ngo*/ /des gtor ma sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga bstan zin to// gal te nyams chags shin tu shas che na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bum sgrub bam/

grib sel gyi bum sgrub gang yang rung ba zhig byas la/ rang gi snying gar snying rin po che pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha gyen bstan/ glo ba rin po che pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha thur bstan/ kha sbyor bar mtshams med pa'i nang du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa he ru ka'i rnam pa can du bzhugs/ he ru ka 'i yi ge brgya pa gang mang bzlas zhing*/ mthar/ mahā' kā la tsa tur mu kha sa ma ya ma nu sogs mgon po'i yi ge brgya pa yang*/ nyi shu rtsa re sogs ji ltar 'os pa bzlas nas/ bum pa la dmigs te/ oṃ bi shud+dhe swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ swā hā/ zhes kyang mang du bzlas te/ gtor snod rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du chos skyong 'khor bcas bskyed nas/ khrus chu gtor ma la ldugs shing*/ khrus gsol gyi 'don pa spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /'di jo bo rjes mgon po seng zhon gyi man ngag blangs pa yin no/ /de nas gtang rag dga' ston dpa' bo'i ston mo byas la mthar/ dbang dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ zhi ba spyi la bsdu na khang steng du/ spyi stabs tsam gyis phul kyang chog la/ spro na khang steng du cho ga da ltar 'chad 'gyur ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /yang lar nas zhi ba sogs yin kyang*/ dmigs gsal bzlog pa lta bu la gtor ma rnams go mtshon rol mo dang bcas pas khyer te/ gnod byed kyi phyogs sam bzhi mdo sogs su me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i steng du stegs bu la bzhag /chu chang nang mchod kyis bran/ spyan 'dren tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa bya/ gdan 'bul dam bzhag /sngags ring gisagator ma bsngo/ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig nas/ gdong bzhi te se'i zhing skyong mdzad la bstod/ /mdog nag me'i dbus nas phyag bzhi pa/ /gri thod ral gri mi rus phreng ba 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi dang dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /g.yog dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/

/ zhes sogs bya/ 'di stabs gtor dgra phyogs su gtong ba tsam ka yin pas/ sgo dbyer 'phrang sol gser skyems zor lam dbye ba sogs gal mi che la/ ci ste spros pa la mos na/ gser skyems dang*/ lam sel cung zad byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /thog mar spyi stabs bya ste/ hūṃ lha chen thugs kyi sprul pa drag shul can/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur zhing skyong 'jigs pa'i sku/ khams gsum srog gi mnga' bdag yum chen bzhi/ / gsod byed dregs pa pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyis gtor ma 'di bzhes shig / ces sogs spyi dang mthun par sbyar nas rol chen yun ring du bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma dgra phyogs su gtong na/ rol mo drag tu bskul zhing*/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bkas bskul zhing*/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus/ /chos skyong srung ma'i dmag dpung 'gyed/ /bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ de ni dgra la bh+yoḥ chos chos de ni dgra la chos/ / 'gres/ nus mthu rmad byung srung ma'i gtso/ /gdong bzhi mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /ru mtshon dgra bo'i yul du 'gyed/ /bh+yo= chos= zhal bzhi'i klong nas me 'bar zhing*/ /phyag bzhis 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha bsdigs/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs bskyod bzhin du/ /bh+yo= chos= yum chen bzhi'i dpung bsdus nas/ /nag mo 'bar ma ma mo'i tshogs/ /nad yams dal yams bdag mo rnams/ /bh+yo= chos= ma ru rtse'i dur khrod nas/ /bshan pa'i rgyal po zangs khrab can/ /ru mtshon glo snying thogs nas kyang*/ /bh+yo= chos = zangs gri klad la bskor zhing 'gying*/ /rgyu zhags 'dom dgu 'phen zhing rgyug /pho bdud bshan pa nag po bdun/ /bh+yo= chos= zangs kyi khyi mo khrag kha ma/ /lan bu can gyi ma mo bdun/ /dgra bo'i bla srog len pa'i phyir/ /bh+yo= chos= dmar nag khrag gi ral pa can/ /gri phub skor zhing bskyod 'gros kyis/

/dgra bo'i bdun brgyud gcod byed pa/ /bh+yo= chos= pho bdun mo bdun sprul pa bdun/ /las byed bshan pa nyer gcig tshogs/ / dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /bh+yo= chos= gzhan yang mgon po'i bka' nyan pa/ /dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga'i tshogs/ /rang 'khor dmag dpung ldan pa yang*/ /bh+yo= chos= steng nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung ni/ /lha dmag 'bum sde brgya byin bcas/ /sa srungs zhon pa'i mthu bo che/ /bh+yo= /chos= bar nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung ni/ /bdud dmag 'bum sde khyab 'jug bcas/ /mkha' lding zhon pa'i mthu bo che/ /bh+yo= chos= 'og nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung ni/ /klu gnyan 'bum sde lto 'phyer bcas/ /sprul nag zhon pa'i mthu bo che/ /bh+yo= chos= bar snang khams la dbang bsgyur ba/ /sde brgyad dbang bsgyur rā hu la/ /mahā de ba drag shul can/ /bh+yo= chos= 'di ltar khyed la bskul ba yang*/ /shākya'i bstan la gnod byed pa'i/ bdud sde'i bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams/ /'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /las ngan gzhan 'phrul dbang byed mthus/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa'i blos/ /nyin mtshan bdud kyi 'khol ba mthong*/ /'di yang = bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ /smod cing bshud pa'i sdig lta mkhan/ /las ngan 'byung pos mnar ba yang*/ /'di yang = sku gsung thugs kyi 'gal rkyen la/

/spang bya mi mthun phyogs rnams dang*/ /byad kha rbod gtong ma lus pa/ /'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa yis/ /byad kha phur kha gnod pa'i tshogs/ /'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /rmi ltas rtsub cing mtshan ma ngan/ /mo ngan phyogs ngan lo skeg dang*/ /rgyu skar ngan pa'i sbyor ba rnams/ /'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /mon mo bse'i rna cha can/ / lag na thun dang dug phye thogs/ /de ni ma mo'i rbod gtong ste/ /'di yang = ha la nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rgyu rlon ga sha lus la thogs/ /de ni gshin rje'i rbod gtong ste/ /'di yang = nam mkha' glog dang ser phran 'khrigs/ /ri bo'i rtse nas thogs 'bab pa/ de ni phur pa'i rbod gtong ste/ /'di yang = stong gsum mig gis gang ba'i gzugs/ /'ur 'ur sgra sgrog mkha' la bskyod/ /de ni gza' mchog rbod gtong ste/'di yang = gtsug lag 'jig cing glegs bam 'khur/ /sku gzugs g.yo zhing mchi ma 'dzag /de ni mu stegs rbod gtong ste/ / 'di yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /mthu stobs dbang phyug lha yi lha/ khyod kyis mi bzlog gang yang med/ /byad kha rbod gtong gnod pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ / sngon las 'phran rkyen gyur pa yi/ /nad gdon mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ / bzlog sgyur 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ / ces pa'i mthar rtsa sngags dkyus ma dang*/ / bsad sngags ring thung gang rung dang bcas/ gtor ma de nyid de kar dgra phyogs su rtse bstan nas 'jog pa'am/ yang na gtor stegs su bzhag go /yang denyid nas zor du 'phang pa'i lugs kyang yod/ yang gtor ma'i snying po rtse mo dgra phyogs su bstan/ gzhan rnams 'phen pa'i lugs kyang 'dug /gtor ma dgra phyogs su mi gtong ba'i phyogs la/ drag bskul ni mi dgos/ spyi stabs kyi mthar gtor ma'i snying po ma sgyel bar 'theb kyu sogs thur la nyil du 'jug pa'i srol yod do/

/de nas/ srid zhi'i dpal yon sogs dge legs kyi tshig brjod/ nang du yong*/ mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs/ 'jig rten khams kyi sogs gong bzhin las/ 'phrin las sgrub phyir bzhes su gsol/ zhes 'don pa spos nas mchod pa 'bul/ hūṃ yon tan myur rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung phan pa'i dgongs pa can// 'phrin las rnam bzhis bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /legs ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mi rtog dbyings las thugs rjes skur bzhengs shig /'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings nas gzhengs/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'chang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod te se'i zhing skyong mdzad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ rten la brtan bzhugs/ mgron gshegs gsol rnams bya'o/ /dam tshig pa rang la stim/ smon lam dang*/ bkra shis rnams kyang bya'o/ /'di nyid dkyus kyi gtor skyong nyams len 'jam po'i lugs gtso bor gyur pa yin pas/ yang yang sgrub na legs shing*/ de yang*/ nyin zhag mang por sbrel te/ sgrubs na bzang bas zhag snga ma rnams la dngos gzhi'i sa bcad drug po rnams rdzogs par bya/ khrus gsol nyin re bzhin byed mi byed skabs dang sbyar/ thun gyi mthar/ rjes chog ni/ mchod bstod/ gsol btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs rnams bya/ 'di dag tu gtong mgron gshegs gsol mi dgos/ smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa'o/

/de dag ni gtor sgrub bam gtor skyong lag tu blangs ba'i rim pa mdo tsam du bshad zin to// // bkra shis// ༈ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ni gtor chen du grags pa/ /drag gtor 'phen bar 'dod na/ /rten rdo phyag mtshan dang bcas pa bshams dgos par 'dod kyang 'grub na ni bzang*/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa med/ sa gzhi la gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dgra bgegs kyi ling ga bris pa zhig rdul tshon chu tshon gang rung gis 'bri/ nyin rgyugs kyi gtor ma lta bu yod med pa dang*/ gnas kyi khyad par las 'bri stabs ma bde na/ ras bris kyis kyang rung*/ de yang med na zhing lpags bting na mchog tu 'gyur/ stag sogs gcan gzan gtum po'i pags pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de'i steng du stegs bu mtho ba/ lcags snod chen por 'bru sna lnga'i phye las/ gtor ma chen po bca' ste/ rgyu bre lnga las chung bas mi rung zer/ dbyibs thog lde lta bu dug khrag ro sol la sogs pas dmar nag tu byugs/ /yum bzhi'i bshos bu byed pa'ang yod/ mtha' 'theb kyu'i ra bas bskor/ de la rtsang dang thod dbyug dang yungs dkar dang rgyu rlon gyi lda ldis brgyan/ drag po'i rdzas kyi zas sna 'bru sna sna tshogs kyis blug /zan ling dkyus ma'am/ sngags can nam/ 'khor lo can sogs gang yin kyang rung*/ mgo gzhug bzlog la gtsugs/ de yang gcig nges par dgos/ ngos gsum la re re byas kyang legs/ khor yug tu rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig dug khrag gis byugs pa yin/ mdun du drag po'i mchod pa thams cad sgrengs tshar du bshams/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du 'brub khung rtsigs pa'am bris pa gang rung spyi dang mthun par bya/ rtsigs pa yin na kha la rtsang 'dzugs/ der bag zan la bcos pa'i dgra bgegs kyi ling ga bzhag dmigs gsal yod na :nang £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· rkang £© rjes kyi sa bsre/ skam thun rlon thun bshams lugs spyi dang mthun/

rlon thun la dug ru byung na legs te nges pa med/ gtor chen gyi rgyab phyogs ji ltar 'os par/ snod lngar mtheb kyu dang sha dang*/ mkhur ba dang*/ sran btsos dang*/ 'bru nag gi chan sogs/ zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba bzhag /gtor chen gyi mdun phyogs su/ ka pā la'am/ zhal bu khrag dang*/ chang gis gang ba bgod/ gzhan rten rdzas spyan gzigs sogs kyang rgyas par bkod par bya'o/ /de nas cho ga'i rim pa la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ yi dam gyi mchod gtor rnams sngon du btang nas/ mgon po'i mdun bskyed/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sngar bzhin byas la/ 'jig rten khams sogs kyi tshigs bcad la/ dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ oṃ mahā kā la tsa tu+u ra mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar so so'i mthar sbyar la sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pas 'bul/ shap+ta'i skabs kyi rol chen ma gtogs 'di la rnga tshigs mi byed/ de nas dam bzhag bya/ bar 'dir snying po nye snying sngags ring rnams ci rigs pa bzla zhing*/ khyad par du 'di nyid kyi bsad sngags che chung gang rung zhig /nyer gcig tsam bzla'o/ /de yang*/ oṃ u tsa ṭa tsa ṭe swāhā/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la bi kā ra tri ta dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍoṃ bi ni dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍa li dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rak+ṣa si dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sing ga li dwi bi dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa i yaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa ka ra la hi yaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa hu baṃ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gh+ri ta kī li kī la ya dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pi bhi sha na pa tā ya na maḥdagra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo che ge mo de bī ha na ha na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ma ra ma ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ le hi ba ling di hi sid+dhi/

dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o//bsad sngags ring ba ni/ oṃ u tsa ṭa tsa ṭe swāhā/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kaṭ+ṭa/ ka rā la/ zhes pa nas/ ud ta ra bu ra/ zhes pa'i bar sngags ring brjod nas/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍom+bi ni dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ de hi sidhi dgra bo ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /'dir bsad sngags ring thung zhes pa snying po la mgo 'dren dang sham bu btags pa dang*/ rtsa sngags la mgo 'dren dang sham bu ma btags pa'i khyad par yin la/ ring ba'i nang na snying po'ang yod mod kyi/ rtsa sngags kyi 'jug sdoms sham bur sbyar ba yin no/ /de las gnyis ka bzla bar 'dod na/ thung ba gtso bor bzla zhing*/ che ba zhar byung du bzla'o/ /gang ltar na'ang gtor chen gyi skabs 'dir bsad sngags gang rung zhig nges par bzla dgos so/ /de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ /dngos gzhi la dang po gtor ma sngo ba ni nye snying gi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun/ ḍom+bi ni sogs btags pa'i snying po la lan gsum/ oṃ sa yi yaṃ sa ka ra la hi yaṃ sa hu baṃ gh+ri ta kī li kī la ya/ bhi bhi sha na ba ta ye/ zhes pa la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum/ de rjes rtsa sngags ring mo lan gsum mam/ bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul ba ni khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ yang mchod bstod bsdus pa cig byas la/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ gong gtor skyong gi skabs su bshad pa bzhin/ rtsa ltung sogs kyi bshags pa tshar gcig bya/ gsum pa brten 'dzugs pa ni/ g.yag nag lug nag phyi yi brten sogs dang*/ phyag mtshan 'bul ba yin la/ bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad sogs mchod 'phreng yin/ lnga pa bskang ba ni/ lha mchog ma'i bskang ba rnams yin no/ /de nas/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad ces pa nas/

sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ / zhes pa'i bar mchod 'phreng song nas/ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ khyed la mthun pa'i zhes pa nas/ dag tshangs chen po mdzad du gsol gyi bar bskang bstod bshags pa rnams bya'o/ / des na mchod bskang rgyas phyin chad/ rtsis mgo gsum po de logs logs su khral te byed mi dgos/ de kho na la tshang ngo*/ /drug pa ling ga sgrol ba la/ dang por bskul ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsung dang ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid kyis/ /ji bzhin bsgo ba bsgrub pa dang*/ /dam tshig chen po'i dam mnos la/ /drag po'i 'phrin las 'di sgrubs shig /las sbyor 'di yis myur du sgrol/ /gsod cig srog rtsa myur du chod/ /thon cig snying rtsa myur du thon/ /chod cig mgo dang yan lag gtub/ /grod cig kha dang pags pa khrol/ /zo zhig sha khrag khā raṃ khā hi/ /ma 'gyangs myur du las 'di sgrubs/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po che/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing che/ / gtsug lag khang gi srung ma che/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dmag dpung che/ / dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma che/ /dug gsum nad kyi sman pa che/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha che/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu bo che/ /lus bong che zhing dam tshig che/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las 'di sgrubs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ /bstan la gnod pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs/ /srog dang myur du phrol las shog /rdo rje bla ma'i sku dgra dang*/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /gsod cig chod cig snying khrag 'thung*/ /rgyob cig chom cig chings la shog /thal ba rdul du rlog las shog /rul du chug la myags su chug /sdang ba dgra bo'i yul rnams su/ /nad dang 'khrug pa mtshon gyi char/ /rgyun mi 'chad par phob las shog /bcol lo bcol lo las bcol lo/ /bcol ba'i las la rel ma byed/ /rbad pa'i dus na rtsal ma zhan/ /bos pa'i dus na snyan ma sra/

/ rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' la nyon/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' 'di ni/ / dpal ldan khyod la ri bas lci/ /bdag gis bka' la ma nyan na/ /bdag ni rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /dam tshig gis ni rdo rje yis/ khyod kyi mgo bo 'gas par byed/ /de phyir dam bcas ma snyel bar/ /bcol ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ zhes rol mo drag tu bskul lo/ /bar du dgug 'dren ni/ 'brub khung gi dbus su ling ga bsham/ 'deb kha g.yas g.yon du bkod/ ling ga bskyed chog ma byas kyang rung*/ dgug gzhug bya ste/ gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor mar bshad pa nyid la 'dor len byas pas khyab bo/ /sngags ni snying po'i mthar ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes btags pas 'grub bo/ /de nas phud snod du chang phud 'theb kyu+u dang bcas pa blugs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang bcas la rol mo bya/ dkon mchog gsum po dgongs su gsol/ /mkha' 'gro srung ma dgongs su gsol// dam las 'das pa'i sdig can 'dis/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos/ /theg pa chen po sun yang phyung*/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten yang bcom/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshig /gsang sngags chos la skur ba btab/ /sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /dge ba'i bar chad brgyud mar byas/ /srung ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ /'di yi srung skyob ma mdzad par/ /rang gshed rang la dbab par mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas/ /'di yi srung skyob lha rnams dengs/ / zhes gtor te ling ga la gu gul sogs rdzas kyi dud pas bdug cing*/ sngags drag tu bzla'o/ /mthar bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ phyag mtshan bzhi rim pas spros te/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsam la/ gri gug thogs te/ stobs chen shugs drag gri gug rno/ /gdug pa sgrol phyir dgra la rgyob/ / gzhan 'dra ba las/ stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyag nas bskyed/ / ces 'don pa spo/

snying po'i mthar/ ha na ha na ban+dha ban+dha da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ling ga la gri gug 'debs tshul bya/ de bzhin du/ rtse gsum/ ral gri/ mdung thung rnams la'ang sbyar/ thun gnyis kyis grub/ bsad sngags 'don zhing rol mo'i sgra bya/ 'di la phur bus 'debs pa'i lag len mi mdzad pa shas che mod/ ling sgrol gyi mthar thug phur gdab yin pas byas na legs so/ /gang ltar yang de nas ling ga gtubs ling ro rnams gtor chen la bstab/ gtor sngags drag tu bzla/ mgon po spyi sngags yin pas shā sa na lan gsum tsam gyis kyang zhal du bstab/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /ye shes zhabs sogs brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa'i/ / zhal du bstab po sha khrag khā raṃ khā hi/ /mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab drag shul can/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bka' yi bya ra ba/ /'phrul ldan nag po zhing skyong stobs 'phrog gi /zhal du bstab po sha khrag khā raṃ khā hi/ /dgra bo'i mdangs dang gzi brjid zhal du bstab/ /'gal byed bla tshe bcud rnams zhal du bstab/ /

gnod byed stobs dang srog dbugs zhal du bstab/ /lus ngag 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma zhal du bstab/ /dpal ldan khyod kyi gzi brjid rgyas par gyur/ /sku'i stobs dang gsung gi nus pa dang*/ /'phrin las mthu rtsal thams cad rgyas par shog /rgyas shing dam las ma mda' las kun sgrubs/ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i zhal du bstab/ /las mdzad gtum mo khros pa'i zhal du bstab/ /za byed srin mo chen mo'i zhal du bstab/ /gsod byed sing ga gling ma'i zhal du bstab/ / sring gcig e ka tsa ti'i zhal du bstab/ /dbyings kyi ma mo'i tshogs kyi zhal du bstab/ /sgrol gying bshan pa lnga yi zhal du bstab/ /bdud gcod gying po rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /bdud 'dul dmag tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ / dmag dpon gshin rje khro che'i zhal du bstab/ /'khor gyi zhing skyong rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /dregs pa sde brgyad rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du bstab/ /zhal du bstab po gzi brjid rgyas par shog /dgyes shing dam las ma 'da' 'phrin las sgrubs/ / bdun pa las bcol gyi sngon 'gro'i bstod pa ni/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi drag po'i 'phrin las pa/ /rngam brjid khros pa char sprin lta bu'i mdog /srid gsum dregs ldan yongs kyi gtsor gyur pa/ /gtum po gzi ldan dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /gang thugs spros pa ma lus nyer zhi yang*/ /ma rungs gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i sku/ /zhal bzhi gdangs pas khams gsum za bar nus/ /rab 'jigs rno ngar mche ba gtsigs la bstod/ /glog 'phreng lta bur g.yo ba'i ljags 'gril zhing*// dbu skra smin ma me lce ltar 'bar ba/ /sdang mig g.yo ba'i spyan gsum bgrad pa las/ /dus mtha'i me 'od 'phro ba khyod la bstod/ /sbom thung rags pa'i phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis kyis/ /dam nyams rdul du rlog pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/

/ g.yon gnyis dang po thod pa khrag bkang dang*/ /'og ma rus 'phreng 'chang ba= las bzhi stsol ba'i bum pa mchan khung g.yon/ /byis pa'i gzugs can ma mchu 'phyang ba po/ /zhabs gnyis bskyod pas sa gsum 'gems par byed/stag lpags sham thabs bkra ba= sku la rus rgyan dril bu tshangs skud dang*/ /dug sprul shin tu 'jigs pas sku brgyan zhing*/ /'jigs rung thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ /thod rlon do shal 'phyang ba khyod= rab brjid zhal nas ha ha'i gad rgyangs dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ drag po'i nga ro can/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /rnam 'gyur du ma ldan pa khyod la = dpa' bo chen po denyid dgyes byed yum/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo seng gha li/ /nag ljang dmar ser 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /las bzhi'i dbang mdzad sring mo bzhi la bstod/ /gang gi bka' nyan mthu rtsal rmad byung bas/ /srog gcod las kyi bshan pa nyi shu gcig /bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs gsod la dpa'// rab gtum gzi byin ldan pa rnams la bstod/ /log 'dren yongs kyi srog 'phrog ma rungs gzugs/ /mtshon rnon du ma thogs shing rab khro ba/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dmag dpung gis/ /rnam 'phrul gar gyi rol ba rnams la bstod/ /yang 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa lha tshogs rnams/ /rang rang 'khor tshogs du mas yongs bskor zhing*/ /dam tshig can la bu bzhin skyong ba dang*/ / gnod byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod rnams la bstod/ /gzhan yang dkar po'i las la mngon dga' ba'i/ /dregs pa chen po sde brgyad lha tshogs rnams/ / gsod byed mtshon cha sna tshogs lag tu thogs/ /mi srun tshar gcod rnams la= ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas kyis/ /lha mchog rnams la mngon par mchod byed na/ /dngos grub ma lus ji bzhin stsal du gsol/ /gang yang bdag gi spyi dang khyad par gyi//

dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul la sogs pa'i/ /nyes pa ma lus snying nas bshags bgyid na/ /thugs brtse ldan pas bzod par bzhes su gsol/ / gnas skabs kun tu bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun rkyen gyi rnam pa ma lus pa/ /dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pas zhi mdzad cing*/ /mthun rkyen bsam don chos bzhin 'grub mdzad gsol/ khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan la gnod pa dang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la mtho 'tshams shing*/ /rnal 'byor bdag la gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams/ /rdul phran tsam yang med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / ces pa bstod gsol zhes pa'o/ /brgyad pa drag tu bskul ba ni/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba mnga' ris rtsad po dang mkhon pa'i tshe mdzad par grags pa'i bskul ba rgyas bsdus 'dra min gnyis yod pa las/ nyung ba 'di byed do/ /de yang*/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa srung ba po/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang stod pa po/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra 'dul ba po/ /dam tshig can gyi 'phrin las sgrub pa po/ /rang gi khas blangs dam bcas skyong ba po/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi srog shing dam pa po/ /dam tshig can gyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ lha chen nag po'i las byed pho nya ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje nag po mthu dang rtsal ma chung*/ /tshangs pa'i gtsug thag gnyan po gcod pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po= tshe srog bcad nas klad khrag dkrug pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po= khong khrag dmar po hub kyis 'debs pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po= bab gzhi bla rus dral nas za ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po= rkang lag mgo gsum so sor phral ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po= bstan pa'i spyi dgra rtsad nas gcod pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje nag po= dam nyams sdig can dgra la rbad pa'i tshe/ khrag mthung nag po mthu dang rtsal ma chung*/ /las mkhan yum bzhi dgra bo'i sha la zo/ /phyogs skyong bcu ni nam mkha'i sprin ltar stibs/

/rgyal chen bzhi yi ru mtshon pur ru ru/ /dpal mgon bdun bcu'i 'bod sgra dir ri ri/ khrag 'thung stong gi tshogs ni chems se chem/ /zhing skyong stong gi tshogs ni phungs se phung*/ /zhub chen stong gi tshogs ni shar ra ra/ /mkha' 'gro stong gi sgra skad ngar ra ra/ /dam can stong gi tshogs ni zangs se zang*/ /bka' srung stong gi tshogs ni k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ /bdud dang srin po'i dung 'bud rums se rum/ /stag spyang seng ge'i ngur sgra 'ur ru ru/ /bshang dang kang ka bya tshogs phungs se phung*/ /bya nag kha gdangs mang po thibs se thib/ /lce spyang mang po'i rkan sdebs dir ri ri/ /mi nag ging gi 'o dod lhangs se lhang*/ /mon mo'i glu len mang po kyur ru ru/ /rgya gar mang po'i bro rdung chems se chem/ / ba shan pa nag po'i gri skor lings se lings*/ /mi nag zhags thogs mang po khrabs se khrab/ /mi nag rnga thogs mang po khrigs se khrig /mi nag mtshon thogs mang po zings se zing*/ /mchu sder rnon po rnams ni thibs se thib/ /ma mo'i zor 'phen mang po shar ra ra/ /sngags pa phur thogs mang po rongs se rong*/ /nag po'i dmag tshogs mang po nyer re re// bskul lo bos so mahā kā la'i tshogs/ /thub pas sngags pa'i dam can las la bh+yoḥ drag shul spyod pa'i cha byad las la bh+yoḥ smod pa ngan sngags mtshon cha= smra ba dug gi kha rlangs= mu stegs 'dam bu'i glang chen= srin po pho nya zhing skyong = dgra bgegs gshed po khrag 'thung = chos byed srung ma nag po= snying ring bshan pa khrag 'thung = mna' bzan gshed po nag po= ngan byed gnyan po khrag 'thung = rnal 'byor dgra lha nag mo= nag po stong gi tshogs rnams= ma mo bye ba'i tshogs rnams= bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams= las kyi bshan pa nyer gcig las la bh+yoḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'di/ /rgyob cig sregs shig tshos shig zhal du gsol/ /thul zhig bzung zhig chings shig dam por sdoms/

/ lo dang zla bar bzhag pa'i skabs med pas/ khug cig sdoms shig chings shig rnam par gtor/ /zhag dang za mar ma bzhag myur du sgrol/ /phye zhig bskrod cig gnon cig rmugs par gyis/ /thul cig choms shig rengs shig rnam par gshig /sku gsung thugs kyis gtad la ma g.yel cig /gsod cig chod cig srog rtsa myur du chod/ /dgra bgegs rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /sha chen khrag la rol cig hub kyis drongs/ /ma thogs myur du sgrol cig gtubs la gsol/ /bcol ba'i las rnams mdzod cig sa mā ya/ khrag 'thung rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bsten pa'i tshe na chos skyong rgyang ma ring*//bstan pa'i spyi dgra yal bar ma bor zhig /bos pa'i tshe na mgon po snyan ma sra/ /bla ma'i sku dgra yal bar ma btang cig /g.yabs pa'i tshe na mgon po spyan ma btul/ /chos kyi sgra 'di yal bar ma btang cig /rbad pa'i dus na dam can mthu ma chung*/ /rnal 'byor dgra 'di yal bar ma btang cig /mdor na rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ khyod la yang yang bskul kyang dgos pa med/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can 'di/ /ma thogs myur du sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ / ces skul 'di skabs thams cad langs te byed/ de nas stan la 'dug ste sngags ring ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /dgu pa gsol ka ni/ hūṃ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che/ / rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka'i phyag brnyan mchog /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal che/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya che'i gtor ma rgya mtsho dang*/ /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i zhal du 'bul/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po nyer dgongs te/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun nod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*/ /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

/ gtor ma la sman phud dang rak+ta sgrengs/ zas sna sna tshogs kyis gtor ma dang po de/ shar du rim pas blugs te/ gtor sngags shugs phyung la lan gsum brjod/ mthar/ hoḥ dpal mgon po nag po dug gsum gyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyug /mna' bzan gyi gshed ma/ dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dpa' bo/ bstan srungs kyi mnga' bdag chen po/ 'khor pho nya las mkhan g.yog 'khor grangs las 'das shing brjod du mi lang ba rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ bar du gcod pa thams cad thal ba rdul du rlag par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig /dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig / dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyor zhig /bsam pa thams cad sgrubs/ re ba thams cad skongs/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad khyab par mdzod/ khyad par du yang deng drag po'i 'phrin las mngon par zhu ba lags kyi/ bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma 'di dag /skad cig nyid la bsad pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ bcings pa'i sgo du ma nas 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ grogs dag bcas pa dang*/ srung skyob dang bcas pa thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig / ces pa'i mthar/ bsad sngags ring thung gang rung zhig tshar gcig gam gsum brjod/ de kho na'i rim pas/ slar yang*/ hūṃ mgon po mtshan gsol zhes man chad/ bsad sngags kyi bar gsol ka las bcol bskul ba 'di tshar lnga bya ste/

gtor chen gyi lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang la re re dang*/ mtshams bzhi la gcig rnams so/ /de nas bcu pa zor 'phang ba ni/ 'phyar dar nag po dang*/ dam rdzas kyi dud pa dang*/ gser skyems sogs kyis sna drangs te/ spros pa la dga' na pho nya las mkhan gyi cha byad 'dzin pa'i/ drag po'i rol rtsed ci rigs pa dang bcas shing*/ go mtshon thogs pas kyang mtha' bskor/ slob dpon 'khor bcas rol mo ba dang bcas pas rting mnan nas 'ongs te/ gtor chen stegs mtho ba la bzhag /zor sna rnams dang*/ thun rnams kyang bshams/ skabs 'dir gzu dpang 'dzugs te/ hūṃ srid pa'i rtse mo man chod nas/ /dmyal ba na rag yan chod du/ /gzu dang dpang la dkon mchog bzhugs/ /yi dam chos skyong dpang mdzod cig /zhal bzhi yab yum dpang mdzod cig /tshangs pa brgya sbyin= gza' dang rgyu skar= dbang chen khyab 'jug= lha srin sde brgyad= ya bdun rgyal po man chad nas/ /'ching byed zhags thogs yan chod du/ /do nub gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /skyes bu klu btsan man chad nas/ /drag dmar btsan rgod yan chod du/ /do nub= srid pa'i rgyal mo man chad nas/ /'gong po spun dgu yan chod du/ /do nub= dbyings phyug rgyal mo man chad nas/ /dam sri pho mo yan chod du/ /do nub= zhal lce lha 'dre yongs kyis chod/ kha smra srung ma gnyan gyis thob/ /nga yis ma nyes 'di yis nyes/ /dam la 'das pa'i sdig can 'di/ /bstan pa bshig cing dkon mchog smod/ /srung ma khyod la snyad btsugs so/ /sngags 'chang bdag la do yang bdos/ /rgyal khams phung bar 'dis yis byas/ /mkha' 'gro srung ma ra mda' log /sdang byed dgra bo dam nyams 'di'i/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag skya bo chod/ /sa yi brten phur nag po phud/ /las kyis rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas gsus/ khod pa'i nang nas snying byung cig /dpral ba'i dbyings nas mig brus shig /ltag pa'i phyogs nas bdud chod cig

/lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig /myur bar khug la rings par sgrol/ / ces pa'o/ /de rjes gser skyems dang*/ zor lam dbye ba sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ spro na slar yang*/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā ya/ / sogs kyis kyang bskul lo/ /mthar/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi bka' nyan pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs sprul pa/ /gtum po khrag 'thung skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag /zhing skyong nag po chen po las la ya/ khyod kyi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab te/ /gang 'dul sprul pa ma thogs cir yang ston/ /bdud dpung dgra bgegs 'dul bar chas pa'i tshe/ /mkha' la mi bzad sprin rum dmar nag 'khrigs/ /rdo rje'i thogs dang ser chen phyogs bcur 'bab/ /'ur 'ur sgra yis ri bo'i tshogs rnams bsgyel/ /phyogs mtshams thams cad me 'bar khro chu 'bab/ /sa gzhi sdig sbrul srog chags gdug pas khyab/ /stag seng gcan gyi tshogs rnams lang long rgyu/ /gsod byed srin po'i tshogs kyis sa steng khyab/ khrag 'thung ma mo'i tshogs kyis bar snang khengs/ /nyi zla gza' skar khros pas mkha' dbyings khyab/ /mtshon cha'i bu yug phyogs bcur bun nu nu/ /dgra tshogs da lta 'joms pa'i dus la bab/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /rings par song la drag tu ded/ /myur bar song la dam du chings//

mgyogs par khug la nges par gsod/ /gri gug 'bar bas dgra srog chod/ / ral gri 'bar bas yan lag gtubs/ /mdung thung 'bar bar lus kun phug / rtse gsum 'bar bas sgo gsum drol/ /nag po chen po sku bskyod cig/zhing skyong chen po rtsal ma zhan/ /stobs 'phrog nag po mthu ma chung*/ /zhal gdangs drag po'i bshugs pa 'tsher/ /g.yung mo nag mo dgra la ya/ /gad rgyangs chen pos dgra snying 'gems/ /mi srun gtum mo dgra la ya/ khrag rgyun gsol bas myos pa mo/ /srin mo 'jigs rung dgra la ya/ /skye gnas nad yams na bun mthul/ / sing ga gling ma dgra la bh+yoḥ /dam nyams dgra la smyo 'bog gtong*/ /bshan pa sngon po dgra la chos/ /dgra la nang 'khrug thog ser 'bebs/ /bshan pa ser po dgra la chos/ /bstan pa 'jig pa nad kyis 'debs/ /bshan pa dmar po dgra la chos/ /'gal byed mi phyugs phyogs kyis 'debs/ /bshan pa ljang khu dgra la chos/ /srog gcod rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /bshan pa nag po dgra la chos/ /ling pa chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /do nub dgra bgegs chom la phob/ / yum cig e ka dza ṭi ni/ /ral pa gcig gis khams gsum khyab/ /dbang phyug chen mo mthu rtsal can/ /dgra bgegs snying la da zo cig /gshin rje khro tsha lus po che/ khab mig tsam la'ang rtag tu 'jug /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon te/ /bi nu rā dza dgra la ya/ /srid pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le/ /stong gsum bha ga'i dbyings su 'jug khyab byed sna tshogs gzugs can ma/ /bdud 'dul chen mo dgra la bh+yoḥ /bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig kyang*/ /mthong ba tsam gyis sdangs par byed/ /do nub dgra bo'i yul du chos/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog / tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ /'khor byed chen po dgra la ya/ /srog bdag gnam lha byang chub ste/ /smyo byed chen po dgra la ya/ /skyes bu gying chen dgra lha khyod/ /cho 'phrul ltas ngan dgra la ya/ /nag po 'bum phrag drug la sogs/

/ zhing skyong mthu chen bsam mi khyab/ /do nub dgra bo'i yul du chos/ /lhag ma med par choms las zhog /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /drag po'i las la da bskul gyi/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul bzhin rlag par mdzod/ /lhag ma ci yang ldangs rgyu med par mdzod/ /sa steng 'di ru ming yang med par mdzod/ /dam pa dus la bab po sa mā ya/ / zhes drag tu bskul la/ ḍo bi ni de bi bh+yoḥ rdo zor 'phangs/ tsaṇ+ḍa lis ra zor dang*/ : ra kha £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· rak+ṭa £© sis khrag zor dang*/ sing ga lis mda' zor dang*/ de thams cad la/ mahā kā la thun bh+yoḥ zhes pas rgyab brten/ bsad sngags drag tu bzla zhing thun 'phang ngo*/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po'i bka' 'khor ni/ /nag po'i dmag tshogs nyer re re/ /sha za'i ngar skad dir ri ri/ /ma mo'i zor 'phen shar ra ra/ /mkha' 'gro'i shugs klu rtser re re// lha mo'i glu dbyangs kyur ru ru/ /mi nag gar byed khyugs se khyug /ro langs gad rgyangs dir ri ri/ /keng rus gar byed zangs se zang*/ /bya nag mang po thibs se thib/ /lce spyang ngu 'bod lhangs se lhang*/ khyi nag mang po khengs se kheng*/ /rnam 'phrul du ma ston pa rnams/ /la la 'gying zhing dgra la rol/ /la la 'phyong zhing bgegs rnams 'joms/ /la la hab hub khrag la 'thung*/ /la la rgod cing ro la za/ /la la chem chem rus pa mur/ /la la 'gying zhing dgra rnams gsod/ /la la rgyug cing dam nyams sgrol/ /sdig can chos la sdang ba 'di/ /bdud kyi khram la thob la shog /sho sde nag po khrom la shog /zhags pa dmar nag thob las shog khyod kyis khas blangs dus la bab/ /dmar ky-i gtor ma 'dis bzhes la// bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /bdun brgyud rtsa nas chod la shog /oṃ māhā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+ṣa si/ sing ga li/ de bi bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ a ya ma ru ru tsa sha na bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ

zhes pa dang*/ bsad sngags drag po brjod cing gtor ma zor du 'phang*/ dgra bgegs phyogs gtogs yul 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad lhag ma tsam yang med par byas par bsam/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas mtshams bcad de/ slob dpon gyi rting mnan la 'ongs/ rjes kyi bya ba ni gong gtor sgrub kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir cung zad nges 'tshal pa la/ sgrub skor rnying pa khungs ma phal cher du/ rnam 'gyur gsum pa nyid bshad de/ de yang bsnyen dus ni gtor chog dkyus kyi de yin/ 'di la rtsa zhal brtsegs ma nyid nag po la 'dzol so med/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag bya ba la/ phyis kyi phal cher ljang la nag pa'i mdangs can du mtshungs par bzhed/ yi ge rnying pa rang mang po na/ g.yas sngo g.yon ljang du bshad pa'ang 'dug /sgrub pa dang las sbyor gnyis phal cher rnam 'gyur 'dra bar byed/ spogs chog la g.yas brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yon brtsegs ma gnyis ljang khur bshad/ de ka'i dbang du byas nas skabs 'dir gtor ma'i las sbyor yin pas/ las sgrub gnyis po rnam 'gyur gcig pa'i phyir dkyus la de bzhin du bris pa yin/ kha cig las sbyor dang spogs chog rnams 'gyur gcig par bzhed de/ de la'ang 'gal ba ma mthong ngo*/ /'ga' zhig rnam 'gyur bzhi par 'dod pa ltar na/ gzhan gsum spyi dang 'dra/ las sbyor mgon po zhal bzhi'i 'khor zhal du 'dod do/ /'on kyang sgrub pa'i bya ba ni/ thog ma bsnyen pa'i phyogs la yang 'jug /phyi ma las sbyor gyi phyogs la yang 'jug pas/ kun khyab yin pa'i phyir sgrub nus nyid gtso bor bya'o/ /zhes bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa rnams gsung ngo*// //de ltar na nag po gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma'i las rim zhi drag nyer mkho tsam gsal bar brjod pa/ las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang*/ rang gi slob rigs me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang sgrub gnas byang chen gyi dge 'dun rnams sogs don gnyer can mang pos snga phyir yang yang bskul ba la brten nas tā ra nā thas zhor byung du bris pa'o/

/'di dag la yig rnying rtsa ba rnams/ tho yig tsam las med cing*/ bar skabs dang phyis kyi yi ge ci rigs 'dug pa rnams/ tshig tshogs ha cang ches bas gzung dka' bar 'dug pas 'dir mdor bsdus tsam tshig zor yang bar bkod pa yin no/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dang*/ sgraṃ sgraṃ sil sil ngaum ngaum rang byed mkhan cig ma lags pa/ 'di 'dra rigs la rtsal 'don rang med mod/ /'on kyang man ngag cung zad rig cing*/ gzhan kyis bskul ba la brten nas bag tsam zhig bris pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ zhus dag ༄༅/ /lha chen lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs / na mo gu ru mahā kā lā ya/ rab 'jigs dregs pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo che/ /sgrub la bu gcig ltar brtse dngos grub stsol/ /bla ma dang ni nag po chen po la/ /gus pas btud nas gtor ma'i cho ga bshad/ /'dir bris sku dang mchod gtor bshams/ bdag bskyed dang yi dam gyi mchod gtor sngon du 'gro bas 'di skad ces bya'o/ / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas/ shin tu gtum pa'i ljongs/ dregs pa bdud kyi yul/ dug gi na bun 'thul ba/ drag po'i glog 'khyug cing*/ rgyob sod kyi 'brug sgra sgrog pa/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi ser ba 'bab cing*/ ma mo 'du ba'i gnas/ mtshan mo me 'bar ba/ nyin mo rlung nag 'tshub cing*/ na bun rnag khrag dang zhag tu 'bab pa/ mi ro skam rlon rid gsum sna tshogs bcal du bkram zhing*/ khrag zhag gi rba klong 'khrug pa/ gcan gzan gtum po rnams ngar skad 'bod pa'i dbus na/ rmangs gzhi lcags las grub pa'i steng du/ shar mi'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ lhor rta'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ nub spre'u'i thod pas brtsigs pa/

byang lug gi thod pas brtsigs pa'i pho brang chen po/ phyi rin po che'i gzhal yas khang la/ nang thod pa'i mkhar du yod pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa shin tu 'jigs shing rab tu 'bar ba/ zur bzhi zangs la byas pa/ sgo bzhi bse las byas pa/ gser gyi re cha gsal ba/ mu min 'phrul gyi g.yag shing can/ /rta babs dung la grub pa/ zangs lcags kyi khrag gi bang yod pa/ nang ke rus kyi ka gdung rnams kyis phub pa/ rus pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed dang*/ mi mgo brtsigs pa'i tog gis mtshan pa/ ngos rnams la khrag gi zar chu 'bab pa/ de'i nang mi ro rta ro bcal du bkram pa/ mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil ba/ mi lpags rta lpags yol bar bres pa/ gsur chen dud pa phyogs bcur 'thul ba/ phyi rol rmang gzhi'i stegs bu la ro langs kyis shon byed pa/ /keng rus kyi gar mkhan 'khrab pa/ phyogs thams cad du zhing chen gyi bla bre/ mi ro'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ mgo bo sna tshogs kyi do shal dang*/ /skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa nyam nga la bag tsha ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i pho brang gi lte bar nag po bdun brtsegs mkhar zur drug pa la mthing bzang g.yu'i skas btsugs pa'o/ /de'i dbus su mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi ro rta ro la gnas pa'i raṃ las dug sdaung raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha chen dpal 'bar mahā kā la srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can sku mdog smug nag bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas shwa na mu kha'i gdong shel mig gyen du phyogs pas dgra bgegs la zug cing bla 'gugs pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril zhing rkan sgra sdeb pa/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi gad mo dang nga ro drag po sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis dung gi sdong po me 'bar ba dang bdud zhags/

g.yon gnyis kyis khram shing dang thod pa snying bcas khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bsgrad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang skra khams nag gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul nag dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzags pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ dug sbrul stong gi chun pos brgyan pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber sum brtsegs mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang gser gyi ska rags can/ de'i steng na dred mo'i bcang slag seng ge sngon po'i gong lag can gsol ba/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ snyan nas 'brug stong ldir zhing*/ dri 'dzin nas nag po brtsegs pa'i rlung dmar ldang ba/ sdang mig las me 'od spro zhing*/ zhal du sha khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba/ sgo dgu nas nyams pa la dug gi char sprin 'bebs pa/ spyi bo la nyi zlas brgyan pa/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ khams gsum 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa/ dgra bgegs dang log par lta ba thams cad skad cig gis rdul du rlog pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du bh+yoḥlas ral gri bh+yoḥs mtshan pa zhu ba las dpal ldan lha mo gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ zhal ras phyi rgyab tu phyogs pas gzigs pa/ mi ro zhal du gsol bzhin pas mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral ba dmar ser g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na zhing chen dang ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can me 'bar ba/ g.yon gnyis na ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor bu'i char 'bebs pa dang*/ thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ snyan g.yas g.yon la dug sbrul dang seng ges brgyan pa/ zhal nas drag sngags kyi 'o dod 'bod cing*/ mig nas khrag gi char pa 'bab pa/ shangs nas nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi ma 'char zhing*/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu zla ba rgyas pa/

mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs shing*/ re ldes smad dkris pa/ sbrul rigs bzhi'i ska rags bcings pa/ zhabs la dbang gi lcags sgrog 'khrol ba/ srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar la chibs pa/ nad kyi rkyal pa mtshon gyi gru gu byang dmar gyi khres po/ sho rde'u dkar nag bdud kyi khram bam ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas pa/ srin po'i ya 'khal la snga ru dang ma 'khal la phyi ru byas pa/ gong smed sbrul las bgyis shing rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rgyu ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhugs pa'o/ / zur drug tu bh+yoḥdrug las sprul pa pho nya mon mo shwa na nag mo drug skad cig gis grub pa ni/ gser mig ma/ dngul mig ma/ zangs mig ma/ 'khar mig ma/ g.yu mig ma/ mchong mig ma rnams khyi'i gdong can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog nag mo g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la gsor zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa nag po 'phen pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/ ral pas rting par slebs pa/ phyag rgya bsgyur zhing gar byed pa/ khyi skad 'don zhing ri rab bskor ba/ lhang lhang ngu zhing dur khrod nyul ba/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad ni lcags kyi bya khra brgyad du sprul nas sngon la ldeng bas snga dgra dar ba rdul du rlog pa/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje chen po brgyad ni/ stag/gzig /dom/ dred/ 'phar ba/ seng ge /ce spyang*/ khyi rnams su sprul nas phyi bzhin du 'breng bas phyi dgra sems pa rdul du rlog pa'o/ / phyi bskor du sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa bdud pho seng ge'i gdong can gsum dang ri bdun dang ma bdun las byung ba'i sprul pa'i mon pa pho bdun mo bdun rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sprul pa dang yang sprul gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ bdud kyi dmag nyis khri chig stong*/ lha dmag 'bum sde dang bcas shing*/ lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams dang bcas pa thams cad kyang gcer bu 'dab chags thang la bor ba ltar 'dar yed yed 'dug pa thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i bka' sdod par gyur/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyis gnas nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan ras gzigs mgon thugs kyi 'phrin las las/ /rnam 'phrul zhi bas 'dul bar mi spyod cing*/ /drag po'i stobs kyis gdug pa tshar gcod pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod ni 'dir byon cig /lha chen thugs kyi pho nya mthu bo che/ khyod kyi rnam 'phrul phyogs bcu ma lus khyab/ /yab gcig rtag tu 'dod rgyal khang bzang na// phal cher u tsa la yi dur khrod na/ /res 'ga' bsil ba'i tshal na srin po'i gzugs/ /da lta tsa ri rong gi pho brang na/ khyod kyi brten sa rtsub mo'i brag phug na/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i rjes 'brang zhing*/ /gang gis bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub mdzad pa/ /drag po dbang phyug gzi ldan 'dir byon cig /sngon tshe phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru/ /trak+shad khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /drag po'i las la gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e h+ya hi mahā kā la trak+shad sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ

nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod phul/ hūṃ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*/ /lha dmag dkar po'i dbug 'byin pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes bstod la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la trak+shad mahā kā la sid+dhi tri yaṃ dun dza dzaḥ zhes dpal mgon po dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ zhes dpal lha mo'i sngags so/ /de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga bskyed/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ rlung gis me sbar ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas lbu ba oṃ du gyur/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ de la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi ljags gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can la reg cing gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥ sa ma ya sa ma lo ki ni mun bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa bā liṃ i daṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi bhuñja ho/ rak+ta pi ba to sa ma ya swāhā/ oṃ de wi mahā kā li re ma ti mahā bā ling ta khā hi/

mahā mang sa kha hī/ rak+ta khā hi/ tsit+ta la khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ mahā pañca a mṛ ta bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyug dug gsum gyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing*/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ lha'i ded dpon chen po/ srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can bā ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ nag mo dre'u la zhon pa/ gcer mo bong bu la zhon pa/ 'gyogs ma rlung la zhon pa/ bā ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi mon mo drug /byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ lho phyogs kyi gshen rje chen po brgyad/ sprul pa yang sprul pho nya 'khor gyi dmag nyis khri chig stong sde brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad bā ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti yak+ṣa bai ta li sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar nas nang mchod phul/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur sbyon srog bdud ma rung pa/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso/ /drag po'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /rdo rje mahā kā la ste/ /lha chen lcam dral spyan 'dren gyi/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /srog gi bka' sdod mgon po'i sku/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ / mdog nag gzugs chen brjid pa la/ /ral pa khams nag gyen du 'khyil/ / steng gi lha tshogs dbang du bsdud/ khros bas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/

/ 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab sgyel/ /dbang phyug che la bdag bstod do/ / g.yas pa dug sdong bdud zhags bsnams/ /g.yon pa thod pa snying bcas gsol/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /las kyi srog bdud chen po ni/ /bdud rta nag po rting dkar 'chibs/ /sku che yan lag rags shing brjid/ /spyan dmar zhal gdangs ljags 'gril zhing*/ /sku la ber nag smug po gsol/ /sag ti'i lham la pad nyi'i gdan/ /bskal pa'i me dpung nang na 'gying*/ /mthu stobs can la bdag bstod do/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar thugs bskyed pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ /thams cad khyod kyis gzhom pa dang*/ / bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel pa dang*/ /thams cad dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams gzhom pa yi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi khyod kyis bgyis/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ ma yi nang nas ma gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas sring gcig ma/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /lha yi gnas na lha mo nam gru ma// klu yi gnas na klu mo glog 'gyu ma/ /srin po'i gnas na srin mo sham sham mo/ / mi yi gnas na bdud mo re ma tī/ /mi la bdud du khyod las che ba med/ /gnas ni byang shar mtshams na gnas/ /rgyu ni bar snang mkha' la rgyu/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi dbugs 'cha' ma/ /rkang la lcags kyi lham gyon ma/ /sku la mdzes pa'i re lde gsol/ /mi mgo rta mgo mkhar du brtsigs/ /thod pa dgu brtsegs gzhal yas 'dir/ /ma cig lha mo spyan 'dren no/ /do nub nam gyi gung stod la/ /ming po rdo rje las 'chol gyi/

/sring mo dam can las mdzod la/ /brnag pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /sgrub pa'i tshe na zor ma lci/ / : sbad [ rbad ] pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ srog bdud nag po chen po yi/ /bka' nyan sgrol byed ma mo drug khyi mo nag mo shes rab gsal/ khro chu'i zhal la rdo rje'i sku/ /ri rab bskor zhing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /lhang lhang ngu zhing dur khrod nyul/ / sdig can sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /bdud kyi bu mo las la ya/ khyi mo nag mo gser mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo dngul mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo mkhar mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo mchong mig ma/ / bdud kyi bu mo khyed drug kyang*/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nyams pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /bar chad sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /mon mo nag mo shel mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo gser mig ma/ /zangs mig ma/ g.yu mig ma/ dngul mig ma/ lcags mig ma/ mon mo nag mo bse mig ma/ /mon mo chen mo khyed bdun yang*/ /sha khrag sogs gong bzhin/ hūṃ mon pa nag po byi la zhon/ /mon pa nag po 'brug la zhon/ /sbrul la zhon/ glog la zhon/ stag la zhon/ khyung la zhon/ rlung la zhon/ bdud kyi bshan pa khyed bdun yang*/ /sha khrag = sogs gong bzhin/ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang*/ /phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren dmag gi tshogs/ /bdud pho nyis khri chig stong dang*/ /lha dmag dkar po 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ sha khrag = sogs kyis bskul zhing 'phrin las bcol/ thun gyi gtor ma med na 'jug gi cho ga bya'o/ /gal te thun gtor yod na/ skabs 'di nyid du gtong ste/ hūṃ srid gsum dbang bsdud mgon po yab yum dang*/

/stobs ldan pho nya mngag bzhugs 'khor dang bcas/ /shin tu 'jigs khros drag la rngam pa'i gzugs/ /rno ba'i mtshon 'dzin 'gyogs pa'i shugs can rnams/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig / dzam bu ti ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /dam nyams dgra po'i sha khrag 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs chen por bzhes/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad dang gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam tshig bden pa bzhin/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba = sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gong gi bstod thung gis bstod/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa sgrub pa'i gdong grogs dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog pa dang*/ dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i tshe/ mi zad pa'i longs spyod/ rab tu rgyas pa'i dbang thang*/ thub par dka' ba'i mthu stobs rnams stsal ba dang*/ mdor na bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya ba ci 'grub tu bzla zhing*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/

dam tshig pa rang nyid la bstim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis bdag bsrung*/ slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par byas la thun mtshams la 'jug go /'dir mon pa pho bdun mo bdun sogs kyi zhal phyag bzhon pa bskyed par 'dod na/ bskul ba rgyas pa so so dag nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed kyang rung la/ man ngag ltar na mon pa byi la la zhon pa bdud zhags dang nad rkyal/ 'brug la zhon pa ral gri dang thod khrag /sbrul la zhon pa dug sdong dang be con/ glog la zhon pa phyag gnyis kyis be con nag po/ stag la zhon pa spu gri dang snying zhags/ khyung la zhon pa sta re dang sbrul zhags/ rlung la zhon pa ral gri dang zhags pa nag po'o/ /hūṃ gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa 'jigs byed bdud pho gsum khram shing dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa seng ge'i gdong can seng ge la zhon pa'o/ /mon mo shel mig ma shel gyi ral pa can nas/ bse mig ma bse'i ral pa can gyi bar rdo rje dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gzhan yang dpal mgon po sku mdog nag po yang rung zhing*/ lha mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang*/ ne'u le nad skyal du bsgyur zhing*/ dre rta rkang gsum la chibs pa dang phyag gnyis ma sogs sna tshogs yod cing*/ shwa na mo rnams kyang*/ gser/ g.yu/ mchong*/ zangs*/ dung*/ mkhar ba/ lcags rnams kyi mig can dang*/ mig dang mthun pa'i ral pa byed pa sogs yod pa 'ga' zhig 'dam ka dang*/ 'ga' zhig bsnyen sgrub dang las tshogs so so'i skabs yin no/ /shel mig ma'am/ dung mig ma'am/ khyi mo shes rab gsal phyag bzhi mar bskyed par yod do/ /man ngag logs su bstan par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa tsam dang nyer 'brel bar/ /sgrub thabs mchod chog 'di byas pas/ /bstan dgra bdud sde bcas bcom nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par shog /lha chen lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di ni/

'jam dbyangs rdo rje bla ma'i gtor chog la gzhi byas te/ yig rnying nas kha bkang ste lhag chad nor ba'i dri ma spangs shing*/ rgyas bsdus 'tshams la klag chog tu byas pa ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cigabakra shis/ gcig zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /dpal mgon trak+shad kyi bskang gso'i cho ga las bzhi rnam rol bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma sangs rgyas nag po chen po dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab brjid bzod dka' gdug pa 'dul ba'i sku/ /ma rungs bdud kyi klad 'gems drag po'i dbyangs/ / dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i thugs/ /slob dpon mchog dang mgon po dbyer med la/ /gus pas btud nas mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /rgyas bsdus skyon bral 'jug bde rnams gsal ba// gong ma'i gsung las gzhan du ma 'gyur bar/ /mchog tu brtse ba'i sems kyis bri bar bya/ /'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ sbyor ba la lnga yod pa las/ dang po rdzas tshogs par bya ba ni/ 'di skad ces/ bshos nag zur gsum khru gang dang*/ /nam rgyang nag po mda' tshad gnyis/ /rta lug g.yag khyi dom spyang 'phar/ /de rnams gang 'grub mtha' nas bskor/ /bya nag rma bya'i rgyal mtshan gzugs/ / mi rkang g.yang gzhi gri snying rnams/ /yod na dngos bshams med na dbyibs/ /bya lug smug nag la sogs bshams/ /mchod rdzas gtor ma bdud rtsi dang*/ khrag chen chang phud spos chen dang*/ /dkyil 'khor dam rdzas tshang ba bshams/ /gu gul maṃ sa'i dud pas bdug /ces so/ /gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i chos gnyis ni/ yi dam gang byed pa de'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs so/ /gsum pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed do/ /bzhi pa ni yig brgya'i sgom bzlas so/ /lnga pa tshogs bsag sngon du 'gro bas mtshams bcad pa ni/ bsrung 'khor yan chad so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o/
