/lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang nyid las/ /zhes sogs gyer ni rnying ma'i bdag bskyed dang 'brel na bya la/ gzhan ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bco brgyad las/ dang po bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor sgom bzlas dang*/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed yi dam gyi gtor ma ni gzhung ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa rten bskyed pa ni/ gtor chog ltar gyi mgon po gzhal yas khang bskyed la gyer ro/ / hūṃ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul/ /bsten no bsten no ye shes lha bsten no/ /sgrub bo sgrub bo ye shes lha sgrub bo/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang bskyed rgya ma chung*/ /seng ge glang chen khri bshams dpangs ma dma'/ /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan bshams 'od ma zhan/ /ru tra pho mo'i gdan bshams brjid ma chung*/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi sgrub po bcud ma zhan/ /mgyogs pa'i pho nya mngag go bang ma bul/ /bdud pho bdud mo bskul lo ro ma gyong*/ / dbang phyug rtsa brgyad tshogs rnams 'khor ma zhan/ /brtan ma bran du 'khol lo ru ma nga*/ /

zhes so/ /'on kyang bsdus pa'i skabs gyer 'di ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do/ /bzhi pa lha bskyed pa gzhung ltar bya/ lnga pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ gtor chog ltar ram/ yang na 'di skad ces/ hūṃ thugs rje chen po mi g.yo gtsug tor can/ /mchod sbyin skyabs mdzad phyag rgya nyid las ni/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo chen po'i skur ston zhing*// byang shar mtshams na gnas bcas shin tu bde/ /bar snang sprin rum lta bu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku mdog sngo nag mi bzad dug gi mdog /shin tu khros shing gtum bag ldan pa ste/ /nam mkha'i khams kun ma lus khyab par ston// brjid mnan stabs su bzhugs pa ste/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i lha/ / nag po chen po spyan 'dren na/ /lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes nyi zer stong khams rgyas pa'i sku/ /gsung gi dbyangs snyan pad+ma kun du rgyas// thugs kyi thugs mchog gsang ba'i dbyings dang mnyam/ /mchog gsum rnam dag mnga' ba gshegs su gsol/ /phyag na rtse gsum mi mgos brgyan pa bsnams/ khros pa'i tshul gyis phyag mtshan drug la spyod/ /thod rlon dang ni tsit+ta'i phyag rgya can/ /spyan gsum 'jig rten dbang phyug gshegs su gsol/ / dbyings kyi ma mo thugs las sprul pa ste/ /dur khrod bdag mo dbang byed ma mo bdun/ /sprul pa mon mo yang sprul khyi mor bcas/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dul zhing bstan pa bsrung*/ /dur khrod ma mo 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ /nag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren na/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /bh+yoḥ nam mkha' stong la rol pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo srid gsum bdag / dus gsum spyod pa'i mnga' bdag re ma tī/ /dgra 'dul chen mo gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi mahā kā la ga na pa ti mahā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hūṃ dza dzaḥ

nag mo s+t+waṃ laṃ ya dun bh+yo dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ drug pa dam ye bsre zhing rgyas gdab pa'ang gzhung ltar bya'o/ /bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gnas 'di ru/ /rdo rje brag chen rab tu gtams pa'i steng*/ /rin chen gdan khri nyi zla bag tsher ldan/ /mi ro rta ro mang po'i bcal steng du/ /dug gi me tog sngon po bcal bkram nas/ /mi lpags rta lpags brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /rab brjid dpa' bo chen po bzhugs su gsol/ /lha min gdug pa g.yul las bzlog pa'i phyir/ /ded dpon dpa' bo chen po bzhugs su gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bo gtan nas brlag mdzad pa/ /mon pa dug gi skyes bu bzhugs su gsol/ /dug gsum rtag tu 'joms pa'i dpa' mtshan ni/ /rtse gsum mgul bar thod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /rgyal mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin zhing bzhugs su gsol/ /dgra khrag dgra snying gsol zhing ru tra 'dul/ /phyag na thod pa snying bcas bzhugs su gsol/ /srog la mnga' mdzad nyams pa'i bdud mdzad pa/ /srog bdag chen po gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med ldan pa'i phyir/ /yak+sha be ta lī dang thabs gcig tu/ / bdag gis mchod pa bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'bras bu mchis pa dang*/ /chos kyi bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir/ /'khor dang bcas te brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la traka shad mahā kā la sid+dhi tri yaṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ bh+yoḥ srid gsum dbang bsdud nag mo re ma tī// mthing nag ral pa sprin dpung 'thibs pa 'dra/ /ti ra'i gnas nas byis pa'i dur byed ma/ /mi dur gcod byed nag mo bzhugs su gsol/ /ma mo nag mo rak+sha ma'i sku la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ / brgyad pa mchod tshogs 'bul ba la gnyis las/ snga ma mchod tshogs bsham pa ni/ hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje las byung ba/ /srid pa'i grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig

/ srid pa'i ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dpal ldan mgon po mthu chen khyod/ / yon tan byin gyis brlabs po che/ /'phags pa'i sa kun brnyes gyur kyang*/ / dus ngan sems can 'dul slad du/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yang bsrung*/ /skye 'gro 'phongs pa'i skyabs kyang mdzad/ /phyag na mdung dang bing chen bsnams/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /gri snying la sogs snying sna'i tshogs/ /mi sha rta sha la sogs sha sna'i tshogs// me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig /la du la phug la sogs yid bzhin 'bras bu'i zas/ /phyogs bcu'i chu skyes thang skyes la sogs longs spyod rkyen/ / ris su ma chad longs spyod rgyas par 'bul/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mdzes par bkra ba dang*/ /bshos gtsang mar me lha bshos sna tshogs dang*/ /rgun chang la sogs btung ba'i mchog /sbrang rtsi la sogs mngar ba'i ro/ /zho phruṃ la sogs dkar gsum zas/ /sna tshogs mchod pa mang po rnams/ /srog bdud 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /yun gyi mgon por khyod mchod kyi/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs rjes gdung ba'i zhing la dgongs/ /bdag cag re skong smon lam rnams/ /'phags pa'i mgon po khyod kyis grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti/ a ha ra yak+sha du/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pra tīts+tsha ho/ mahā yak+sha be ta li khā hi khā hi/ phyi ma mchod tshogs 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje las byung ba/ /srid pa'i grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig / srid pa'i ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dpal ldan mgon po mthu chen khyod/ / yon tan byin gyis brlabs po chai/ /'phags pa'i sa kun brnyes gyur kyang*/ / dus ngan sems can 'dul slad du/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yang bsrung*/ /skye 'gro 'phongs pa'i skyabs kyang mdzad/ /phyag na bdud 'dul kha ṭ+wāṃ ka /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/

/yun gyi mgon por khyod bsten gyi/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rta mchog la sogs sha lnga dang*/ /spyang khu ra dang mkha' lding sha /gzhan yang sna tshogs pa yi sha /btsos pa'i sha dang khu ba'i khrag /bsregs pa'i bsur dang rlon pa'i sha /glo snying nang khrol mkhal mar bcas/ /'bras bu lnga bsgral bdud rtsi ni/ /mi dbang go ro tsa na dang*/ /thal chen mahā maṃ sa dang*/ /rkang dang zhag dang tshil bur bcas/ /nya sha sgog btsong la phug dang*/ /chan thug 'khur ba 'bru sna dang*/ /rtsi thog kha zas sman la sogs/ /bza' btung bro ba'i ro mchog rnams/ /tha dad rtog pa kun spangs nas/ /dri zhim ro mchog brgya ldan pa'i/ / bdud rtsi mchog gi gtor ma 'bul/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*/ /ar+ghaṃ me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me dri dang zhal zas dang*/ /rol mo sil snyan 'phan gdugs dang*/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /yid 'ong mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bdag la gzigs/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i smon lam rnams/ /'phags pa'i mgon po khyed kyis grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti/ a ha ra yak+ṣān tu/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ mahā yak+sha be ta lī/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ badz+ra dhū pe dhū/ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra gan dhe gan/ badz+ra nai we te hrīḥ badz+ra mahā kā la/ thar la luka kā ya badz+ra mahā kā la pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ bzhes shig rol zhig dgongs shig kha raṃ khā hi/ / dgu pa lha mo'i sgos mchod ni/ bh+yoḥ rin chen pho brang thod mkhar dgu brtsegs na/ /rlung nag khros pa 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ khrag gi rgya mtshor keng rus ri rab spungs/ /dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /srin mo nag mo khyod la mchod pa 'bul/ /gzugs snang gzugs su 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /sgra grags dbyings su 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/

/rnam rtog yid kyi tshogs rnams bzhes su gsol/ khyod la mchod pa dmigs su 'bul ba ni/ /mi dbang 'bras bu snying gzhon bcud khrag dang*/ /keng ka'i tshal thog shing lo rlung khyer sogs/ khyed la dmigs su 'bul gyi 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i las 'di 'char bar mi btang 'tshal/ /ma mo nag mo sa ra ta ku lu ku lu ha ha ha maṃ sa khā hi/ rak+ta khā hi/ zhes brjod do/ /bcu pa sman phud 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥtha/ hūṃ/ bhan+dha snod bzang yangs pa ru/ /rang byung gdon nas dag pa ste/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol zhing*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyis gsol/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i mchog /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul gyi bzhes/ /mchod bzhes las kyi dngos grub stsol/ / bcu gcig pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hrīḥtha/ mahā rak+ta bsgral ba'i khrag /mū la tan tra rtsa ba'i khrag /pad+ma rak+ta sbyor ba'i khrag/chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /sha sna brgya dang khrag sna stong*/ /'bul ni nag po chai la 'bul/ /mchod ni yi dam chos skyong las mkhan mchod/ /skong ni snang srid ma mo thugs dam bskang*/ /bskongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub zhu/ /mahā rak+ta khā hi/ go ro tsa na khā hi/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ /zhing chung nya 'phyo tshil chen 'phyar/ /bsur phud bdud rtsi rak+ta'i gtor ma 'bul/ /slob dpon la ni sdang ba dang*/ /rdo rje spun la khro ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag la gnod pa dag /de dag nag po chen pos sgrol/ /yan lag kun gyi sha chod la/ /rtag tu mgon po nag pos gsol/ khrag gi rgyun yang btung bar gyis/ /de yi tshe srog dbang du bsdus/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/

/rkyen dang nad rnams thams cad bzlog oṃ tsan da mahā kā la dhi le na ta/ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā kā la ma mā sha trūṃ/ a mu kaṃ maṃ sa me da/ bha sa me tsa ru ti/ dzi baṃ/ pri yaṃ/ ba ka sha ni/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gh-ih+ṇa khā hi khā hi/ bhu dza ho/ sa mā yaṃ/ a ti kra ma hūṃ phaṭa/ / bcu gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mahā bā liṃ ta te dzo bā liṃ ta bā la ba te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūṃ hrīḥtha/ hūṃ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /bcud kyi sems can gtor mar bshams/ /sha sna brgya dang snying sna stong*/ /'bul ni la ེ gas ldan khyed la 'bul/ /mchod ni zhing bcu'i khro rgyal mchod/ /skong ni snang srid lha srin bskongs/ /bskongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub zhu/ /bzhes shig rol zhig kha raṃ khā hi/ / zhes gyer la/ de rjes gtor chog nas 'byung ba gtor ma byin rlabs dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ zhal du bstabs pa rnams bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa skang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang rgyal ba shākya seng ger gyur/ /gtor nang zla steng a dkar po/ /thal mo khong stong du snying gar sbyar/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ rang nam mkha' mdzod sngon po rin chen sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ zla steng swa ser po/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor dmar po mnyam gzhag can/ zla steng raṃ dmar po/ thal mo phyir bskyed mthe bong bsnol ba kha'i thad du bzhag oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa zla steng ha ljang khu/ g.yon khu tshur g.yas snying gar sdigs mdzub byas pa snod la btang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ ye shes skar mda' dkar po rdor dril can zla steng hūṃ sngon po/

g.yas khu tshur g.yon snying gar snod 'degs tshul bya/ oṃ dz+nyā na ā wa lo ki te sa man+ta s+phā ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūṃ/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo dmar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ zla steng dza dmar po sor mo nang du bsnol ba spyi bor bzhag na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañja na mahā sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes so/ /bcu bzhi pa thugs dam bskang ba la/ yab gtso bor gyur pa'i thugs dam bskang ba dang*/ yum gtso bor gyur pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ hūṃ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ /dam la gnas shing lha la 'phreng*/ khyed ni srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /sngon tshe dpal gyi spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ khyed kyi dam bca' gnyen po de/ /da lta rnal 'byor bdag bskul na/ /bsgrub phyir bskul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /mahā kā la gnas 'dir spyon/ /nag po chen po gnas= rig 'dzin srung ma= legs ldan nag po= bos so bdud rgyal snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs so bdud rgyal spyan ma rtul/ /bsten no bdud rgyal rgyang ma ring*/ /sgrub po mgon po gong ma g.yel/ /skul lo bdud rgyal phrag ma dog /rbad do legs ldan mthu ma chung*/ /thugs dam skong la gnas 'dir byon/ /do nub chad dang khrims la spyon/ /do nub mna' dang mtho la spyon// do nub mthu dang dpung la spyon/ /grogs por byas so gzhung ma ngan/ /mdza' bor byas so ngo ma chung*/ /mna' mthor byas so khrel ma shor/ /rje bor bsten no dbang ma che/ /bran ltar bsgrubs so rgyud ma ngan/ khyed dam tshig gnyan la mi sems sam/ /dang po'i chad so 'di min nam/ /dam tshig 'da' bar ma chad do// bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam/ /dam bcas ma g.yel da tshur spyon/ / bcol ba'i las 'di ma byas na/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' yang bslus/ / dang po'i chad so ma gsos na/

/dam tshig gnyan gyi chad pa 'ong*/ /bka' yi dmod pas sdigs par mchi'o/ /de bas dam la ma 'da' zhig /thugs dam gnyan po bdag skong ngo*/ /bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' yi/ /chad pa'i gzhung las mi ldog go /gnyis ka dam las mi 'da' 'tshal/ /de tsam mtshang la ma brgal na/ /mi shes snyoms las byed par mchi'o/ /kye/ nyon dang mgon po thod phreng can/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la mi sems med/ /zab mo'i don la mi sems med/ /mna' dang khrims la mi brten med/ /zas dang skom la mi chags med/ / do nub khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /do nub nyam chag ma lus bskang*/ /do nub zhig ral ma lus gso/ /do nub lha la bshags pa byed/ /do nub lha la sems 'khon sbyong*/ /do nub nyes par khas kyang len/ /do nub mnyes pa'i zas shig 'dren/ /do nub mdza' ba'i gzhung zhig srong*/ /do nub byams pa'i lan zhig ldaun/ /do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong*/ /do nub phyi ma'i zhu skyems 'bul/ /do nub khyed rnams dgongs su gsol/ /phyag brnyan rgya nag dgongs su gsol/ / pho nya lcags spyang = tshogs kyi bdag po= yum chen pe ta= bka' sdod mgon po= ma bdun sring bzhi= klu mo mched bzhi'i= phyogs skyong mgon po= bskang ngo skal ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /skyung ka'i rgyal mtshan gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis= ljags kyi dbang po tshim byed phyir/

/bshos bu nag pos= rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir/ /dmar chen ar+ghas= rtag tu 'phrin las 'chol ba'i phyir/ / rgyun gyi gtor mas= thugs dam gnyan po bskangs pa yis/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum chen pe ta'i= bka' sdod mgon po'i= kang ka ta ra'i= rigs bzhi mgon po'i= ma bdun sring bzhi'i= klu mo mched bzhi'i= phyogs skyong mgon po'i= bdud kha dgra la bsgyur ba'i phyir/ /rgya gar nag po'i= dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugs pa'i phyir/ /lcags spyang sngon po'i= dmag dpon ru mtshon 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /yang sprul 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*/ / bskang ngo skal ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /do nub lha la 'khon spangs pa/ /nyes pa mchis na khyed la bshags /phyin chad nyes pa mi bgyid do/ khyod kyang ring du ma mdzad cig /bdag gis tshor ba ma nongs kyang*/ /bdud kyi thugs nur srid pas su/ /bskang ngo bshags so byas lags so/ /thugs dam bskang ba de lags so/ /sgrub la bar chad gyur pa dang*/ /dam rdzas tshang bar ma bsogs dang*/ /thugs dam dus su ma bskongs dang*/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig 'chol ba rnams/ /do nub bskang zhing bshags par bgyi/ khyed kyang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /skul na rings ba'i las 'di mdzod/ /nga yang dam las mi 'da' ste/ khyod kyang rtag tu bsgrub cing mchod/ /'o skol gnyis kyi dam bca' 'di/ /srog la bab kyang gzhung bsrang 'tshal/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra byung na/ /pha khur 'dug kyang sod la shog khyed la mchod pa'i dam rdzas 'di/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na 'dug kyang rung*/ /ci la'ang bsdos nas thugs dam bskang*/ /je nye je gdung gnyis kas bgyi'o/ /kye/ grogs la gzhung med mi srid kyi/ /rnal 'byor dam med mi srid kyi/ /chad 'di m-i 'grub mi srid kyi/ /mgu ba'i zas shig nges kyang 'dren/ /zas kyi ngo yang khyed kyis gyis/ /chad pa'i gzhung 'di nga yang srong*/ / smras pa'i tshig 'di khyed kyang nyon/

/bskul ba'i gnyer 'di nga la yod/ /bcol ba'i las 'di khyod kyis gyis/ /gnyis ka chad pa'i gzhung bsrang 'tshal/ / gnyis ka las kyi gnyer bskul 'tshal/ /smra'o chad do thugs dam can/ /gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs/ /sod cing chod cig dgra dang bgegs/ /ltos so gnyer ro thugs dam can/ khyed dang rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis/ /bskal pa zhig kyang mi 'bral lo/ /ltems se rgyangs se ma mdzad par/ /brtse gdung sems la ce cher mdzod/ /mthu stobs ci yod lta yang lta/ /sku shugs phyung la las 'di mdzod/ /rnal 'byor gnyen po'i srung ma mdzod/ /nor rnams bsrung ba'i srung ma mdzod/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskangs ba yis/ /lha dang mi 'bral grib ltar 'grogs/ /zas dag phud kyis khyed mchod do/ /rtag tu drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ gnyis pa ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo ni/ /gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol/ /sring gcig lha mo dgongs su gsol/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /nad dang rims kyi bdag mo khyod/ /thugs dam bskang phyir gshegs su gsol/ /nyams chags gso yis gnas 'dir spyon/ /bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang*// bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhis thugs dam bskang*// brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir*/ /mi dbang snying gis= rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs phyir/ /mi rkang gling bus= dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ / bdud rtsi sman gyis= 'dod pa'i gtso mo yin pa'i phyir/ /rma bya'i rgyal mtshan gyis= shangs kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir/ /sha chen dud pas= mgur gyi gsang nas drangs ba'i phyir/ /dmar chen rak+tas= nyams chags ma lus bskang ba'i phyir/ /bya lug smug nag gis= nag mo 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dkar mo 'bum sde'i= ser mo 'bum sde'i= dmar po 'bum sde'i= mthing nag 'bum sde'i= ljang mo 'bum sde'i=

smug mo 'bum sde'i= mon mo nag mo'i= 'dod khams brtan ma'i= khyed kyang dam las ma 'da' cig /da yang dam las mi 'da' 'o/ /thugs dam gnyan po 'dis skongs nas/ /nyams chags mchis pa bzod par gsol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /'phrin las drag shul ma chung cig /bcom ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / bco lnga pa bstod pa ni/ gtor chog ltar ram/ yang na/ 'od phung bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /smin gnyis 'khrigs pa'i khro gnyer bzhad pa'i zhal/ /rab bzhad 'dzum dang mche ba gtsigs pa po/ /ye shes spyan gsum nyi zla shar ba'i 'od/ /ston pa bla med chos rje'i bka' bzhin du/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i rgyud rnams srung mdzad cing*/ /klu yi cod pan brjid pas 'gyings pa ni/ /nges par che btsan rgyal po'i bdag po lags/ /dgon pa'i nags 'dabs dur khrod chen po na/ /rab 'jigs ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor zhing*/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong nyi zla'i rgyan thogs pa/ khyod ni rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyug yin/ / nad gtong gshin rje'i tshogs rnams kun bcom ste/ /mdangs 'phrog srin po kun kyang phyag 'tshal bstod/ /log 'drain bgegs rnams shin tu 'dul mdzad pa/ /seng ge glang chen pags pa gos su gyon/ /lha yul grong khyer nags 'dabs thams cad du/ /lha dmag dkar po 'bum gyi dbugs 'byin pa/ /nyon mongs g.yul las lha chen rgyal ba'i rtags/ kha ṭ+wāṃ mi mgos rgyan pa phyag na bsnams/ /ban+dha thod pa snying bcas snying zhags can/ /dug sdong ha la 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ /thod pa'i khar 'jog spyan snga brtson pa yis/ /gnod sbyin gzi brjid mdangs kun 'phrog par mdzad/ /zhe sdang ro langs rnam par 'joms mdzad cing*/ /lha min bdud dpung g.yul gyi mtshams bcad nas/ /log 'dren srin po mtha' yas dgra gnon pa/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /lha yi lha khyod me lha tshogs bdag sogs/

/drag po la sogs lha chen kun gyis mchod/ /phyogs rnams kun dang gzhan du rnam par grags/ /smon lam khyad par mang pos thugs sbyangs nas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam pa cir yang ston/ / phan mdzad sman sdong ljon pa khyod drung du/ /sdug bsngal tsha bas gdungs pa bdag la sogs/ /mgon dang gnyen 'tshal skyabs su byon nas kyang*/ /'jigs med rgya chen dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bh+yoḥ khams gsum dbang sdud nag mo re ma tī/ /sman mo brjid pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /skye 'gro sgrol mdzad yum chen kun gyi ngang*/ /nag mo gtso mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul/ /stong gsum dbang sdud bh+yoḥyi sgra sgrog ma/ /lcags kyi ral pa mang po sprul par spro/ /leb gan nad kyi mtshon sprin sku la gsol/ /dgra 'dul g.yul zlog ma la bstod par bgyi/ / dus bzhi dbang byed nam zla'i stangs 'dzin ma/ /za byed srog la rol pa'i mche ba can/ /sems can rgyal mo bzhi zhon 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nam zla'i dbang byed ma khyod gus pas bstod/ /rang bzhin dbyings las sprul pa dpag med ston/ /srid gsum bdag mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'dir spyon rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ming pos bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / bcu drug pa bshags pa chen po ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /bram ze mchog sred mkha' 'gro bde ster ma/ /bā ling a tsar gnyos lo yon tan grags/ /rdo rje bla ma dpal seng grags pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas ras chen rin chen dbang rgyal dang*/ /mkhan chen byang dar 'jam dbyangs gzi brjid rgyal/ / gnyan ston kun rin mtshungs med nam mkha' dpal/ /'khrul zhig kun rin 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i mtshan/ /bsod nams grub rgyal grags pa 'od zer dang*/ /grags pa dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa rje/ /thugs sras rnam gsum rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/

/byang chub dar dang bsod nams rgyal po dang*/ /kun mkhyen saṃ gha grub chen blo gros brtan/ /yon tan rgya mtsho yon tan snying po dang*/ /bsod nams rin chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan la sogs pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag mi shes ma gus bag med dang*/ /nyon mongs dbang gis rtsa ba yan lag dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'gal 'khrul sogs/ /thams cad chos dbyings ngang du mthol lo bshags/ /rang bzhin stong nyid ngang du rnam dag ste/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun 'grub par/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*/ / bshags pa mchog 'dis sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /hūṃ/ dam la 'bod cing dam tshig bshags/ /mgon po nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā kā la srog gi bdud/ /bar snang khams na rgyu ba na/ /dbang bskur ming btags dam tshig byin/ /nag po dbang byed ces kyang btags/ /tshogs bdag chen por bskos pa ste/ /mahā kā la mthu bo che/ /chags byed rdo rje'i phreng ba can /lha mo nag mo mthu che dang*/ / bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag gis bsten zhing mchod pa las/ /gzhung dang 'gal ba bzod par gsol/ /rgyu chung phud nyams 'byor pa chung ba bshags/ /sgom sgrub mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba= bzlas brjod zur chag ting 'dzin g.yel ba= sgo gsum rgyus 'tsho le lor shor ba= 'dzin chags ser sna'i dbang gyur 'khrul ba= dgon pa nags 'dabs dur khrod chen po ru/ /sngon chad ji ltar bskang ba ma grub mthol lo bshags/ /rdzas dang mchod pa tshul bzhin ma bshams dang*/ /lha dang bla mar ma gus yid gnyis sogs/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'gal 'khrul kun/ khyed thugs chos dbyings ngang du bzod par gsol/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/

/sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig 'gal ba ma lus so sor bshags/ /mthol bshags phul nas tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ / bcu bdun pa drag po'i las la bskul ba ni/ dang po mgon po'i bskul bya ste/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs srog bdud ma rungs pa/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa ste/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud po legs ldan mthu rtsal can/ /byang shar mtshams na bzhugs pa ni/ /thod pa 'bar ba'i sku mkhar te /zhe sdang bdud kyi rgyal po'i mkhar/ /logs gcig mi yi thod pas brtsigs/ /logs gcig rta yi thod pas brtsigs/ /logs gcig spre'u'i thod pas brtsigs/ /logs gcig lug gi thod pas brtsigs/ /rin chen gser gyi sgo btsugs te/ /mthing zangs g.yu yi skas kyang btsugs/ /zur bzhi rin chen lcags las byas/ /zangs lcags sgo la khrag gi bang*/ /mi ro rta ro bcal du bkram/ /mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil/ /mi lpags rta lpags yol bas bres// mi rta'i bsur chen thul lu lu/ /mi thod gad mo yal la la/ /rta thod rta skad tse re re/ /mi rkang gling bu congs se cong*/ /sku mkhar de yi nang shed na/ /bdud kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa ni/ /rngam pa'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /sku la dar nag ral ka gsol/ /phyag g.yas dug sdong bdud zhags bsnams/ /dgra bo'i snying dang ske la 'debs/ /g.yon pa dam nyams thod snying dang*/ /bdud kyi khram bam nag po 'dzin/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzis/ /sprul dang nyi zla thod pas brgyan/ / spyan zlog ljags 'gril mche ba gtsigs/ /zhal nas me 'bar lhabs se lhab// shangs nas drag po'i rlung nag 'tshub/ /bra nag rting dkar chibs su chibs/ /lha mo gnyan dang gnyis med rol/ /gser ska rin chen sked la bcings/ /sag ti yu ring zhabs la gsol/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /dug gi ngag skyugs dgra la gtong*/ /tshe dang srog la mnga' mdzad pa/

/rgyu ma mi mgo'i do shal can/ /dam tshig can gyi gdong grogs mdzod/ /dam nyams kun gyi rtsa rgyud chod/ /mna' zan kun gyi srog dbugs len/ /srog bdud chen po ma rungs pa// lan 'ga' drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /srin po'i dmag tshogs nyer re re/ /yun gyi mgon du khyod brten na/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs te/ /yid la re ba skong ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ / de nas dpal lha mo skul ba ni/ hūṃ lha mo gnyan dang gnyis med pa'i/ /byang shar mtshams kyi dpal lha mo/ /'dod khams kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ /nad kyi bdag la rims kyi rkyen/ / bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /rgya mtsho'i klong na me 'bar ma/ /mtsho rnams skem par nus ma ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir/ /lha chen sku la 'tshim par bzhugs/ mahā kā la'i sku la 'khril/ bka' blon chen mo dgra 'dul ma/ / mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bdag mo ste/ /ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo khyod/ /sha za 'bum gyi bdag mo lags/ /gling bzhi 'bum gyi sha za mo/ /srin mo 'bum gyi khrag 'thung ma/ /sems can 'bum gyi srog gcod ma/ /dam nyams kun gyi bshan pa ste/ /mna' zan rnams kyi gshed ma lags/ /sdig can rnams kyi srog gcod ma/ /zas su sha dang khrag la dga'/ /las su gsod dang gcod la mkhas/ /bang ni glog gis bskyod du med/ lag na nad kyi rkyal pa thogs/ /lan 'ga' drag tu bskul ba na/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i sna la 'gro/ /zas su mi sha rta sha za/ /skom du mi khrag rta khrag 'thung*/ khyod kyi longs spyod der bskos so/ /dgra bo'i srog chod snying rtsa gtubs/ / sngags 'chang bdag gis phul ba yi/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang*/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bo'i rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod/ /bcol ba'i las rnams mthu ma chung*/ / de nas 'khor mon mo rnams bskul te/ bh+yoḥ

lha chen mahā kā la dang*/ /lha mo nyid kyis byin brlabs las/ /bka' nyan mon mo nag mo bdun/ /dgra srog cham la dbab pa'i dus la bab/ / mon mo nag mo rkang 'cha' ma/ /dgra rkang za ba'i mthu mo che/ /yan lag 'cha' ba'i dus la bab/ / sgrol cig myur du dgra dpung chom/ /mon mo nag mo sha za ma/ /maṃ sa za ba'i mthu mo che/ /dgra sha za ba'i dus la bab/ /sgrol cig myur du dgra sha gtubs/ /mon mo nag mo khrag 'thung ma/ /mi khrag 'thung ba'i mthu mo che/ /snying khrag 'thung ba'i dus la bab/ sgrol cig myur du dgra khrag 'thung*/ mon mo nag mo snying 'byin ma/ dgra snying 'byin pa'i mthu mo che/ tsit+ta slob pa'i dus la bab/ /sgrol cig myur du dgra snying thon/ /mon mo nag mo dbugs 'phrog ma/ /srog dbugs 'phrog pa'i mthu mo che/ /lus srog 'phrol ba'i dus la bab/ / sgrol cig myur du srog dbugs phrol/ /mon mo nag mo bla len ma/ /tshe srog phrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /dgra chos 'gugs pa'i dus la bab/ /sgrol cig myur du bla tshe phrol/ /mon mo nag mo srog gcod ma/ /srog rtsa gcod pa'i mthu mo che/ /dgra srog gcod pa'i dus la bab/ /sgrol cig myur du dgra srog chod/ /brda ni mi 'phrod lho bal mon/ /mon chas mang po wa la la/ /mon mo rna cha wangs se wang*//

mon mo sgra 'gag di ri ri/ /dri ni mon dugs chil li li/ /bcol ba'i las rnams rtags phyung shig / de nas sprul pa khyi mo bdun skul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ khyi mo nag mo gser mig ma/ /mkha' la rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ myur du rgyug la bla tshe khug/myos su chug la dgra snying phyung*/ khyi mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ /bar snang rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshe phrol/ /lha rnams sku la bog tu chug khyi mo nag mo mchong mig ma/ /sa la rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshe sbos/ /klu rnams sku la grug ltar sgongs/ khyi mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ /dur khrod rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshe zung*/ /srog gshed skul la gsod du chug khyi mo nag mo dung mig ma/ / rtsibs la rgyug pa'i mthu mo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshe chings/ /snang srid skul la dbang po sdoms/ khyi mo nag mo mkhar mig ma//chu la rgyug pa'i mthu mo che/ myur du rgyug la bla tshe gzir/ /chu srin skul la sub tu chug khyi mo nag mo lcags mig ma/ /rlung la rgyug pa'i rtsal mo che/ /myur du rgyug la bla tshe sgrol/ /snying phyung srog chod dbugs kyang phrol/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod/ /sa'i lte phur 'og nas thon/ /zhe sdang tshang ba'i don snying phyung*/ / dkon pa'i tshe srog gnyis dang phrol/ /lha chen yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ / dgra bo'i bdun brgyud rtsad nas chos/ /bcol ba'i las rnams mthu ma chung*/ / de nas mon po rnams skul ba ni/ hūṃ gzhan yang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /mon pa nag po rdzu 'phrul can/ /byi la zhon nas dur khrod nyul/ /zhal nas me 'bar dgra snying sreg/spyan nas khrag 'dzag zul lu lu/ /phyag na dung gi be con bsnams/ /lha bdud mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po sbrul la zhon/ /phyag na bdud kyi be con bsnams/ dam nyams dgra bo rdul du bzlog

/zhal nas me 'bar snying la rngub/ /mig ni gser mig lams se lams/ /klu bdud mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po khyung la zhon/ /phyag g.yas dug gi spu gri bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /zhal nas me 'bar rgya mtsho skem/ /spyan nas khrag 'bab zul lu lu/ /gang la dmigs pa rdul du bzlog /bdud kyi mon pa'i dus la bab/ / mon pa nag po 'brug la zhon/ /phyag g.yas ral gri glog ltar 'debs/ /dam nyams srog rtsa gting nas len/ /'brug sgra shangs nas thog 'beb shing*/ khrag dang ser ba'i mchi ma 'bab/ /gang la dmigs pa rdul du bzlog /gnod sbyin mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po rlung la zhon/ / lcags mda' dgra bgegs snying la gzer/ /zhal nas mi khrag rta khrag 'dzag /mig ni nyi zla'i zer bas 'tsher/ /gang la dmigs pa rdul du brlog/gshin rje mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po stag la zhon/ /ral gri 'debs shing nags tshal rgyu/ /zhal nas nad kyi rlangs pa gtong*/ khrag gi mchi ma sha ra ra/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /srin po mon pa'i dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po rta nag zhon/ /phyag na tsan dan bing chen bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la brtson/ /sdig can 'dul ba'i mthu bo che/ /mgon po mon pa'i dus la bab/ / yang na mon mo bdun la skul 'di ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ bh+yoḥ shel mig mthing gi lan phran can/ /gser gyi dra ba wangs se wang*/ khrag gi be con tserare re/ /phyag na dung gi phur pa sgril/ /lha bdud mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo gser mig ma/ /gnas ni srid pa gsum na gnas/ /dgongs pa bar snang khams la mdzad/ /bzhugs ni rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs/ /dbu la cod pan mthing nag bcings/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje nad rkyal g.yon/ /klu bdud mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ sbrul nag ral pa shigs se shig /lcags kyi rna cha khral la la/ /phyag na gser gyi phur pa sgril/

/bdud kyi mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra/ / bse yi snyan cha khra la la/ /phyag na bse yi phur pa sgril/ /gnod sbyin mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo dung mig ma/ khrag gi ral pa shar ra ra/ /byi ru'i rna cha khral la la/ /phyag na byi ru'i phur pa sgril/ /gshin rje mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo'i nag mo bse mig ma/ /zangs kyi lan phran sha ra ra/ /zangs kyi rna cha khral la la/ /phyag na zangs kyi phur pa sgril/ /srin mo mon mo'i dus la bab/ /mon mo nag mo khrag mig ma/ /mthing gi lan phran shar ra ra/ /mchong gi cod pan khra la la/ khrag gi rba rlabs chil li li/ /nad kyi kha rlangs thul lu lu/ /phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /re ma tī yi dus la bab/ /hūṃ bh+yoḥ trag shad yab yum drag shul can/ /lha srin kun gyi rgyal po ste/ /mon pa pho mo khyed rnams kyang*/ /dbu skra gyen brdzes thod pas brgyan/ /zhal gdang spyan bzlog mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i zhal nas 'jigs sgra sgrog /sku la dar nag mi lpags gsol/ /me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong dkyil nas/ /phyag mtshan mtshon chas dgra bgegs 'dul/ /bstan pa gnyan srung mthu bo che/ /sngon gyi dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul sogs kyang bya'o/ /bsdu na gtso bo yab yum la bstod pa las gzhan pa'i skul mi dgos/ dus la bab zhes pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod ces pa'am/ thugs dam bskang zhes par 'don pa spo ba'i srol yang yod la/ yang na 'khor la gtor chog tu bshad pa de tsam gyis kyang chog go /bco brgyad pa mnga' gsol ba ni/ hūṃ dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas chen 'dir/ /mgon po yab yum mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dam rdzas gtor mi ri ltar spungs/ /sman rag bdud rtsi rgya mtshor bskyil/ /sna tshogs rol mo 'brug ltar ldir/

/rgya spos gsur chen dri ngad ldan/ /zhun chen mar me skar ltar bkram// dar nag ru mtshon ba dan 'phyar/ /dam rdzas snying sna rdza ltar lhags/ /sha rus mang po ri ltar spungs/ /bya nag mang po phur zhing lding*/ /mi nag ging po rngam pa'i gzugs/ /rta nag rting dkar rlung ltar 'phyo/ /g.yag nag zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs/ /lug nag lcags ru rgyan dang ldan/ khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar nyer/ /tsa ra rog po brjid pa dang*/ /gcan gzan mang po 'dur zhing rgyug / 'dod yon sprin ltar gtibs pa 'dis/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po mnga' gsol lo/ /mahā kā la= legs ldan nag po= lha chen dpal 'bar= srog bdud chen po= nag po chen po= bshan pa chen po= lings pa chen po= bdud rgyal thod phreng = traka shad nag po= rnal 'byor dgra lha= dam nyams srog gcod= dpal ldan lha mo= 'dod khams gtso mo= bdud kyi yum gcig= gshin rje'i lcam gcig= mon pa pho bdun= mon pa mo bdun= phyag brnyan sprul pa= pho nya las mkhan= bdud dmag bye ba= bdud mgon 'khor bcas= chos skyong 'khor bcas mnga' gsol lo/ /de ltar gsol ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par spel/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo sgrol// rnal 'byor bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / ces bskang rdzas mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /de rjes mdos kyi bskang ba rgyas bsdus gang byed 'dod kyang bya ste/ logs su shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la lnga las/ dang po dngos grub blang ba ni/ thun mong ma yin khyad par che bas na/ rdo rje khrag 'thung thugs kyi dpal be'u nas/ /bdud 'dul mthu chen nag po chen po'i sku/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gzi brjid 'od 'phro bas/ /skal ldan bdag la dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ /rab rgyas sprul pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/

/dpal chen khrag 'thung mahā kā lar bcas/ /'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga tshang lags kyi/ /mgon po thugs rjes byon pa na/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gso ba yis/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral slad du/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /skya rengs dang po shar ba dang*/ /ri rab rtse la gdugs dar tshe/ /sgrub po gtor ma der gtong na/ /da lta dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ khro rgyal thugs kyi dngos grub= khro rgyal gsung gi= khro rgyal sku yi= sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje'i tshe mchog dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /pho nya rkang mgyogs dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mthu dang grags pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yid bzhin lhun grub dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa gtor ma gtong ba ni/ de nas gtor ma gtor stegs sam/ khang steng du khyer la/ spyi btab rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas 'bul/ mdos 'bul na'ang skabs 'dir 'bul dgos so/ /bstan skyong rgyas bsdus gang rung re byed pa phyag len du gnang zhing*/ ma byas na'ang cho ga chad pa'i skyon med mod kyi/ bod kyi phyogs 'dir sgrub pa po'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa sogs kyi phyir 'grub na shin tu legs pa yin no/ /de nas bde legs su byed pa'i 'phrin bcol gang 'os shig bya la/ phyis kyi lag len la ni/ gzhan gyi lag len dang bstun te/ srid bzhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog / ces pa 'di byed kyin snang ngo*/

/skabs 'dir gtor mnan la sogs pa byed pa'ang long skabs dang bstun nas byas kyang legs mod/ nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni/ nang du yi dam la mchod bstod bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa tshe chog ni/ hūṃ/ phyogs bcu rnams nas tshe 'gugs pa/ /dpal chen khrag mthung yab yum dang*/ /rdo rje ma hā kā la'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas kun gyi mthu stobs kyis/ /tshangs pa'i gnas nas tshe khug cig /ri rab rtse nas tshe khug cig /phyag mtshan gri gug la sogs pas/ /steng gi 'jig rten khams drol la// bgegs kyi lag nas tshe drongs shig /tshe rten 'di la tshe stims shig /phyag mtshan rtse gsum la sogs pas/ /'og gi 'jig rten khams drol la/ /bgegs kyi lag nas tshe drongs shig /tshe rten 'di la tshe stims shig /phyag mtshan beng chen la sogs pas/ /phyogs mtshams 'jig rten khams drol la/ /bgegs kyi lag nas tshe drongs shig /tshe rten 'di la tshe stims shig / ces brjod nas/ yi dam chos skyong gi sngags kyi mthar tshe sgrub kyi sngags gsham bur btags la ci rigs par bzla'o/ /lnga pa rjes bsdu shis brjod dang bcas pa ni/ de nas yi ge brgya pa bzla pa dang*/ bzod par gsol ba lan mang du byas la/ rten rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/ mgron rnams gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ bdag bsrung ba rnams byas pa'i mthar smon lam dngabakra shis ci 'grub tu bya'o/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dngos/ /'phrin las mgon por sku sprul pa/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod pa'i cho ga mdo tsam ste/ /'di sgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /bsod nams cung zad gang bsags pa/ /de las byang chub myur 'grub nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis don byed shog / dpal ye shes kyi mgon po trak+shad mchod pa'i cho ga las bzhi rnam par rol ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang rtog dang sbyar ba'i tshig legs legs su bsgrigs pa dag spangs te/

rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi gsung la bcos bslad ma byas par/ yig rnying yi ge mang ba dang*/ 'thor ba'i tshul can du yod pa rnams 'dus shing go bde bar bsgrigs pa ste/ rang lo nyer dgu pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes bzang po la/ dpal bzang ldan gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ /sngags rnams las rgya skad du mngon pa rnams la tha snyad kyi gtsug lag dang mthun pa'i zhus dag byas na/ rig gnas sbyangs pa rnams kyi blo ngor 'phral du 'bab cing*/ legs legs 'dra ba yong ba 'dug na'ang*/ byin rlabs la gnod pa'i ltas mthong bas/ yig rnying mang po zhal mthun du yod pa'i zhus dag tsam las gzhan ma bcos pa lags so/ /maṅgalaṃ/ dar rgyas 'phel/ /zhus dag / ༄༅/ /legs ldan mahā kā la 'khor mang gi bstod pa 'phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ dpal legs ldan mahā kā la'i bstod pa 'phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha chen dpal 'bar mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// rgyal ba'i ye shes mkhyen pa thugs su chud/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ khams gsum 'jig rten kun khyab rtag pa'i gtso/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa srung*/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun la dbang sgyur ba/ /dge la spyod pa kun gyi steng 'dzin zhing*/ /dam tshig nyams pa kun gyi srog gcod mkhan/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug kun gyi bka' sdod de/ / gsang sngags chos rnams kun du skyong ba'i mgon/ /traka shad mahā kā la khyed la bstod/ /'jig rten mthun phyir mahā de ba'i sras/ /res 'ga' mi bzad dug gi nags su 'khrungs/ /phal cher 'jig rten dbang po'i thugs las sprul/ /gzhan du gsang ba'i bdag po'i las byed mchog /gzi brjid khro rgyal 'chol ba stobs po che/ /gshin rje gshed po'i gcan pa 'jigs gzugs can/

/rtag par ma mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig rol/ /bdud 'joms drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas stong dang lhan cig thugs bskyed pa/ khyed ni 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal po yis/ /bstan srung kun gyi rgyal por mnga' gsol mdzad// sdig can yongs kyi gshed ma dpa' bo khyed/ /ma rungs kun la srog gcod mthar byed nyid/ /chos gzhi kun gyi srung ma mel tshe mkhan/ /chos bzhin spyod pa kun gyi dgra lha'i rgyal/ /srid pa'i byed po khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /u tsa la yi dur khrod chen po ni/ /mi dang 'byung po'i bam chen ri ltar spungs/ /rus pa'i gram khrod du mas phyogs kun khyab/ /zhag dang klad pa'i 'dam rdzab lteng ka 'khyil/ khrag rgyun dron mo'i chu klung brgya phrag 'bab/ /mi bsrun bya dang gcan gzan tshogs kun rgyu/ /sha za srin po bro brdung glu gar byed/ /drag po'i zhing mchog de la'ang bstod par bgyi/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal med khang*/ /de dbus thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub ma'i nang*/ /'degs byed glang chen seng ge bya khyung can/ /gser gyi khri mchog pad+ma nyi zlas spras/ /bstan dgra bsgral ba'i mi ro rta ro 'bum/ /dud sprin 'thul zhing me stag 'phro ba yi/ /dug gi me tog bcas par bkram pa'i gzhi/ /ye shes las sprul gnas mchog de la 'dud/ /gru gsum mthing nag brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal chen mgon nag srin po khros pa'i tshul/ /shwa na'i zhal gyis 'gal byed bla tshe rngub/ /

dug sdong 'bar bas stong khams khyab par bsregs/ /bdud zhags nag pos log 'dren khrag khrig 'ching*/ /ngan sems can kun bdud kyi khram la 'debs// dgra snying phung po thod par blug ste gsol/ /phyag bzhis bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che/ /rab khros gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdang mig nyin byed bye ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /mche gtsigs ston zla 'bum gyi 'od dkar 'gyed/ /glog dmar grangs med 'gyu ba lta bu'i ljags/ /bskal pa'i me mtshungs sma ra smin ma ser/ /ral pa bskyod pas sa gsum mun par 'jug / goms stabs shugs kyis rtsom chen rlung yang bsgul/ /shugs drag phyag gis stong gsum skad cig nyul/ /nag po gzi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gad rgyangs gcig gis ri dbang stong phrag sgyel/ /lhab lhub na bza' g.yo bas mkha' dbyings 'gengs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyi snang bas zhing kun khyab/ /lta zer 'bar bas lha min grong khyer bsregs/ /snyan nas glog 'gyu 'brug stong dus gcig ldir/ /sha khrag rus pa'i ri bo zhal du 'debs/ /shangs kyi khong nas dus mtha'i rlung yang ldang*/ /srid gsum byed po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshangs dang dbang pos mdun nas gus pas bsu/ /gshin rje srin po bka' nyan las la 'gyed/ /gdong drug tshogs bdag lha dmag skul mar gtong*/ /gza' dang gnod sbyin thams cad phyi yi bran/ /klu dang gsang ba pa rnams nang gi 'bangs// rlung dang sreg za'i lha yis logs nas bstod/ /lha yi lha mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdzu 'phrul rta nag chibs nas phyogs kun gnon/ /seng ge chibs nas pha rol g.yul ngo zlog /'phrul gyi bya khra gter bdag tshogs rnams kun/ /sngon du rgyu zhing snga dgra dar ba 'joms/ /gsod byed gshin rje rngam pa gcan gzan tshul/ /phyi bzhin 'brangs nas phyi'i dgra rdul du rlog /ru mtshon thogs te lha rnams dbugs kyang 'byin/ /sde brgyad dmag dpon chen por phyag 'tshal bstod/

/bdud 'dul tsan dan bang chen thogs pa'i tshe/ /dmag tshogs mkha' dbyings khyab pa'i sprul pa ston/ /bdud rgyal nyi khri chig stong sku las sprul/ /bye ba dung phyur bdud dmag lings la 'gyed/ /g.yas nas lha dmag dkar po 'bum sde 'phyo/ /gdug rtsub gcer bu 'bum sde g.yon nas rgyug / srin po'i dmag tshogs grangs med bka' la sdod/ /gzi byin mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i sde brgyad ma lus las la 'khol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa khyod kyis sgrub/ khyod sku dran pa tsam gyis dgra tshogs stongs/ /mtshan smos tsam na bgegs kun phyogs bcur 'bros/ khyod la dad gus skad ca/ིga gcig bskyed pas/ /nad med tshe ring 'byor ba thams cad 'byung*/ snying po bzlas pa tsam gyis sgrib kun sel/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gnas mchog 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i khang bzang na/ / lha rdzas 'dod yon kun la dges rgur rol/ /mi bzad 'jigs chen dur khrod brgyad po ru/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba kun gyi sde dpon tshul/ /o rgyan la sogs nyer bzhi'i yul chen du/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyi dbang*/ /'phags mchog khyod ni rdo rje theg pa 'dir/ /rgyud kun bdag por gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpa' bo che khyod res 'ga' sa steng rgyu/ /dug dang me dpung mtshon cha'i char sprin 'khrug /nag phyogs 'dre kun dwangs shing snying khrag skyug /ngan sems can gyi mi rnams srog rtsa 'chad/ /lan 'ga' bar snang mkha' la gshegs tsa na/ /nyi zla gza' skar tshogs kyis me tog 'thor/ /bdud rnams skrag cing myos la klad pa 'gems/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dus gzhan dag tu sa 'og 'jig rten rgyu/ /ri rab dang bcas sa gzhir 'dar zhing bskyod/ /rgya mtsho bdun yang 'ar 'ur chal chil 'khrugs/ /'bum phrag grub pa'i sde rnams gar yang bsgyur/ khrag khrig bcu gnyis gdengs can bu mo yis/

/glu dbyangs stong dang rol mo bye bas mchod/ /mtha' dag lha min dbang pos thal mo sbyor/ /mchod 'os mthu ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mgon khyod 'dzam bu'i gling du rtag bzhugs tshe/ /gtsug lag khang rnams g.yel med bsrung ba dang*/ /dge 'dun thams cad chos bzhin spyod du 'jug /sangs rgyas bstan la sangs rgyas nyid dang mtshungs/ /bdud dang bgegs dang lha min gnod pa bzlog khyod la mchod cing khyod kyis bskyangs pa na/ /chos spyod bcu po yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas/ /bar chad kun sel chos srung khyod la 'dud/ /ma rungs gdug can 'dul bar mdzad tsa na/ /mi snying rdza ltar brnyil ba khyod kyi zas/ khrag chen bshwa' rgal rgyug pa skom du 'thung*/ /me 'od 'khrugs pa khyod ni dur khrod du/ /ro langs chen po rnams dang sgyu rtsal rtse/ /rnal 'byor can la nyams kyi drod tshad nyul/ /dam tshig can la 'bral med gdong grogs mdzad/ /sngags rig dgra lha khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sgrub po mchog la rig 'dzin dngos grub stsol/ /ri lu mig sman dngul chu gnod sbyin mo/ /ral gri rkang mgyogs gter chen kha cig la'o/ /skal ba shin du chung yang zhi sogs las/ /thogs med rtsol khyod dngos grub kun gyi bdag /ma sgrubs bar yang dbang thang phun tshogs thob/ /bsad bskrad dbye bas dgra 'joms nus par 'gyur/ /mthu rtsal 'gran zla med pa khyod la bstod/ /'di na 'jig rten dbang bsgyur de kun gyi/ /mgo la khyod kyi zhabs pad rdul phreng g.yogs/ khyod mthong tsam gyis gshin rje'i pho nya byer/ / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams sa gsum thams cad du/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i rnga chen brdungs/ /lha mchog legs ldan mahā kā la de/ /drag shul can khyod rtag tu bdag bsten no/ /dngos po kun gyis mchod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal gyi thugs la dgyes bde bskyed byed yum/ /'phrin las kun sgrub dpal ldan re ma tī/

/sgrub po dam ldan ma yis bu bzhin skyong*/ khams gsum dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon gcod 'phrin las sgrub la thags thogs med/ /ri rab yud kyis bskor zhing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /'gro ba drug gi srog la mnga' mdzad ma/ /las byed khyi gdong bdun la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cho 'phrul mtha' yas ston byed mig sgyur ma/ /nad kyi bdag mo dgra bo'i sha la rngam/ / bar chad log 'dren bgegs kyi khrag la rol/ /dur khro ma mo bdun la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rab gtum pho nya mon pa nag po'i tshul/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso bo dmag dpon bdun/ /bstan la 'gal byed ming gi lhag mar 'jog /rdo rje bshan pa'i tshogs la bstod par bgyi/ /mtho ris sa steng sa 'og srid gsum la/ /dbang byed drag gtum zil gnon seng ge'i gdong*/ /sdang ba'i dgra la gnam lcags thogs ltar rgyug /gsang ba'i las mkhan gsum la bstod par bgyi/ /dngos su bshams dang yid byung mchod pa 'bul/ /bden stobs las byung mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mtha' dag 'bul/ /legs ldan dgyes pa'i rten rdzas dpag yas 'bul/ /rgya chen phyogs grol khyab pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rang bzhin ye shes chen po'i ngo bor 'bul/ /rnam 'gyur 'dod yon bsam mi khyab par 'bul/ /nyams myongs lhan skyes bde ba chen por 'bul/ /bdag dang rgyud lngar 'khor ba'i 'gro rnams kyi// nyes byas gang yin chos dbyings ngang du bshags/ khyad par dam tshig 'gal 'khrul gyur pa kun/ khyed thugs snying rje'i klong du bzod par gsol/ /dpal mchog mgon po lcam dral khyed nyid la/ /las 'brel 'jog pa'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'dir bzhugs la/ /bla med dam chos bdud rtsi'i char chen phob/ /dge 'dis dpal chen khrag 'thung legs ldan che/ khyed bzhin bdag kyang dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par sgrub pa dang*/

/gang la gang 'dul 'gro don nus par shog/// ces pa legs ldan mahā kā la 'khor mang gi bstod pa 'phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po kun dga' rab bstan dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung gis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /legs ldan nag po trak+shad kyi bstod pa bzhugs/ oṃ swa stī/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin shugs drag rngam pa'i sku/ /gnas tshul bde chen rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /gdug can dgra la nad mtshon me char 'bebs/ /legs ldan nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bgegs kun 'joms/ /gsang sngags rang sgras sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ / rgyob sod skad kyis bdud sde'i snying khrag 'gems/ /trak+shad mgon po'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas spros bral mkha' ltar dag pa la/ /kun khyab byams dang snying rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /gdug la khro tshul dbang po'i gzhu ltar shar/ /mahā kā la'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug rtsub khro dang chags pa'i tshul 'chang zhing*/ /gsod gcod tshig rtsub 'phrog sogs rnam cha kun/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu tshul khrims rnam dag dang*/ khyod kyi yon tan tshul la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gnod pa kun sel 'dod pa'i don kun stsol/ khams gsum dbang bsdud gnod byed thal bar rlog /gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i 'jug pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub mdzad khyod la bstod/ /gnyis med sbyor yum dpal gyi re ma tī/ /mkha' 'gro khyi bdun rjes 'brangs grogs mo'i tshul/ /mon pa pho mo gshin rje gnod sbyin sogs/ /nang gi phyag brnyan pho nya rnams la 'dud/ /mtha' yas snang srid lha srin dregs pa can/ /bka' 'khor thams cad bstan dgra 'dul la dpa'/ /sgrub la bkra shis dge legs stsol bar mdzad/ / dpal gyi bka' sdod kun la bstod pa 'bul/ /bdag gis bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /sngon gyis las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/

/bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang rgyas par mdzod/ /shākya seng ge'i dgongs don dar ba dang*/ /'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i las nus can/ /rang gzhan thams cad bde dang thar pa dang*/ /rtag tu 'god pa'i mthu stobs ldan par shog / ces pa'ang sa skyong kun dga' rab brtan gyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /dpal mgon trak+shad kyi 'phrin las bskang gso sogs nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ skad cig gis ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ thun rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ/ trak+shad mahā kā la dang*/ / yum gcig lha mo ma pham ma/ /'khor gyi dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /de ring srid pa'i mdos la byon/ /srid gsum rab 'byams 'jigs rten khams/ /stong gsal nam mkha' 'od kyi gzhi/ /rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ri mtsho gling bdun bkod pa 'dzes/ khyad par gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs ldan/ /ri rab rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin/ /lha dang mi yi bkod pa 'bar/ /shar phyogs dkar po shes las grub/ /dri za bye ba brgya yi rten/ /lho phyogs baiḍūr+ya las grub/ /gshin rje bye ba brgya yi rten/ /nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga 'bar/ /lto phye bye ba brgya yi rten/ /byang phyogs rin chen gser las grub/ /gnod sbyin bye ba brgya yi rten/ /sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa/ /lha gnas bkod pa bsam mi khyab/ /'og min gnas kyi byang shar dang*/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas rab mchog /ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs dang*/ /tshang tshing 'khrigs sogs dur khrod du/ /dpal chen lcam dral gzhal med khang*/ /rgyu ni rin chen bye ba 'bum/

/rmangs ni rdo rje pha lam la/ /thod pa sna tshogs brtsigs pa'i mkhar/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ /sna tshogs dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mthing nag zur gsum lcags ris bskor/ /mdung dang ral gri gshibs pas mdzes/ /ro dang ro langs bya gcan sogs/ /'jigs su rung ba'i bkod pa 'bar/ /bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /chos dbyings bden pa'i mthu stobs dang*/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin dang*/ /rten 'brel rdzas dang nus pa'i mthus/ /zag med phul byung rnam par bkod/ / ༈ hūṃ gling bzhi ri rab mdzes pa yang*/ /bye ba khrag khrig grangs med kyis// nag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig/ thugs dam gnyan skong bar chad gsol/ /thugs dam gnyan skong dngos grub stsol/ /thugs dam gnyan skong bsam pa sgrubs/ /thugs dam gnyan skong 'phrin las mdzod/ /gzhal med khang bzang bkod pa yang*/ /bye ba khrag khrig grangs med kyis/ /nag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan po = sogs/ 'di man kun la 'gre'o/ / shel nag rgyal mtshan 'bar ba yang*/ /bye ba= dar nag ba dan 'bar ba yang*/ /bye ba= gri gug ral gri la sogs kyang*/ /bye ba= rta nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= drel nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= rnga mong rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= 'brong chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ / bye ba= lug nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= khyi nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= stag chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= gzig chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= seng chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= dom nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= dred mong rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= spyang ki rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= bya khra rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ / bye ba= khyung chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= g.yu 'brug rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/

/bye ba= ma he rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= lto 'phye rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= bya rog rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang*/ /bye ba= ma hā gser gyi rus sbal yang = bye= mthing nag nam mkha' mdzes pa= bye= 'phan dar rgyal mtshan brjid pa= bye= lha bshos dkar zlum mdzes pa yang = bye= bshos phran dmar po zur gsum yang*/ /bye= gsang phyi zla gam mdzes pa yang*/ /bye= bdud bshos zur bzhi rtse rgyas yang*/ bye ba= bshos phran ting lor bcas pa yang*/ /bye ba= thod pa khrag gis bskang ba yang*/ /bye ba= sman sna sna tshogs ril bu yang*/ / bye ba= glud gzugs dbang po tshang ba yang*/ /bye ba= chang bu mtheb kyu bcas pa yang*/ /bye ba= zas sna bsam gyis mi khyab yang*/ /bye ba= dbang po rnam lnga bkram pa yang*/ /bye ba= don snying rnam lnga bkram pa yang*/ bye ba= yan lag lhu dum bkram pa yang*/ /bye ba= rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil pa yang*/ /bye ba= sha chen ri ltar spungs pa yang*/ /bye ba= keng rus gcal du bkram pa yang*/ /bye ba= zhing gi bla re ba dan yang*/ /bye ba= gsur chen sprin ltar gtibs pa yang*/ /bye ba= zhun chen sgron me sbar pa yang*/ /bye ba= bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa yang*/ /bye ba= rten rgyun thun gyi gtor ma yang*/ /bye ba= gzhan yang 'dod yon bsam mi khyab/ /bye ba khrag khrig grangs med kyis/ /nag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan po skongs gyur cig

/thugs dam gnyan skongs bar chad sel/ /thugs dam gnyan skong dngos grub rtsol/ / thugs dam gnyan skong bsam pa sgrubs/ /thugs dam gnyan skong 'phrin las mdzod/ / ༈ hūṃ drak+shad mahā kā la dang*/ /nag mo za byed be ta li/ /dgongs pa mnyam nyid chen po'i klong*/ /legs nyes bzang ngan rtags dang bral/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor gyi tshogs/ /rtag 'dzin tshar gcod rjes gzung gi /'phrin las las la brtson pa rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag la gsan zhing dgongs/ /bdag ni ma rig rmongs dbang gis/ /dam rdzas ma tshang mchod gtor g.yel/ /sgrub la mi brtson le los gzir/ /gsang ba gzhan la spel ba sogs/ khyed kyi thugs dang 'gal ba rnams/ /do nub mdos kyis dag par mdzod/ /lta ba nyams pa mdos kyis skong*/ /spyod pa nyams pa mdos kyis skong*/ /srid pa'i mdos kyis thams cad tshangs/ /mdos kyis ma tshang gcig kyang med/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor bcas pa yi/ /bcings pa khrol la bsdams pa klod/ /gzung pa thong la nyams pa gsos// mthun pa sgrubs la re ba skong*/ /'dod pa mtha' dag grub pa dang*/ /bla med bde chen thob par mdzod// // dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅga laṃ// ༈ hūṃ mon pa dkar po seng ge'i mgo /the rang rgyal po las la 'khol// bgegs kun 'joms pa'i cho 'phrul can/ /sku yi las byed dus la bab/ /mon pa dmar po seng ge'i mgo /rmu btsan sa bdag las la 'gyed/ /sri btsan 'dul ba'i drag shul can/ /gsung gi las byed dus la bab/ /mon pa nag po seng ge'i mgo /gshin rje gza' bdud las la 'khol/ /dgra kun gsod pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /thugs kyi las byed dus la bab// // bkra shis/ ༈ hūṃ lta ba mkha' ltar yangs pas mnga' gsol lo/ /spyod pa nongs 'khrul med pas mnga' gsol lo/ /sgoms pa steng 'grus med pas mnga' gsol lo/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung bas mngal gsol lo/ /phyag rgya ting 'dzin brtan pos mnga' gsol lo/ /bzlas brjod ma yengs tshang bas mnga' gsol lo/

/dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas mnga' gsol lo/ /'khor 'das bkrag mdangs bcud kyis mnga' gsol lo/ /sde brgyad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mnga' gsol lo/ /srid gsum bdag po chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan srung kun gyi rgyal por mnga' gsol lo/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /bdud 'dul dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /bkra shis mthu stobs dbang por mnga' gsol lo/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mnga' gsol lo/ / zhes gyer ro/ /bshags pa'i rjes la skul rnams gyer/ de'i rjes su dngos su yang gzugs 'gros dang*/ na bza' dang*/ go mtshon sogs bstar nas bzhag /dmigs pa dang*/ bzlas pa cung zad byas nas/ yid kyis 'khor mang po sprul/ mchod pa mtha' yas pa spel/ mnga' gsol gyer bar bya'o// // zhes pa bstod bskul mnga' gsol dang bcas pa'i tshogs mang po las/ snying po khyer bde bar byas pa 'di yang*/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po kun dga' rab brtan gyi thugs dam du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgrigs pa'o/ / maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /gtor bzlog bsdus pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ gtor bzlog bsdus pa ni/ bskang gtor gyi mdun nam/ g.yon du bshos bu gru gsum nag po sha khrag gis brgyan pa khru gang ba mtheb kyu bcad kha phyi la bstan pas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du dgos mchod dang*/ snod gcig tu gtor chung du grags pa mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad bshams/ bskang gso tshar gcig song mtshams/ bzlog gtor che chung la thun mong du byin rlabs dkyus ltar dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyang bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dgra dang bgegs dang gnod byed thams cad bkug nas gtor ma la thim/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ ṇ+ri yaṃ dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mtheb kyu rnams tsho bzhir bcad/ yang nang mchod kyis bran/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gtor sngags lan nyer bdun gyis phul/

oṃ mahā ka la rnal 'byor gyi sgra lha sogs dang*/ rol mo rgyun dkrol bya/ de'i sgang la 'theb kyu gtor ma chen por blugs/ de ltar lan bzhis phul/ bar 'dir bstod pa dang skul rnams bya/ de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ hūṃ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ khro rgyal dpal chen he ru ka /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /de ring drag po'i zor 'phen gyi/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma dang*/ /sems can phan byed dge la spro/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi/ /'byung po thams cad sku zur cig /gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong bdag dang*/ /sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha' la/ /gnas pa'i lha klu mi ma yin/ /thams cad rang gi gnas su song*/ /mtho ba rnams ni zhabs skum zhig /dma' ba rnams ni dbu chums shig /bar pa rnams ni sku zur cig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhig /'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig / ces chang gi nang du mtheb kyu bcug pa lan gsum 'gro phyogs su gtor/ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥsdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /chos chos dgra la dmag dpung chos/ /dmag dpon rgyal po dmag sna drongs/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod las/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul phyi la bsgyur/ /skeg dang bar chad dgra la bzlog /bzlog go drag po'i dpung gis bzlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /nad yams dal yams dgra la bsgyur/ /rmi ltas mtshan ngan phyi la bzlog /bzlog go drag po'i= bzlog gi dmar= khram kha shod kha phyi la bsgyur/ / mthu gtad byad kha dgra la bzlog /bzlog go drag= bzlog go dmar= yas kyi bdud g.yos dgra la bzlog /mas kyi sri langs dgra la bzlog /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥ de nas gtor ma la rak+ta dang nang mchod bran/ snying po'i mthar/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag khang steng ngam phyi rol du dmar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa'i snod stegs la bzhag

chab kyis bran/ spyi btab dang*/ de rjes rol chen byas la shā sa na bzla'o/ / hūṃ chos skyong mgon po lcam dral dang*/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i las mkhan dang*/ /sde brgyad mgon po dmag dpung bcas/ / phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren tshogs rnams dang*/ /sprul pa nyi khri chig stong dang*/ /lha bdud grangs las 'das pa rnams/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs nas/ / chos 'khor 'di yi btang bzung la/ /byad kha rbod gtong byed pa dang*/ /gnod par byed pa'i gdon dang bgegs/ /log par lta ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /thams cad rdul bzhin brlag par mdzad/ /rdo rje mtshon cha'i char pa phob/ /mi nad phyugs nad mun ltar gtibs/ dus mtha'i me yis bsreg par mdzod/ /sha khrag rus pa zhal du thob/ /'go ba'i lha dang phral nas kyang*/ /ma thogs myur du las mdzod cig /sdig cig ma rungs 'di rnams kyi/ /rnam shes dbyings su spar du gsol/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung dgos pas/ /da lta las la 'jug pa dang*// gang la bya ba dbyings su sgrol/ / zhes pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor ma skyel ba'am 'phang par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rting mnan phyi mig mi lta bar ldog /nang du mchod pa kha gsos la rjes chog bya/ 'phrin las bskang gtor yang 'bul na/ dang por spyi btab kyi bskang gtor khang steng ngam/ gtor stegs su 'bul lo/ /de rjes dmar chen gtong ba'am/ yang na dmar chen phyi rol du btang 'phral sgrub khang steng du 'phrin las gtor ma 'bul ba'i lugs kyang yod/ de yang dkyus gcig po la gnyis ka 'bul ba'i dbang du byas so// // zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtor 'bul bzhugs/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po'i bka' 'khor na/ nag po mi sdug ma'i bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi/ dmar mo khro gnyer can ma'i bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi/ dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi/

'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa bka'i pham 'babs la gshegs su gsol/ oṃ a ral+li ho hrīḥhriṃ hriṃ dza dza bh+yoḥ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ bh+yoḥ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas pa nyid/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ /'dir spyon dam dgongs 'phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan lha yi rdo rje g.ya' mo skyod// gang gi yum chen rdo rje kun bzang ma/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo chen mo mched bzhi yang*/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub bzang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ /mkha' reg khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang*/ /dmangs rigs rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin chen mo mched bzhi yang*/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub bzang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*/ /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo gsil/ / g.yu yi dril snyan rdo rje zul le ma/ /sman btsun chen mo mched bzhi yang*/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub bzang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ / bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / bh+yoḥ mched bzhi chen mo khyed rnams kyang*/ /sngon dang sngon gyi dus tshod na/ /rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /a su ra'i brag phug dang*/ gung thang de yi la thog dang*/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo'i gling 'gram du/ /bka' dang dam la btags pa bzhin/ /sngon gyi zhal gzhes ma g.yel bar/ /phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/

/la lā/ li lī/ sdang sdang*/ sdeng sdeng*/ srid 'gro ma hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ bh+yoḥ // maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /dpal legs ldan nag po trak+shad kyi gtor sgrub kyi lag len man ngag bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā rā ya/ legs ldan nag po'i 'di'i gtor sgrub kyi man ngag ni/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung mthing kha me ri can rtse mo phar bstan pa/ dbus su nyi gdan la raṃ dang bh+yos mtshon pa bsdus pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol zlum bskor gyi nang ljang khu/ phyi rol thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rdo ra me ri rnams byed pa 'bring po dang*/ bskyed chog dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'bri ba rgyas pa'o/ /dbus su mañji'i steng du yab yum la sgrub gtor gcig /mdun du gtso bo'i 'bul gtor dang*/ lha mo'i 'bul gtor/ g.yas g.yon du mon pa pho mo'i gtor ma bdun bdun/ mdun du khyi mo bdun gyi gtor ma/ g.yas su sman dang g.yon du rak+ta/ mchod pa sogs lag len bzhin bshams/ mda' dar gri snying can yod na rab med na'ang sgrub gtor la mda' dar nang rten gyi tshul du gzugs/ bris sku med na nges par tsa ka li 'dzugs/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams bshags bsdam la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed dang yi dam gyi gtor bsngo dang*/ mgon po'i gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yan chad bya/ sgrub gtor chen po de gtor bsngo ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi 'babs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas gtor ma la gzungs thag bzhag ste/ oṃ mahā bā ling ta sogs kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ yig brgya dang rten 'brel snying po tshar gsum gsum gyis brtan par bya/ de nas gzungs thag brdog /de lta bu'i gtor ma la dmigs nas/ gtor ma dang bris sku lhan cig tu lhar bskyed pa yin te/ tshig cha mngon rtogs bzhin bzhugs gsol gyi bar du bya/ mchod pa tshan gcig byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dkyus ma de byas la/

dmigs pa shugs drag pos bzlas pa gang mang bya'o/ /sgrub pa po yi dam dang mgon po'i bsnyen pa song ba sha stag yin na/ sngags brgya tsam la gzi byin bskyed pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas dus skabs dang bstun pa'i las bzhi'i dmigs pa nyid kyi gzhung bsrang*/ gzhug tu nyer gcig tsam la dngos grub blang ba'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /mgon po'i bsnyen pa ma song na phal cher bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ mjug tu sngar ltar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma thams cad phyogs gcig tu byin gyis brlabs la/ yang so sor dmigs te gtso bo'i 'bul gtor la 'bru gsum/ lan nyer gcig dang gzhan rnams la gsum/ thun mong du sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan bdun bdun dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags la de btags pa gsum gsum dang*/ thun mong du gtor sngags dkyus ma dang*/ shā sa na lan gsum gyis 'bul/ dpal ye shes kyi zhes sogs bstab pa'i tshe rol mo rgyun chags bya/ slar yang gtor chung nyi shu rtsa drug byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum nyi shu rtsa drug tu bzlas/ mchod pa rnams kyang byin gyis brlabs/ mchod 'phreng dang sman rak+ta gtor ma gsum gyis gzhung bsrang*/ de skabs gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad la sman dang rak+ta ldugs/ gtor chung rnams gong bzhin bsngos nas/ las kyi rdo rjes dpral ba'i thad tsam du gtor snod bzung la thams cad kyis 'di ltar gyer te/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /dpal ldan mgon po spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā la trak+ṣad sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di skabs su 'thor ba bsdu ba'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas/ hūṃ bstan dgra ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /snying khrag dron mo'i mchod yon dang*/ /dbang po sna lnga'i me tog bshams/

/tshil chen bsregs pa'i bdug spos sprin/ /zhun chen snang gsal mar me'i 'od/ /klad pa mkhris pa'i dri chab dang*/ /sha chen skam rlon zhal zas mchog /thod rnga rkang gling rol mo'i sgra/ /gtor ma bza' ba sna tshogs ri/ /btung ba khrag gi rgya mtsho ste/ / stobs bcu'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi sman/ /zhing gi bla re rgyal mtshan gdugs/ / rgyu rlon lda ldi keng rus te/ /gsang chen mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas thugs dam skong gyur cig /oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ mahā ba ling ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes brjod cing*/ gtso bo'i 'bul gtor la gtor chung btab/ de nas bstod pa dang*/ 'phrin bcol bsdus pa ni / hūṃ raṃ las byung ba'i stobs po che/ /bdud kyi rgyal po khro gtum can/ /rta nag zhon pa rdzu 'phrul bdag /sdig can sgrol mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /bh+yoḥ nad kyi bdag mo re ma tī/ /gshin rje'i lcam mo a la la/ /'byung po kun gyi sha la rngams/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /lha chen yab yum 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig dus la bab po sa mā ya/ khyi mo shes rab gsal gyi dus la bab/ /nag mo gser mig ma'i= nag mo dngul mig= dmar mo zangs mig= sngon mo 'khar mig= nag mo mchong mig= nag mo gdong brgya ma'i= nag mo phag gdong ma'i= dur khrod bdag mo za byed ma/ /tshangs ma dbang mo gzhon nu ma/ /lha chen ma dang rtog 'dod ma/ /rgan byed ma dang sna chen mo/ /

mon mo bdun gyi dus la bab/ /lha dang gshin rje gnod sbyin dang*/ /klu dang srin po gying chen dang*/ /'jig rten mgon po nag po ste/ /mon pa bdun gyi dus la bab/ /bdud dmag bye ba'i dus la bab/ /lha dmag 'bum gyi dus la bab/ / lha srin sde brgyad dus la bab/ /mchod gtor bdud rtsi 'dir bzhes la/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ /chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par spel/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus mdzod/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bdag gi gus pas mchod gtor phul ba 'di bzhes la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can rnams bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod cig /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad= pha rol gyi byad kha phur kha mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa= keg ki kaṃ ma gshin rgyal sen sogs bgegs dang log 'dren gyis bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ skye bo dam pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i don du rgyan blon rgyal phran yul mi gtso bo mtha' dag dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ zhi bas mi 'dul ba sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa bsam sbyor ngan pa can gyi mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad bsad pa dang bskrad pa dang dbye ba dang rengs pa dang bcings pa la sogs pa tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la phan pa dang bde ba thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ bye brag 'dod don gsol ba yod na'ang drag tu btab/ mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi sngags drag tu bzla/

de nas bskang ba bstod pa bshags pa sogs kyi gzhung bsrang bar bya'o/ /bshags pa'i sngon du yig brgya gang mang bzla'o/ /de dag ni dang po tshugs pa'i thun thog mar bya ba yin la/ de phyin chad nas thun re re bzhin du gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams 'theb kyu res gso zhing*/ srod thun ma gtogs pa la gtor chung gong gi grangs bzhin dang*/ /srod thun la gtor chung sum cu btab/ dang po rang de ma gtogs gtor chung btab pa'i skabs/ gtor chung snga ma rnams nas gcig gnyis res sgrub gtor kha gso/ phyi ma bzhi po de rgyal chen bzhi la bsngo ba yin/ thog ma'i thun gcig po de ma gtogs dam tshig pa sngar yod gsal 'debs kyi gsar du bskyed mi dgos pas 'don bya la sa bon rnams bor bas chog go /'grol ba'i tshe tho rangs nas snga dro'i bar gang yang rung ba zhig la sngar bzhin cho ga rdzogs par btang nas/ /sgrub gtor chen mo'i lha bris sku la stim pa'i dmigs pa lan bdun bya/ gtor ma'i lha bris sku'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan bdun brjod sgrub gtor chen mo de nyid gtor chog gis phul nas/ gtor ma de nyid kyi snying po ma gtogs/ gtor ma dang 'theb kyu thams cad khang steng du spyir btab kyis 'bul ba man chad dus gtor dang 'dra'o/ /gal te 'phrin las bskang gso dang mnga' gsol byed par 'dod na nyi ma so sor bya'o// legs ldan nag po chen po dpal mgon po trak+ṣad kyi gtor ma'i sgrub pa chen po'i man ngag gsal bar bkod pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /dge'o// ༄༅/ /dpal mgon po'i zungs gso thabs kyi lag len cho ga bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ phyi rten zungs gso thabs mdor bsdus pa ni/ chos skyong mgon po'i grangs bsnyen sogs ji ltar 'os pa sngon du song bas/ ras gzhi dar gzhi shog bu sogs ji ltar 'os pa la/

gser dngul lam/ mtshal lam/ snag tshas kyang rung ste/ mgon po nyid dam lcam dral lam/ gtso 'khor kun gyi sngags ji ltar 'os pa'i tha mar/ dpal mgon po 'khor bcas rten zungs su btsugs pa 'di la/ rten bcas te dgyes par bzhugs shing*/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma dang*/ bstan pa'i gnyer kha mdzod/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du sgrubs/ 'phrin las phyogs med du spel/ rten 'brel legs phyogs su sgrigs/ dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad choms/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub can gyi dgra thams cad rlag par mdzod/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes bya ba bris la/ lhar bskyed rab gnas byas/ zhu ba las sngags 'phreng du bsam/ zhabs nas bsgril/ smyug sbugs sogs su bzhugs pa'am/ thums btab/ dar mtshon sna lnga'am/ rdo tshar gyi mgo la bcoms/ de 'dra rten gyi grangs dang mnyam par bya/ de nas dus khyad par can la/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis gtor bsngo dang bskang ba sngon du btang*/ rten gtor ram/ bskang gtor gyi gtor dbang byas kyang rung mod kyi/ lag len mi bde zhing de dag dus ma yin par sgul skyod byed pa la dgag cha'ang yod pas/ gtor dbang byed rgyu'i dmar gtor gru gsum zhig logs su bcos/ de la gtor bsngo logs pa mi dgos kyang*/ byin rlabs sogs gtor bsngo dang bskang gso'i skabs thams cad du dmigs pa nan tan du byed cing*/ gtor bsngo'i skabs su yang dmigs pas logs su 'bul/ gtor ma de'i steng gi nam mkha' la mgon po lam mer bzhugs pa'i mos pa byed/ rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i bum chu sgrub pa'am/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i las bum yod na des chog /bsdu na bum pa kha rgyan dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa la/ a mṛ ta brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka brgya rtsa bzla/ de nas zungs rten rnams ji ltar 'os pa'i sar khrid/

bgegs sbyangs ba dang*/ til sbyangs sogs bya/ a mṛ ta'i sngags bzla bzhin zungs rten rnams la bum chus gtor/ yang a bhi ṣe ka'i sngags kyis kyang de dag la gtor zhing*/ gu gul gyis bdugs nas/ sngar gyi shog ril dar sna dang bcas pa de rta'i phuṃ phuṃ dang*/ g.yag lug khyi rnams kyi sog ba g.yas pa'i thad du 'dogs/ gtor dbang byed rgyu'i gtor ma de stegs bu'i steng du bshams/ zungs kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mtheb kyus gsos/ nang mchod kyis bran/ chang phud cig kyang bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis dbyangs dang rol mor bcas te/ spyan ras gzigs mgon sogs kyis spyan 'dren bya/ mthar rol chen yun ring du bya zhing*/ oṃ mahā kā la kā li de bi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa lan mang po dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'i gnas su pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+wam/ zhes sbyar ba'ang lan mang du brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa = sogs kyis me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la khrus gsol bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ / zhes pa'i tshab tu/ dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ dmigs pa ni/ mgon po 'khor dang zungs rten rnams lhan cig pa la/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bkrus par bsam/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod thung sho lo ka res bstod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs gsos/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por mos/ gtor sngags dkyus ltar gyis phul/ zungs rten rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i rta nag /g.yag nag /lug nag khyi nag la sogs pa zungs rten khyad par can lus dpa' brjid nyams rtsal stobs dang ldan pa/ ngag don ldan nus pa'i mthu dang ldan pa/ sems shes rigs dpa' ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa/ byed pa 'dod don 'phrin las sgrub pa'i 'phrul dang ldan pa/ phung khams skye mched yan lag yongs su rdzogs shing*/

'dod yon mkho dgu ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi gyur pa 'di nyid/ dpal mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes shing tshim la thugs chags pa'i rten dang*/ mthu stobs nus pa rgyas pa'i gzhi dang*/ rgyu dang rten du gyur cig / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags ring thung gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma de zungs rten rnams kyi mgo bor 'jog cing*/ mar gyi zhur re 'debs/ sngags gtor kha gsos pa'i mtheb kyu re sbyin/ chang phud nas gtor ba tsam bya/ sgrub po gzhan rnams kyis snying po bzla zhing*/ rol mo 'jam rol bya/ slob dpon gyis mgon po lcam dral gyi snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes btags pa mang du brjod/ de nas 'di skad ces gyer te/ mig sman ltar gnag myur ba'i gom stabs kyis/ /gling bzhi ri rab yud kyis skor byed cing*/ /sna tshogs rin chen dar gyi lhab lhub can/ /cang shes sprin gyis shugs can 'di nyid 'bul/ /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /zungs rten 'di la rten bcas bzhugs nas kyang*/ /bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun bcas pa yi/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po la sogs pa/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs/ /chos 'khor 'di yi bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol du gsol/ /rgyal blon rgyal phran yul mi gtso bo kun/ /thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khyod la re bltos 'cha' zhing bcol lags so/ /rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum bstan du gsol/ /bdag cag sde 'di'i mi phyugs nor dang 'khor/ /rang dbang yul 'khor thams cad khyed la gtad/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe ma g.yel zhig / bcol lo bltos so mthu stobs ci 'dug blta/ /rtsal shugs bskyed la 'gal ba'i sde choms shig

/yal yol rnam g.yeng le lo ma mdzad par/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rdo rje rjes dran nas/ /bcol ba'i las rnams thams cad grub par mdzod// ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ de bzhin du/ mun ltar gtibs shing rab 'jigs ngar sgra can/ /glog dmar 'gyur ba'i ro 'dzin skyod byed cing*/ /rdo rje'i rwa rtses ri rab rib du 'phen/ /g.yag rgod zhol chen ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul/ /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral = sogs sho lo ka gsum gong bzhin/ 'jam legs spu sdug gos gyon nyams stobs rgyas/ /yid 'ong sgra yi dir dir khams gsum g.yo/ / 'khyil pa'i rwa can skye 'gro dbang du bsdud/ /lug nag spyi dkar g.yang chags 'di nyid 'bul/ /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral = sogs gong bzhin/ 'brug stong skad kyis bdud sde'i snying 'gas shing*/ /drag gtum mche ba'i shugs kyis dgra dpung 'joms/ /'bum phrag gdong lnga'i tshogs kyang zil gnon pa'i/ khyi nag snying dkar stobs ldan 'di 'bul lo/ /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral = zhes pa nas/ rten du gsol gyi bar gong bzhin/ de yang rta g.yag lug khyi bzhi kar yod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ gcig gam gnyis sam gsum yod na'ang de dang de'i tshig gis 'bul bsdu na gang la yang*/ dpal ldan mgon po = sogs shwa lo ka gsum kho nas kyang chog go /yang na/ rin chen rgyan ldan rta nag rting dkar 'bul/ /rngam brjid stobs ldan g.yag rog zhol chen 'bul/ /yid 'phrog g.yang chags lug nag spyi dkar 'bul/ /mi srun dgra 'joms khyi nag snying dkar 'bul/ / zhes so/ /re re'i mthar gong bzhin sbyar bas legs par 'gyur ro/ /lag len bsdus pa byed na/ bgegs sbyangs pa dang*/ gzungs sngags 'dogs pa dang*/ khrus chu gtor nas gtor dbang tsam bskur/ 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad bsdus pa tsam brjod pas kyang chog go /de nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ spyan drangs pa'i mgon po zungs rten la thim par mos nas/
