dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod la me tog gtor nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharma bzla/ bkra shis kyi tshig ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing*/ rol chen dang bcas te zungs rten rnams btang ngo*/ /'di nyid lha dang sngags dang spyan 'dren tshigs bcad sogs so so'i 'don pa bsgyur pas mgon po'i rigs gang la sbyar kyang chog go /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas nyer mkho tsam brjod pa'o/ / gcig zhus/bkra shis/ / ༄༅/ /gser skyems bzhugs so/ / £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ £© hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*//hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan he ru ka /hūṃ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan <khro bo'i rgyal > dus 'khor lo/ /hūṃ nga ni khro rgyal <gshin rje gshed > rdo rje shugs/ /hūṃ nga ni khams gsum dbang phyug bdag /skyed dang sdud pa'i byed po yin/ /srid zhi kun gyi gtso bo'o/ /rgyal ba yab yum dkyil 'khor lha/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha mor bcas/ /ye shes khro bo khro mo rnams/ /'dir byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhes/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas dang*//rigs ldan <rig 'dzin > sprul pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad kyang*/ /'dir byon= mchog dang = yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ /theg gsum 'phags tshogs ma lus dang*/ /bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma kun/ /'dir byon = mchog dang = hūṃ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ las byed ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /hūṃ dus gsum bde gshegs bka' nyan gtso/ < /dpal gyi mgon po mthu rtsal can/ /legs ldan nag po chen po'i tshogs/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'phrin las mgon/ /trak+shad lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ > /sde drug srung ma drug bcu'i tshogs/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/

/dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /ha ha rgod pa'i zhing skyong che/ /gzhan yang las mkhan pu <shwa na > tra sogs/ /'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab bcas la/ /gser skyems bdud rtsi 'di 'bul lo/ /bar chad sol la 'dod don sgrub/ /hūṃ phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi/ /lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /'jigs byed dgu dang gza' chen dgu /rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /ming po gsum dang srin mo bzhi/ /ma bdun dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /zhing du spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ / bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa/ /zhing skyong bzhi bcu zhe brgyad dang*/ /phyogs bzhi so sor gnas pa yi/ /thub pa 'byung po nyer brgyad dang*/ /dmag dpon gnod sbyin nyi shu brgyad/ /stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /grong khyer skyong ba bcu drug dang*/ /ljongs chen skyong ba lnga brgya sogs/ /laṅga la sogs srin po'i tshogs/ /pho nya sum brgya drug cu dang*/ /grub pa drang srong 'phrog ma dang*/ /nyi khyim cha yi lha rnams dang*/ /sbyor ba nyer bdun byed pa bcu/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas dang*/ /gzhan yang bstan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ /skyes bu gying chen bco brgyad dang*/ /dge bsnyen mthu chen nyi shu gcig

/rje yi mgur lha sum cu sogs/ /bod yul gnas pa'i sde brgyad kun/ /rang rang bud med g.yogs dang 'khor/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun grogs bcas la/ /gser skyems= khyad par gnas 'di'i chos skyong ba/ /sman btsun nags sman rgyal mo dang*/ / nang 'khor sman mo 'bum sde dang*/ /che btsan dmag dpon 'khor dang bcas/ / yul 'di'i lha klu gzhi bdag ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dpag yas la/ /gser skyem= gzhan yang lha dang gnod sbyin dang*/ /gshin rje dri za grul bum dang*/ /lto 'phye mkha' lding mi'am ci/ /klu dang sa bdag gnyan gyi sde/ /rgyal po btsan dang ma mo bdud/ /gza' dang the rang 'gong po rmu/ /ri dang nags tshal shing gi lha/ / dur khrod lam srang bzhi mdo dang*/ khyim dang mtshan gcig gnas la sogs/ / mdor na 'jig rten dregs pa can/ /srid gsum gnas pa ma lus kun= gser skyem= 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /mthu ldan dam pa khyed kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun 'phel ba dang*/ /rgyal khams sems can bde ba dang*/ /gnod byed gdug pa tshar chod cig / hūṃ khyad par nges don bstan pa gsal mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan jo nang ba'i/ /bstan pa yul rnams kun tu dar ba dang*/ /srid mthar mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang*/ /bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag gsang sngags zab mo yi/ /'phrin las bsgrub pa'i dam tshig grogs mdzod cig /ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ / 'di rgyas pa yin/ bsdus pa phyogs skyong bcu dang sogs sh+lau ka bdun po tsam gyis kyang chog go / zhus dag/ maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi drag gtor shin tu zab pa rtags mngon gyur can bzhugs/ gtso bo dang las mkhan gyi drag sngags ma sbas par bris yod pas bka' rgya dam pa gal che'o/ /dmar nag gang la sbyar kyang 'dra/ /dge'o/ / na mo gu ru badz+ra dha rā ya/

rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras drag po'i gtor ma'i las bya bar 'dod pas/ gnas dben par bgegs bskrad pa dang byur bsal ba sogs byas la/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags bzlas pas sa gzhi la gtor/ der dkyil 'khor 'bri dgos pa las/ dmar po rta sngon can nang sgrub tu grags pa ltar na/ 'khor lo pad+ma zlum skor rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa 'bri dgos la/ gsang ba ma mo ltar sgrub pa 'di dang*/ gshin rje bzhi skor lta bu'i sgrub pa dngos la/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi kho nas chog pa zhig dang*/ rtsibs bzhi nyis rim byed pa'ang yod/ gzhan yang sgrub pa mi 'dra ba la dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'dug kyang*/ 'dir kun bsdus spyi dril gyi dbang du byas na/ gtor bzlog sogs kyi las rim la stobs che bar grags pas/ de ltar bshad na/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag me ri 'bar ba la 'khor lo sngon po'am/ pad+ma sngon po dang nyi ma'i steng du/ phyag mtshan ral gri'am/ sa bon bai nag po'am/ de dag ma 'grub na tshom bu nag po zhig 'god do/ / de'i phyi rol zlum por bskor/ gru chad dmar po bya/ zlum skor gyi snam bu+u la shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo ba'i phyogs mdog can la chu ris 'bri/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo sngon mo rtsibs brgyad la/ sras bzhi dang*/ blon po bzhi'i tshom bu sku mdog dang mthun par 'god/ de'i phyi zlum skor sngon po'am ljang khu la rgyal chen bzhi'i tshom bu ni nges par 'god cing*/ spro na gshin rje bzhi dang*/ srin po bzhi dang*/ mchod lha bzhi yang 'god do/ / mtha' rdo rwa me ris bskor/ der mañji'i steng du gtor ma chen po kha zas bzang rgu dang sha khrag sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zur gsum zhig bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir gtor ma chung ba gru gsum re bsham ste/ rim pas ra khyi mi rta rnams kyi sha khrag gis brgyan par byed dgos pa las/ ma 'byor na so so'i gzugs brnyan btsugs te/

sha khrag ci 'byor gyis brgyan pa dang*/ gzhan yang bshos bu gru bzhi rgya phibs can dang bse zhal du chang phud ma nyams pa dang*/ mda' bya rgod ma la dar leb rgan btags pa dang*/ zho cha dang*/ bre srang sogs bsham/ 'phen gtor thog gzugs me ri can dang*/ de'i mdun du las mkhan gyi gtor ma/ zan gru gsum gyi steng du snying gzugs dang bcas pa bsham/ klu gtor yang bsham/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ rten bsham zhing rgyan dgram par bya'o/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du btang nas/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ yi dam ni spyir sgrub pa tsam yin na zhi khro gang gis kyang rung*/ gtor bzlog sogs drag po dang 'brel na yang*/ ye shes khro bo gang gis kyang rung mod/ dregs pa spyi'i gnyen po'am/ gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i dbang du byas na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang bdag nyid dam rdo rje rnam 'joms sogs bsngags par byed/ ma mo gshin rje'i las tshogs dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ gshin rje gshed nyid bsngags par yang grags/ yig rnying la la na rta mgrin bsngags par byas pa'ang gda'/ kun gyi gnyen po mthar thug ni/ khams gsum rnam rgyal lam dpal he ru ka yin pas de ltar yang legs so/ /de nas mdun bskyed ji ltar 'os pa'i yi dam gyi gtor chog kyang grub par bya'o/ / de dag ni nges par dgos la/ de rjes rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyang yin/ sprul gzhi yang yin pas/ rgyal chen zhi ba bde byed ma'i gtor chog bskang bstod yan chad kyang 'grub par byas na shin tu legs mod/ yang drag gtor gyi cho ga'i yan lag tu ni nges can dgos pa rang yang ma yin pas/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de las gzhan pa dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gang yang rung ba'i bskang ba sogs grub na rgyab dpung du legs par 'gyur ba'ang yin la/ sgrub pa po'i blo'i khyad par gyis res 'ga' phan med gnod med dang*/

phan gnod gnyis kar yod par 'gyur ba'ang yod mod/ drag las chos skyong rigs mi gcig pa ha cang mang ba dus gcig tu byed pa ni mi bzang ste/ mchod yul gyi sgo nas khyad med kyang*/ sgrub pa po rang gi dmigs pa sogs gnad la mi 'gril bar/ blo mang du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /da ni 'dir drag gtor gyi cho ga la/ zhi drag gnyis kyi cho ga spel nas byed pa'i srol zhig kyang byung 'dug mod kyi/ bskang gso tsam la de ltar mi 'gal yang*/ drag las sgrub na de ltar byed mi bde zhing 'khyams pa'i rgyu yin pas/ 'dir drag gtor gyi cho ga sgos su byed do/ / de yang 'di ltar/ hūṃ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ /dbang bskur yang dag thob pa las/ /su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje gsor zhing phur pa'i dpal gyen la bstan to/ /mtshams gcod do/ / hūṃ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /gsang sngags tshul bzhin sgrub sngo ma thogs te/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur pa/ /bla ma rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /yi dam lha tshogs spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /gtsang ris mgon po'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /chos skyong lcam dral spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /lha srin sde brgyad spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /mthol bshags phul nas tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ / tshar gsum/ bshags pa'o/ /bshags pa rgyas pa la dga' na yig rnying du blta'o/ / sman rag gtor gsum sngar yi dam gyi gtor ma dang lhan cig byin gyis brlabs pa de/ gsos btab pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mahā sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ oṃ āḥhūṃ raṃ rak+ta dza la sa mu dra ya hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ oṃ mahā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sa ma ya hūṃ swāhā/ lan bdun bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i tsha tsha 'khrug pa'i sa gzhi'i steng du/ rdo rje'i rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur pa'i nang du/ sprin nag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la mi mgo skam rlon rid gsum brtsigs pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'jigs su rung zhing mi sdug pa'i rgyan dang rta babs kyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la ral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su ma mo'i gnas rgya mtsho kha dog bzhi las khor yug tu bskor ba/ de'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang du/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ ru tra pho mo sgral ba'i gdan steng du hūṃ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ chos skyong rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyis dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu blta ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar bas gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kyi mgo lus : 'grel [ breg ] pa/ g.yon pas mda' dar leb rgan phrag par brten zhing g.yob pas/ sde brgyad ma lus pa'i dmag dpung bsdu ba/ sku la dar nag gi ber chen bse khrab smug po dang bcas pa gsol ba/ dbu la lcags kyi rmog zhu gser gyi thig le can bsnams pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham g.yu ris can gsol ba/ bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog can gyi rta mchog lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ gser gyi sga dang*/ 'phra men gyi yob can la chibs pa/ sbrul dang mi mgo'i rgyan can/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba srin po'i cha lugs can me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/

srin po dang gshin rje dang bya gcan gdug pa'i tshogs rnams sku las spro ba/ 'khor gnod sbyin bye bas bskor ba'o/ / yang na rta nag rkyang dang*/ phyag g.yon mdung dmar ba dan can byed pa'ang yod/ de'i thugs kar yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bai yig mthing nag go /phyi rol rgya mtsho bzhi la shar du traka las bdud mo gshen rje mgo dgu ma/ sku mdog smug nag gam dkar mo/ phyag g.yas dung gi spu gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ dar dkar nag spel ba'i na bza' can/ ba men ru yon la chibs shing*/ gti mug klad pa'i mtsho la rol ba'o/ /lho ru raka las bdud mo gshin rje lag ring ma nag mo/ lag pa stong g.yas lnga brgyas ral gri dang*/ g.yon lnga brgyas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ stags lpags kyi smad dkris can/ ma he nag po la chibs shing*/ nga rgyal rkang dang zhag gi mtsho la rol ba'o/ / nub tu sha yig las bdud mo gshin rje phung khrol ma dmar nag /g.yas lcags kyu'am dgra zor g.yon dgra snying 'dzin pa/ zhal nas khrag zor 'phen pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ rus 'phreng gi thod byas pa/ g.yag rgod nag po chibs shing*/ 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtshor rol ba'o/ /byang du bh+yoḥlas bdud mo gshin rje gsod byed ma ljang nag lag pa brgya pa/ g.yas lnga bcu khram shing dang*/ g.yon lnga bcu bdud zhags dang*/ dgra bo'i glo snying sbrags te 'dzin pa dred lpags kyi smad g.yogs can/ rkyang bu kha dkar ram rnga mong la chibs shing*/ phrag dog 'khris pa'i rgya mtshor rol ba'o/ /thams cad kyang mi mgo'i do shal can/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i bud med drag shul can 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /phyi rol kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ shar du sha yig las gza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ lhor ra yig las gnod sbyin dha na/ nub tu ma yig las gnod sbyin ka la/

byang du na yig las gnod sbyin ku be ra ste sras bzhi dang*/ shar lhor ye las gnod sbyin bum rna/ lho nub tu sa las gnod sbyin dung rna/ nub byang du ha las gnod sbyin dril bu'i rna ba'am rna gsum/ byang shar du aṃ las gnod sbyin rna bo che ste blon po bzhi dang*/ lha rnams kyi phyogs bzhir/ shar du bhṛ las rgyal chen yul 'khor srung dkar po mda' gzhu dang pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ glang po che la zhon pa/ lhor be las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ ma he la zhon pa/ nub byang du bi las spyan mi bzang dmar po sku gdung dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ chu srin la zhon pa/ byang du bai las/ las mkhan ngal gsos po ljang nag dbyug to 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang go cha bgos shing*/ srin po ltar ches khros pa'o/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma bzhi dang*/ gra bzhir mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang gshin rje'i rgyal po bzhi dang*/ srin po'i ded dpon bzhi la sogs pa/ pho nya drag gtum gyi tshogs dang sde brgyad grangs med pas bskor de bzhugs pa'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros te/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /chos skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang*/ /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa/ /chibs su rdzu 'phrul rta la chibs/ /sku mdog nag po bse khrab gsol/ /gser gyi rmog zhu gyen du brdzes/ /g.yas kyi ral gris dgra bgegs sgrol/ /g.yon pa mda' dar dmag dpung g.yob/ khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i dmag dang bcas/ /ma mo gnod sbyin gshin rje'i tshogs/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i don slad du/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /hūṃ bai trag raka sha bh+yoḥs ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

dpal ldan mgon po rnam thos sras/ / thugs rjes 'phongs pa las sgrol ba/ /'phrin las rdzogs mdzad dpa' bo che/ / 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ a ti bhu ho/ pra ti bhu ho/ yab cig rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /ma mo la sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ / kun gyi yab gcig dpal 'bar ba/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥs ma ya tiṣ+tha lhan/ hū chos skyong sogs la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /yon chab me tog spos dang mar me dang*/ /dri mchog zhal zas spyan gzigs sna tshogs pa/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams kyis bzhes su gsol/ /gzugs legs sgra snyan pi waṃ gling bu dang*/ /dung dang rdza rnga cang te ḍā ma ru/ /dri zhim spos mchog na bza' bzhes su gsol/ /hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥs ma ya hoḥ gzhan yang khyad par rmad du byung ba yi/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar dam tshig rdzas/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma chang dang bcas/ /ru tra sgral ba'i tsit+ta mchod par bzhes/ /hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥpañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ dgra bgegs kyi tsit+ta la khā raṃ khā hi/ hū rin chen mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun nas sngar sangs rgyas/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa/ /ngal gsos po la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang*/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong mdzad pa/ /thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /drang srong rnam mang thos pa dang*/ /lha mo dpal tshul bzang mo

yi/ /sras su smon lam rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /bzang po'i khri la bzhugs nas ni/ /gter chen bzhi la mnga' mdzad pa/ /dzaṃ bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha chen khyod ni khros pa'i tshe/ / spyan rtsa dmar po bzlog pa yis/ /dgra la mi nad phyugs nad gtong*/ /lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje ya mān ta ka yis/ /gdong dmar 'dul bar dbang bskur ba/ /gshin rje dmar po srog gi bdag /ma ru rtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa yis/ /chos 'khor srung mar dbang bskur ba/ /bsgo ba che la phyag 'tshal= /gru gu'i yul du gshegs pa na/ /gru gu rta dmag rgyal po yis/ /srung ma chen por dbang bskur ba/ /ku be ra la= rgya nag yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /rgya chen dar btsan dmar po yis/ /te te'i srung mar mnga' gsol ba/ /mdung dmar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas su/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// srung ma chen por dbang bskur ba/ /chos kyi rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/ khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /da lta bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil nas/ /gshin rje khros pa'i mthu mo che/ /'jigs pa'i bud med dkar la 'tsher/ /bdud mo mgo dgu ma la bstod/ / des 'gre/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i= gshin rje= 'jigs pa'i bud med nag la rngam/ /gshin rje lag ring ma la bstod/ /nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i= gshin rje= 'jigs pa'i bud med dmar la 'bar/ /srin mo phung khrol ma la bstod/ /byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i= gshin rje= 'jigs pa'i bud med ljang nag 'thibs/ /ma mo lag brgya ma la 'dud/ /sras mchog dam pa rā hu la/ /mgo dgu srin po'i cha lugs can/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/

/gnod sbyin dha na sku mdog ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa/ /rtse gsum thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /gnod sbyin ka la 'jigs gzugs smug /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa/ /be con thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /ku be ra ni sku mdog ljang*/ /zhal gcig= dbyugs tho 'bar ba thod khrag 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad= /dregs pa bum rna dmar ljang la/ /zhal gcig= /rgyal mtshan dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa= dregs pa dung rna ser ljang la/ zhal gcig=/ mdung dmar dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa= dregs pa rna gsum ljags nag la/ /zhal gcig= rtse gsum dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa= dregs pa rna chen dkar ljang la/ zhal gcig= dbyug pa 'bar ba ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung*/ /shar gyi dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad cing*/ /shar phyogs bstan pa skyong ba po/ /dri za'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /lho yi dgra= lho phyogs bstan pa= grul bum= nub phyogs na ni spyan mi bzang*/ /nub kyi= nub phyogs= klu 'brug rgyal po= byang phyogs las mkhan rnam thos bu/ /byang gi= byang phyogs= gnod sbyin rgyal po= shar phyogs sgo srungs chen mo na= dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ khro rgod brkyang bskum gar gyis rol/ /lcags kyu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs sgo= ser mo zhal= khro rgod= zhags pa 'dzin pa= nub phyogs= dmar mo= khro rgod= lcags sgrog= byang phyogs= ljang nag= khro rgod= dril bu 'dzin= gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha rnams dang*/ /gying pho gying mo pho nya bran/ /lha srin sde brgyad mthu bo che/ /de dag kun la'ang phyag 'tshal bstod/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan par gyur/

dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ya hūṃ swāhā/ traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ zhes bzla ba man ngag zhal gdams kyi yig chung na yod/ rgyun bzlas la/ oṃ bai shrā ba ṇa ya hrīḥṣ+tā+-i bi kri sarba sha trun hūṃ druṃ/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'i sngags so/ / hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ rgyun bzlas kyi snying po 'bru drug pa ste ma mo ltar sgrub pa'i snying po'o/ / de la raka mo ru tṛ raṃ baṃ ri li li mā ra ya snying la khrag khraṃ/ mā ra du ya sod rbad su rbad bu bh+yoḥ che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ ces btags pa ni rbad sngags so/ /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ dun dun rmugs rmugs pa shang tsa la tsa la/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hi ma hi ma/ rbad na rbad na/ rbad tu ling rbad me sha ya che ge mo la mā ra ya rbad rbad/ rbad bsad sbrags pa'o/ /de dag ci rigs par bzla'o/ /bzlas pa grol nas/ 'dir gtor bsngo byed na/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du oṃ las thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a/ muṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad bkug ste bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung po chen po dang gtor ma gcig tu 'dres pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ a kā ro sogs/ oṃ ru ru spu ru sogs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs/ gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shrā ba ṇa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ e dam ba liṃ grih+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha ma ma sarba karma sā dha ya a mo gha ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/

bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ mahā yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa du ta ging ka ra/ dh+ri bo bi bai sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis 'khor la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs bstod thung gcig 'don/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ 'phrin las gzhol/ bar 'dir klu gtor gtong ngo*/ /'di dag gsar ma'i lugs kyi gtor chog yin kyang*/ nges par phyag len du byed kyin 'dug /rgyun gyi gtor bsngo la shin tu mkho bar yang snang ngo*/ /de nas skabs 'dir rdzu 'phrul bstod bskang bya ste/ chos skyong rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/ khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ / 'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /lha yi gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha chen brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /lha dmag 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas/ /'dod yon rnam lngas thugs dam bskang*/ /klu yi gtso bo= klu chen brgyad= klu dmag 'bum= dug chen gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ /gnod sbyin gtso bo= gnod sbyin brgyad kyi= gnod sbyin 'bum= rdzu 'phrul rta yi thugs dam bskang*/ / gshin rje'i gtso bo= ma ru sde bzhi'i= gshin rje 'bum= tsa ra dmar pos thugs dam bskang*/ /ma mo'i gtso bo= bdud mo bzhi'i= ma mo 'bum= sha khrag dmar gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /the rang gtso bo= the rang brgyad kyi= the rang 'bum= sna tshogs rdzas kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /'gong po'i gtso bo= khu le lag dgu mched bzhis bskor/ /phud byed 'bum= dgra bgegs srog gis thugs dam bskangs/ /phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rta mchog sngon po rgyan ldan 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ khyed kyi thugs dam skong gyur cig /nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /'khor bcas bris sku mtshan ldan 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ khyed kyi thugs dam skong gyur cig / gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /gri snying 'khor lo sngags bcas 'di/

/ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ khyed kyi thugs dam= khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir/ /mdung dmar dar gyis brgyan pa 'di/ rgyal chen= khyed kyi thugs= 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir= mda' dar dmar po sngags can 'di/ /rgyal chen= khyed kyi= rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ / 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rtag gtor 'di/ /rgyal chen= /khyed kyi rgyun du 'phrin las bcol ba'i phyir/ /dmar nag bshos bu zur gsum 'di/ /rgyal chen= khyed kyi=/ /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /dza gad phud kyi mchod pa 'di/ / rgyal chen= khyed kyi= sngon gyi thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho 'di/ /rgyal chen= khyed kyi= dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'di/ /rgyal chen= khyed kyi= rtag tu dri la dgyes pa'i phyir/ /dri zhim spos kyi dud pa 'di/ /rgyal chen= khyed kyi= gnod sbyin dgyes pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /sna tshogs shing 'bras dam pa 'di/ rgyal chen= khyed kyi thugs dam= gzhan yang mchod rdzas nor sna rnams/ /mo btsun g.yog 'khor rkang 'gros sogs/ /srid pa gsum na yod rgu cog /gzung rgyu thams cad 'bul gyi bzhes// chos skyong mgon po'i= de ring bdag gi mgon la byon/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ /shin tu gdung bas khyod bskul na/ /ma yengs chos skyong thugs dam can/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ rdzu 'phrul mthu yi dngos grub stsol/ / ces bskang ngo*/ / de nas dgra chos sam 'phrin las bskul ba ni/ gong bzhin/ hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po zhes pa nas/ bye ba'i dmag dang bcas/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag sna drongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na/ / chos gcig rgyal po dgra la chos/ /chos gcig lha chen dmag la chos/

/rtags dang mtshan ma khyer la shog / 'bru drug pa la dbyangs lan gsum byas nas/ gtor ma dbus ma la sman dang rak+ta bran no/ / bh+yoḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i shar phyogs nas/ /bdud mo gshin rje mgo dgu ma/ /chibs su mdzo mo ru yon chibs/ /gshin rje khros pa'i mthu mo che/ /na bza' dkar nag 'bar ba la/ /phyag na dung gi spu gri thogs/ /dgra bo'i bshan mo bdud kyi ma/ /bdud mo gshin rje mgo dgu las/ /mgo gcig bang gi lha la rgyug /mgo gcig phugs kyi nor la rgyug /mgo gcig 'chan gyi bu la rgyug /mgo gcig steng gi pho la rgyug /mgo gcig 'og gi mo la rgyug / mgo gcig ra ba'i phyugs la rgyug /mgo gcig sgo yi khyi la rgyug /mgo gcig phyi yi zhing la rgyug /mgo gcig srog gi gshed ma gyis/ /gshed mas 'gugs shing cho nges thob/ /bdud mo gshin rje mgo dgu ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung gi /chos gcig sring mo dgra la chos/ /chos gcig dam can dgra la chos/ /bdud mo gshin rje mgo dgu mas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i tsit+ta la mā ra ya na dza dzaḥbh+yoḥbh+yoḥ shar gyi gtor ma la sman raka bran no/ / bh+yoḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i lho phyogs nas/ /bdud mo gshin rje lag ring ma/ /chibs su ma he brjid pa chibs/ /raka sha khros pa'i snying zan ma/ /sku stod zangs kyi gyim 'bag la/ /sku smad lcags kyi sham thabs can/ /lag stong bar snang nyul mdzad ma/ /lag pa lnga brgyas dgra bo 'dzin/ /lag pa lnga brgyas dgra bo gsod/ /drongs shig dgra bo'i mgul nas drongs/ /bdud mo gshin rje lag ring ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sogs 'di'i snga ma dang 'dra/ bh+yoḥ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nub phyogs nas/ /bdud mo gshin rje phung khrol ma/ /chibs su g.yag gu tsha ba chibs/ /shu la ra dza dgra bo'i gshed/ /mi lpags rlon pa gos su gyon/ /rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba thod du bcings/ /dbu las sprul pa'i gshin rje khram thogs 'gyed/

/g.yas pa lcags kyi zor ba bsnams/ /bstan pa bsnub pa'i mgo lus khrol/ /g.yon pa zangs kyi sde mo 'bar/ /dgra bo'i glo snying spar gyis 'debs/ /bdud mo gshin rje phung khrol ma/ /rnal 'byor sogs gong bzhin/ bdud mo gshin rje phung khrol mas/ /dam nyams dgra bo che ge mo/ /baṃ ril ril mā ra dza/ gtor ma nub ma la sman raka bran no// bh+yoḥ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i byang phyogs nas/ /bdud mo gshin rje lag brgya ma/ /chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs/ /sku la dar nag 'jol ber gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying 'byin ma/ /yak+sha sen sha mthu mo che/ / g.yas pa lnga bcu zhags pa thogs/ /g.yon pa lnga bcu khram shing thogs/ khyod ni klu yi sring mo ste/ /dgra bo klu dang gnyan la gtod/ /bdud mo gshin rje gsod byed ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sogs gong bzhin/ bdud mo lag brgya mas dam nyams dgra bo tshal pa tshal pa/ snying khrag la mā ra ya rbad dza dzaḥ 'di mngon rtogs dbang btsan par byas kyi/ dpe rnying mang po na nub dang byang go brjes par yang 'jug go / hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs na/ /pho brang chen po spos ngad ldan/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung*/ /sku mdog dkar po bse khrab gsol/ /gser gyi rmog zhu gyen du brdzes/ /phyag na gau'u rgyud mang bsnams/ khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /dri za 'bum gyi dmag dang bcas/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud/ /dgra bo'i yul du nas/ lha chen dmag la chos kyi bar gong gtso bo'i skabs bzhin/ ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs na/ /pho brang chen po chos kyi 'phags/ /rgyal po chen po'i 'phags skyes po/ /ma he brjid pa'i= sku mdog sngon po bse khrab gsol/ /gser gyi= phyag na ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ khyod ni dmag dpon= gshin rje 'bum gyi= dmag dpung bskyed la= sogs gong bzhin/ ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs na/

/pho brang chen po rgya mtsho gling*// rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang*/ /chu srin bsnol ba'i= sku mdog dmar po= gser gyi= phyag na sku gdung 'od 'bar bsnams/ khyod ni= klu bdud 'bum= dmag dpung bskyed sogs gong bzhin/ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na/ /pho brang chen po lcang lo can/ /las byed rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /sku mdog ljang nag= seng ge brjid= gser gyi= phyag na dgra 'joms dbyug to bsnams/ khyod ni= gnod sbyin 'bum= dmag dpung sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ bh+ri ta raṣ+ta yā swāhā/ oṃ bai ru ḍha ka ya swāhā/ oṃ bai ru pak+ṣa ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shrā ba ṇa ya swāhā/ zhes phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma la sngar bzhin sman raka sgreng ngo*/ / sras mchog dam pa'i rā hu la/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i mche ba can/ /gsod pa'i las la rab tu brtson/ /phyogs mtshams skyin thang 'khor lo can/ /bdag go dgra bo dbang du bsdus/ /dam nyams rnams la cog 'gyel thong*/ /bcol ba'i las la mthu ma chung*/ /gnod sbyin dha na srog gi gshed/ /dregs pa chen po rtsa rgyud 'dren/ /sku mdog gser nag 'bar ba la/ /lag na mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs/ /gang nas gang du rbad tsam na/ /dgra bo'i srog rtsa drongs las shog

/bcol ba'i= gnod sbyin ka la srog gi gshed/ /bdud 'dul nag po mche ba can/ /lag na be con me 'bar thogs/ / dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod las shog /bcol ba'i= bdud 'dul chen po ku be ra/ / lag na ral gri phur bu thogs/ /'dul ni bstan pa 'jig pa 'dul/ /dgra bo'i mi phyugs phyags mas thob/ /bcol ba'i= de yi bka' dpung gshed do bzhi/ /dregs pa bum rna ba dan 'phyar/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i snying nas drongs/ / dregs pa dung rna rtse gsum thogs/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i snying la rgyob/ /dregs pa dril rna dbyug tho 'dzin/ /bstan pa bshigs pa'i mgo lus chom/ /gnod byed kha phung thal bar rlog /dregs pa drag 'dul rna bo che/ /lag na mdung dmar zangs se zangs*/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dmag tshogs chom/ /dregs pa kha bgrad dgra bgegs 'dul/ /bdag gi dgra bo rdul du rlogs/ / dun dun rmugs sogs kyi drag sngags brjod do/ / hūṃ srin po ya ma rā dza'i sku/ /smug nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /smyos shig ya ma me dak+ṣe/ /gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /ser nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams= dkrugs shig= bdud po ar+ya dmar po'i sku/ /dmar nag= dam nyams= rdungs shig= gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ni/ /ljang nag= dam nyams= song zhig= dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nyi zla spa ra ya/ dmag dpon chen po sha ta ya/ / biṣ+ta rā dza bai mā ra thang thang bh+yoḥ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad ces drag tu bzlas/ gzhan yang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /shar gyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ /sog po lcags kyi sma ra can/ /chibs su chu rta sngon po chibs/ /phyag na gcod byed ral gri bsnams/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /lho yi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ /gnod sbyin zangs ma'i 'be slog can/ /chibs su btsan rta dmar po chibs/ /rab tu khros nas mda' gzhu 'gengs/ /dam nyams= nub kyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/

/bdud po dar nag g.yang gzhi can/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po chibs/ /phyag na dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar/ /dam nyams= byang gi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ /skyes bu 'ob kyi 'gying gzhu can/ /chibs su rgyal rta dkar po chibs/ /phyag na dar dkar g.yab mo 'debs/ /dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog /oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa tri sa ra pra ya hūṃ 'bor ba 'bor ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo bh+yoḥ drag tu bskul/ phyag rgya bdud 'dul bka' nyan ni/ /dam can phyogs bzhi'i dgra 'dul ma/ /lcags kyu 'bar bas snying nas drongs/ /zhags pa 'bar bas gnas nas khug /lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdoms/ /dril bu 'bar bas rdul du rlogs/ /gzhan yang pho nya dam can ni/ /sde brgyad nam mkha' gang ba rnams/ /gnod sby-in rgyal po'i bka' byung gi /bdag gis bcol ba'i las mdzod cig / ces bskul lo/ /de nas tshogs kyi bya ba ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs ni/ tshogs dang po mchod pa/ gnyis pa bshags pa/ gsum pa sgral mchod de/ tshogs phud rim pa gsum gyi cho ga yig rnying rnams las mang du 'byung mod kyi/ re zhig bzhag la/ phud mdor bsdus don tshang tsam du byas na/ phud bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /chos kun sgyu mar rig pas na/ /raṃ las ye shes me spros te/ /dngos dang dngos med bag chags bsregs/ raṃ gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ yaṃ las ye shes rlung*/ bag chags gtor/ yaṃ/ baṃ las ye shes chu/ bag chags bkrus/ baṃ/ oṃ mahā ba liṃ sogs dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes su gsol/ /na maḥsarba badz+ra pū dza swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zla ba la sogs snying po can/ /mngar ba la sogs ro mchog gsol/ /me tog la sogs tsan dan dri/

/bzang dgu 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mi mo la sogs reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor ma/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /oṃ ru pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar+sha/ rak+ta/ a mṛ ta ga ṇa pū dza sa ma ya swāhā/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad nas/ /da lta tshe lus 'di bskyed phan chad du/ /lus ngag yid kyi nyes ltung sdig pa'i tshogs/ /nongs shing 'gal 'khrul thams cad bzod par gsol/ /sku'i nyams chags tshogs kyis bskang*/ /gsung gi nyams chags tshogs kyis bskang*/ /thugs kyi nyams chags tshogs kyis bskang*/ /skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ / tshogs cha gsum pa bsgrub bya'i gzugs su bya ba'am mos te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir bkug ste tshogs gtor la thim par gyur/ hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥganod byed dgra bgegs thams cad hrīḥ.a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ byang gi phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ /dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin drag po sprul par 'gyed/ /drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ /dgra bgegs khug la sgrol bar mdzod/ /de yi bka' nyan pho nya ni/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po kha ṭ+wāṃ kha/ /de yi yang sprul pho nya ni/ /gnod sbyin lcags kyi sde ku can/ /las ngan dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phyir/ /byang gi phyogs nas las mdzod cig /hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥsarba bigh+nān shā trun kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis bsgral bar bsam/ shā trun mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dum bur gtubs te spungs/ na mo dus gsum bde gshegs zhal du bstab po kha raṃ khā hi/ de bzhin du/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i zhal du= ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du= /chos skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi zhal du= sring mo gsod byed bzhi'i zhal du=

thugs sprul rgyal po bzhi'i zhal du= gnod sbyin gshin rje srin po'i zhal du= phyogs skyong lha srin sde brgyad zhal du= snying po gnyis kyi mthar/ e daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa la khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ sarba pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis tshogs gtor lhan cig tu bsngo/ a kā ro lan gsum mam bdun sogs kyis kyang gtso 'khor thams cad la 'phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bzlas pa cung zad bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ las byed gnod sbyin mdung dmar can sku mdog dmar po/ pho nya drag gtum gyi gzugs go chas can/ mdung dmar dang sku gdung bsnams pa/ 'khor las byed bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ srog dang dbugs la dbang byed pa/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po ma ru tse/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan mchog/mthu stobs bsam mi khyab la bstod/ /sgrol gying shaṃ shaṃ rtsed rtsed sha sha ra dza ma ni gying ka ra kriṃ kriṃ yaṃ yaṃ shog shog bsdus bsdus khyer thung khyer thung gying rā dza ma ni bh+yoḥ zhes srog sngags mang du bzlas la/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar/ e daṃ ba liṃ ta sogs gong bzhin sbyar la gtor ma phul/ gtum po yaṃ yaṃ sgrol gying yaṃ yaṃ ma ru tse las la yaṃ yaṃ/ zhes pa'i rbad sngags cung zad bzlas la/ raka phud kyis gtor zhing*/ hūṃ bar snang khams kyi gying rgod ku be ra/ /sku mdog dmar nag khrag rul baṃ gyi mdog / ba spu ser nag tsha tsha sngo dmar 'khyug kha rlangs sngo dmar nad kyi rlangs pa 'thol/ /keng rus mche gtsigs khrag gi kha phru 'debs/ /dug sbrul nag pos ral pa thod du bcings/ /rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi zhwa ru gsol/ /thod 'phreng bdud kyi g.yang gzhi phrag la bkal/

/g.yas na mi mgo'i rnga brdung di ri ri/ /g.yon na mi rkang gling bu kyu ru ru/ /seng ge chibs nas dam nyams khrag rjes gcod/ /nyams pa'i lus srog phrol cig mā ra ya/ /gying rgod ku be ra yi dus la bab/ /rdo rje rnam thos sras kyi dus la bab/ / ces brjod/ tring tring ra dza ma ni snying shad shad hang hang mā ra ya ni du dza dgra bo'i srog rtsa la mā ra ya du dzaḥ zhes drag tu bskul lo/ /'di'i drag gtor gyi cho ga'i yan lag tu/ tshogs phud kyi bsgral mchod ma gtogs/ ling sgrol gyi gsal kha med pas/ cho ga'i yan lag tu med mi rung ma yin la/ spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir byed la/ de bzhin du gser skyems dang*/ sgo dbye 'phrang sol sogs spros pa byed na'ang 'dir byed/ spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas drag gtor gnyis dgra phyogs su spags te/ bh+yoḥ srid pa'i lha 'dres dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma yo'o/ /las ngan srid pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /chos la bar gcod byed du byung*/ /bdud mo ming sring rgyal mo bzhi/ khros pas sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /bzhengs shig pho nya dbyings nas bzhengs/ /skyod cig chibs la myur du skyod/ /srog zan chen po da skyod cig /shar nas dkar mo'i tshogs rnams skyod/ /lho nas ser mo'i tshogs rnams skyod/ /nub nas dmar mo'i tshogs rnams skyod/ /byang nas ljang mo'i tshogs rnams skyod/ /sprul pa nag mo'i tshogs rnams skyod/ /yang sprul mi bzad tshogs rnams skyod/ /ma thogs myur du las mdzod cig /bdag gi dgra bo las ngan 'di'i/ /tsit+ta phyung la khyer las shog /byams sdug gnyen dang myur du phrol/ /rten pa rgya mtsho'i mtha' la skyod/ /yul sa bskor nas 'gangs su chod/ /smyo 'bog thong zhig tsit+ta dkrugs/ /'o dod mchi bshal brang lag rdobs/ /ltas ngan nad yams dgra la thong*/ /mi nad phyugs nad rim nad thong*/ /dgra bgegs mun nag sros dus la/

/thugs chen bla 'bod 'khyams su chug /mtshon cha dug dang tsha ba'i nad/ /rang gis rang la skud du chug /rbad pa'i las chen da mdzod cig /dus la bab po sa mā ya/ hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ dgra bo che ge mo la bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ zhes pa'i mthar/ las mkhan mdung dmar can gyi sngags gsum sbrel nas bzla bzhin du/ las mkhan gyi drag gtor 'phangs/ de'i rjes su rgyal chen gyi drag gtor 'phen/ de dag gi mthar/ zor sna tshogs pa 'phen rgyu yod na yang 'phen la/ hūṃ bai traka rak+sha bh+yoḥ prig prig chum chum her her raka mo snying rtsa la breng breng dung dung bh+yoḥbh+yoḥraka sha bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ zhes g.yang gzhi gdab cing ral pa sprug /de nas slob dpon gyis rting mnan te 'ongs la/ nang du mchod bstod rgyas par bya zhing tshogs la longs spyad/ rjes kyi cho ga ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bstod pa bsdus pa byed na/ lha tshogs dbugs 'byin lha min 'joms la dpa'/ /mi bzad bdud 'dul cha lugs bstan pa skyong*/ /byang phyogs rgyal po bdud rgyal rnam thos sras/ /'khor bcas sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la bstod/ / nang sgrub la/ byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i lha/ /gsod byed gshin rje'i cha byad can/ /mdung dmar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bya zhing gzhan la'ang 'don pa spos pas rung ngo*/ /'dir spros pa la dga' na zor 'phen pa'i gnas su yang*/ gong du bshad pa'i las la bskul ba de dag ci rigs pa sngon du btang nas/ srid pa'i lha 'dre dpang mdzod cig sogs kyis btang ngo*/ /gtor ma'i lag len cung zad tsam/ yi ger bris pa'i dge ba las/ nyon mongs dgra tshogs kun bcom nas/ /thar pa'i dga' ston 'byed par shog /de ltar na 'di ni drag las spyi dril du byas pa yin la/ gtso bo nang sgrub la mos na dkyus la/ sku mdog dmar po mdung dang ne'u le 'dzin pa yin kyang*/ drag las 'ba' zhig la mchod rten nag po 'dzin par byed/

'khor lo rtsibs bzhi nang du byas nas sras bzhi 'god/ phyi ma rtsibs brgyad la phyogs bzhir bdud mo bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir blon po bzhi bkod na rung*/ drag las kho na la blon po bzhi'i phyag mtshan ne'u le rnams nad rkyal du bsgyur ba yin no/ /cho ga gzhan gong bzhin mngon rtogs dang*/ ri rgyal lhun po ma la 'don pa bsgyur/ dgra chos kyi sngon la bstod pa dmag chas ma 'di gyer ro/ / rgyal chen rnam sras mdung dmar can/ /chibs su sngon po rgab nag chibs/ /rol du ngang pa phum dmar rol/ /seng ge rngam pa pho nyar 'gyed/ /snga long g.yas nas sras kyi tshogs rnams gshegs/ /phyi long g.yon nas btsun mo'i tshogs rnams gshegs/ /dbus nas rgyal chen gtso bo bzhengs pa ni/ / rin chen rgyan dang bse khrab khra bo gsol/ /phyag na bse mdung dmar po bsnams/ /dbu la bse yi rmog zhu gsol/ /zhabs la bse yi go khrab mnabs/ /bse yi rmog zhu chen po la/ /rgod kyi dang ru ldems se ldems/ /dar dmar cod pan pu ru ru/ /bse khrab de ni sil li li/ /g.yu mthur de ni khyugs se khyugs / /rta dmag tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis bar snang gang*/ /ru mtshon dmar pos nam mkha' gang*/ /mgon po dmag la chas tsam na/ /sa gzhi ri rab 'dar zhing g.yo/ /dgra bo'i yul mkhar rmangs nas zhig /'dir gshegs rgyan gyis gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / ces pa'o/ /rnam thos sras bka' gter gyi chos skor rnams/ g.yer bo jo ston las brgyud nas rim pas so sor gyes pa'i lugs srol mang po byung ba las/ khro lo nas brgyud pa dang*/ sbal ti dgra bcom pas brgyud pa gnyis po 'di ngo mtshar che bar byed/ gnyis ka la bka' gter gyi man ngag thams cad bzhugs mod kyang*/ mngon spyod drag po'i skabs khro lo phyogs rnams gsar ma drag byed la gtso bor mdzad/ sbal ti phyogs rnams gsang sgrub rnying ma 'di kho na la gtso bor mdzad pa 'dug

/yang kha skad du/ rnam sras la zhi ba gsar ma zab/ drag po rnying ma zab kyang zer ba ltar/ drag byed las rta sngon can 'di las myur bar grags/ gsang sgrub 'di la'ang gshin rje khram thogs kyi rgyud sogs snubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skabs su byung ba'i bka' ma la/ sku mdog nag po 'di byung ba yin/ gnyal ba nyi she'i gtor ma la gzhan 'dra ba las sku mdog dmar por byed de/ spyir gnyal ba'i gter ma'i skor la/ phyi lha ltar sgrub pa/ nang ma mo ltar sgrub pa/ gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro ltar sgrub pa zhes kha skad du grags 'dug dang po ni ser chen sprin gseb ma'i skor yin/ gnyis pa dmar po bdud mo bzhi skor la ngos 'dzin/ gsum pa mdung dmar can gyi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa rta sngon ma yin zer/ bzhi pa ni phyag mtshan bzhi par grags par yin zhes 'dod/ 'on kyang mdung dmar rta sngon can nang sgrub dang*/ gshin rje mo bzhi skor 'di gsang sgrub yin par nges shing*/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la gshin rje ltar sgrub pa zer ba ni kha skad bla thabs su bsnan pa tsam yin/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa dngos de rang myos byed 'bar ba sogs gshed po bzhi skor rang la zer ba yin/ spyi dril du mi byed par rkyang pa'i lugs su sgrub na/ rtsa sgrub la sras bzhi/ blon po bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi ste gtso 'khor bcu gsum dang*/ gsang sgrub ma mo bzhi skor 'di la/ ma mo bzhi dang*/ rgyal chen bzhis

chog /gshin rje bzhi skor dang*/ srin po bzhi skor yang*/ sgrub thabs logs su yod pa bzhin lha lnga pa kho na yin no/ /las mkhan mdung dmar ni/ ser chen gyi las mkhan du bshad pa gcig yod na'ang sgrub thabs 'dra min yod/ 'di drag po'i skor du gtogs pa'o/ /de ltar na rnam sras drag gtor gyi cho ga'i ngag 'don mdo tsam yid yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bar skabs su sbyar ba'o/ /gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang ba nyer mkho bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang ba byed par 'dod na/ rten dgram/ lnga tshar dang mchod pa bsham/ bskang gtor ni dpal gtor gru gsum rab tu rgyas pa la/ 'khor can du byed na/ bshos phran phra mo bcu gcig gis bskor ba dang*/ rgyun gtor zur gsum pa gcig kyang bsham/ mdun kyi 'og phyogs su las mkhan gnyis kyi gtor ma bsham/ gsang spyi'i tshul du bshos bu bud med kyi mgo can rgyan dang ldan pa/ g.yas g.yon du gshog pa can du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa 'grub na legs/ yang bsdu na dpal bshos snying gzugs ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa kho nas kyang chog / sman dang rak+ta dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ spyan gzigs rgya cher bsham/ gtor bskang la de tsam gyis chog la/ mdos bskang du byed na/ 'phying pa sogs kyi khong du mdos bca'/ ri rab dbus su nam mkha' mthing nag gam/ smugs nag gur dang bcas pa shar du khong dkar/ lhor khong ser/ nub tu khong dmar/ byang du khong sngon/ mtshams rnams su khong nag re/ thams cad kyang 'ja' ris ma yin/ gur la nang nas nag dkar dmar ser sngon po/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad do/ / 'ja' ris gzhan rnams de dang 'dra rung la/ phyi'i mdog so so rgya che bar bya/ bang rim tha ma la nam mkha' 'ja' ris ma chung ba bcu gnyis/ nam mkha' thams cad kyi mdun du rgyang bu re/ g.yas su mda' re/ g.yon du 'phang re bya/ de btsug mi bde na nam mkha' phan tshun gyi bar du mda' 'phang rgyang gsum btsug pa'i chog

/ri rab kyi rtse mo'i dbus su bud med drel zhon/ shar du seng zhon/ lhor rnga mong ngam stag zhon/ nub tu sbal pa'am mdzo zhon/ byang du sbrul lam rta la zhon pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir mi mo bzhi dang*/ skong bu bzhi/ gzhan bud med kyis gzugs 'brang rgyas/ bshos bu/ mtheb kyu/ chang bu/ lug nag bya nag 'bri mo dre'u/ rma bya'i mdongs dang*/ dar tshon sna tshogs pa gang 'byor bsham mo/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang*/ sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs nas bzung*/ dgra bo kun 'dul gnas 'dir byon/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ mthing nag chen mo gshegs su gsol/ / grub pa'i rgyal mo gshegs su gsol/ /nag bzang mthu chen gshegs su gsol/ /he la 'bar ma gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje gshog rgod gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje dbang sgrub gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje sna yon gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje mdzo zhon gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje rgyang grags gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje rab brtan gshegs su gsol/ /gnas 'dir ma gcig lha mo spyan 'dren no/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir khyod bsten no/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dul phyir da tshur byon/ /rak+ta mtsho ltar skyil lo da tshur byon/ /gtor ma ri ltar spungs so da tshur byon/ /dam rdzas sa steng khyab po da tshur byon/ /ma gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis spyan 'dren no/ /dam las ma 'da' gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / tshigs bcad 'di dag gyer bya zhing*/ de rjes raka mo du ra zhes pa nas/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis bar gtor chog bzhin/ hūṃ thod rus 'bar bas gtams ba'i gzhal yas su/ /mthing nag phyogs med zla ba kham pa'i steng*/ /rlung gi bong bu ga dmar gdan steng du/ /lcags kyi drel rta rkang gsum gdan steng du/ /seng ge stag chen rngam pa'i gdan steng du/ /mi dmar bya mo nag mo'i gdan steng du/ /pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan khri la/

/ma gcig dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /bh+yauḥ srid gsum dbang bsdud = sogs bya/ gnyis su med par bstim/ bar 'dir mchod 'phreng ni/ rang byung gdod nas grub pa yi/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin 'di/ /rtsa ba brgyad la lo ma stong*/ /dmar chen mchod dang maṃ sa gsum// ga bur shel gyi spos phor dri/ /sangs rgyas stong gi thugs dam ste/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dam tshig go /dam tshig sbyin pa chen po 'di/ /sbyin no stabs so sku la gsol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gdung bas lha mo 'bar ma mchod/ /thugs rjes dgongs la dngos grub stsol/ /mahā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūṃ khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba 'di/ /dam nyams dgra bo 'di lags kyi/ /gzugs phung : shing lnga £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· shig la £© rnam shes thon/ /bla srog khug la da lta sgrol/ /sha khrag nang khrol rol te mchod par bzhes/ /tshil bu rus chen rkang rnams mchod par bzhes/ /go ro tsa na ba su ta la rol/ /tsit+ta dmar po 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ traka rak+sha ma ra ya/ dgra bo kha raṃ khā hi/ lha min pham byed rab brtan ma/ /lha rnams rgyal byed rab brtan ma/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /ba ling ban+dha'i bcud blangs nas/ khor yug rtogs pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /gsol zhig rol zhig kha raṃ khā hi/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla bre 'phan/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /phyi yi mchod pa ci mchis rnams/ /nam gru khyod la mchod pa 'bul// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig / bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /rak+ta gsang ba'i ar+ghaṃ 'di/ /dbang po sna lnga'i me tog dang*/ /tshil chen bsur chen bdug spos dang*/ /zhun chen sgron me snang gsal dang*/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dri chab dang*/

don snying rnam lnga'i zhal zas bkram/ /thod rnga rkang gling rol mo'i sgra/ /nang gi mchod pa ci mchis rnams/ nam gru = sogs gong bzhin/ myos byed kun gyi bcud bsdus pa/ /kun da 'khyil ba byang chub sems/ /ma nyams nyi 'od rak+ta'i rdul/ /dri chu sman dang klad pa sogs/ /mdangs dang stobs dang bde ba'i rgyu/ /rab tu gsol zhig dam tshig can/ /thabs shes dbyer med mnyam par sbyor/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /nam gru = sogs gong bzhin/ rak+ta stong gi mchod pa bzhes/ /sha sna stong gi mchod pa bzhes/ /snying sna stong gi mchod pa bzhes/ sman sna stong gi mchod pa bzhes/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan 'phan dang gdugs/ /chibs dang bang mdzod na bza' sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di 'bul gyi/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / ces mchod 'phreng gyer bstod pa ni/ chos skyong rgyal mo gshog rgod ma/ /srog bdag rgyal mo gsal shing can/ /dam nyams gsal shing rtse la tshugs/ /dgra bgegs brlag byed da tshur byon/ /byang shar mtshams kyi re ma tī// dur khrod chen po'i nang zhig nas/ /mi ro rta ro gdan steng nas/ /'khor ni ma mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'od 'bar ma/ /dbu la g.yu yi go cog gsol/ /bse yi gdong la nor bus brgyan/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag chil li li/ /spyan gsum me 'bar tal la la/ shangs nas rlung 'tshub dud pa 'thul/ /zhabs kyis dgra bo'i glo snying brdzi/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir mi bzad mche ba gtsigs/ /srid gsum sgrol byed mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /yun du mi 'bral lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /bdag gi 'chi bdag bzlog la bdud 'di srungs/ /'di dang skye ba kun tu gdong grogs mdzod/ /rgyun gyi mgon dang gnyen bshes khyod kyis gyis/ /bsten pa'i 'os su lha mo khyod bsten no// mchod pa'i 'os su rnal 'byor bdag gis mchod/ /sgrub pa'i 'os su sngags dang phyag rgya bsgrub/

/dam tshig dus la bab po dam can ma/ khyod la bstod pa 'bul gyi dgyes par mdzod/ /bka' yi pho nya chu srin mgo /dkar mo zhal gyi pho nya mo/ /sngon mo ral ba 'dzings pa mo/ /dmar mo chen mo gtum pa mo/ /ser mo rdo rje kha la bzhad/ /bka' nyan ba lang drel sna mo/ /mgyogs byed khri sman sa le ma/ /sprul pa stag seng dur bya'i tshogs/ /las byed mkha' 'gro grangs las 'das/ /ma mo bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /rdzu 'phrul dpag yas 'phrin las sgrub/ / 'khor bcas bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ / zhes so/ /de rjes tad+ya thā sogs bzlas pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sogs gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ slar yang*/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /dam rdzas mchod yon 'bar ba 'di/ /nam gru 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam skongs la phrin las mdzod/ /oṃ mahā kā li re ma tī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du rol mo nas/ shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar ro/ bstod pa ni/ bh+yauḥ nam gru khyod kyi cho 'brang dang*/ /mtshan nyid kyang ni bshad bya na/ / nor bu'i rang bzhin khyod kyi lus/ /rgyab ni dzam bu chu mo'i gser/ khyod kyi gdong ni dngul yin te/ /lte ba'i ngos ni rdo rjes gtams/ /ming po mdzod dang mdzod bsrung pa/ khyod kyi ma ni kun 'gro ma/ khyod kyi pha ni rlung zhes bya/ skal ldan shing rta khyod kyi lus/ /lha yul du'ang grags pa yin/ /mtshan mo nag mo 'jigs byed ma/ /gshin rjes sring mo chen po ste/ /srin mo yongs 'du'i bdag mor bstod/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrubs shig / ces bya/ 'phrin las gzhol/ de nas bskang rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug ting nge 'dzin drug gis byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya kho nas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas bskang ba mdor bsdus pa ni/ kyai/ ma gcig gnyen gyi re ma tī/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel yal gam can/ /dam las ma 'da' srung ma'i tshogs/

/dam can ma mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag gis gdung bas bos pa'i tshe/ /ma thogs myur du tshur byon cig/ dam can ma ni gcig bos kyang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho kun kyang 'byon/ /thugs dam can du 'dra lags kyang*/ /dpal gyi lha mo sna la byon/ /ming po bdag gis bos pa'i tshe/ /ma mo srin ltar 'khor zhing byon/ /ma mo glog ltar khyug gin byon/ /dam can 'khor bcas da tshur byon/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul/ /bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ /bsten pa'i tshe na ru ma nga*/ khur ba'i tshe na brjid pa che/ /mngags pa'i tshe na rtsal ma zhan/ /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /shrī mahā kā li dza dza hūṃ/ bh+yauḥ dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ /lha mo chen mo nam gru ma/ /rjong mo chen mo dka' bzlog ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /byis pa kun gyi dur byed ma/ dur khrod 'bar ba'i lo ma can/ /rak+ta chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mthu mo che/ /bar snang khams kyi glog ma sprin/ kha nas me 'bar rgya mtsho skem/ / lag na rdo rjes ri rab snyil/ /ral ba nag po stong khams khebs/ kha nas zhing khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /nyin gyi dus su rtog byed ma/ /mtshan gyi dus su rgyu byed ma/ /nag mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /sha chen tshogs ni ri ltar spungs// tsit+ta'i tshogs ni rdza ltar lhags/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khyil/ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /nag mo kha la dza ya du/ sa ma ya ho/ ru lu ru lu snying kha la ma ti dun bh+yauḥ zhes rgyun rol dang bcas pas gtor ma la rak+ta bran/ bh+yoḥ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /rlung nag sgor rlung 'tshub pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma gcig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /lha mo chen mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskangs/ /sha khrag gtor mas= tshogs kyi mchod pas=

dmar chen khrag gis= tshil chen spos kyis= sna tshogs rol mos= spyan gzigs du mas= dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis= bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhis= bsten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /mi dbang snying gis= rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs phyir/ /mi rkang gling bus= 'dod pa'i gtso mo yin pa'i phyir/ /rma bya'i rgyal mtshan= shangs kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i/ /sha chen dud pas= mgur gyi gsang nas drangs pa'i phyir/ /dmar chen rak+tas= nyams chags ma lus bskang ba'i phyir/ /bya lug smug nag gis= dpal gyi lha mo'i= rgyal gar yul du mtshan gsol ba/ /he la 'bar ma'i= u rgyan yul du mtshan gsol ba/ /rdo rje sna yon thugs= za hor yul du mtshan gsol ba/ /rdo rje mdzo zhon= dkar chung rgyal sder mtshan gsol ba/ /rdo rje gshog rgod= tho li srung mar mtshan gsol ba/ /rdo rje dbang grub thugs= rgyan gong gnas su mtshan gsol ba/ /rdo rje rab brtan ma'i= /bstan srung chen mo'i= sngags bsrung chen mo'i= sgra ni 'brug las shin tu che/ /ma mo 'bum sde'i= dgra sha za zhing dgra khrag 'thung*/ /sprul pa 'bum sde'i= ming po klu chen thod dkar= las mkhan klu bdud nag po'i= las bzhi sgrubs mdzad mkha' 'gro'i= ljang nag chu srin gdong gi= ba li drel sna khri sman sa le sogs/ /bka' nyan ma mo 'bum= bstan ma bcu gnyis tshogs kyi= nyams chags bskangs shing chos 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /nges don bstan pa phyogs bcur dar ba dang*/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /'dod don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ dpal gyi lha mo 'jigs gzugs ma/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje gshog rgod ma/ /gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum las lhag /sprul pa stong gsum bye ba khyab/ /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /klu bdud nag po pho nyar 'gyed/

/phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /bdud tshogs 'joms shing nyon mongs gcod/ /bstan dgra thal ba rdul du rlog / g.yon pa ne'u le rin chen char/ /dgos 'dod dngos grub thams cad stsol/ / mnga' thang longs spyod stsal du gsol/ khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ / bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /nag mo khyod kyi zhal du thob/ /rol zhig : sprul £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· skul £© zhig kha ram khā hi/ /lha mo de yi khol mo ni/ /srin mo dmar 'dabs phur bu'i lha/ /klu mo gzhogs zha chu srin mgo /gang 'phrad de yi srog la gcod/ /gsod pa'i mtshon cha lag na thogs/ /bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma zhon/ /pho nya chu srin mang po 'gyed/ /'dir byon dam dgongs 'phrin las mdzod/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dkar mo rdo rje pho nya mo/ /na bza' bya rgod thul pa gsol/ /dkar mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /'dir byon= lho yi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /sngon mo ral pa 'jongs pa mo/ /sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /sngon mo bye ba= 'dir byon= nub kyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dmar mo chen mo gtum pa mo/ /sku la 'brug gi slog pa gsol/ /dmar mo bye ba= 'dir byon= byang gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /ser mo kha la bzhad pa mo/ /sku la stag gi pags pa gsol/ /ser mo bye ba= 'dir byon= 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i lha mo rnams/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs thod gdong can/ /phyag na ral gri thod khrag bsnams/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las 'di sgrub/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal shed nas/ /rdo rje ba lang drel sna mo/ /gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i thod gdengs can/ /phyag gnyis zhing lpags thod rlon bsnams/ /chibs su dre'u nag kha dkar chibs/ /ma bdud kun gyi sna 'dren ma/ /'dir byon= de yi sngon la 'gro ba ni/ /ma yams nag mo kun gyi rje/ /phyag na thod pa khrag gang bsnams/ /chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs/ /stag gzigs dom nag stong gis bskor/

/'dir byon= rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rim nas/ /rdo rje khri sman sa le ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan ban+dha 'dzin/ /chibs su so bya rog po chibs/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i dmag sna 'dren/ /'dir byon= nag mo chen mo ha la mo/ /lag na thod pa khrag gang 'dzin/

/chibs su srid pa rlung la chibs/ /grong mtha' skor zhing nad yams 'bebs/ /'dir byon= ming po klu chen thod dkar yang*/ /dkar gsal sbrul mgo bum pa 'dzin/ /chibs su klu rta dkar sngon chibs/ /sa bdag klu gnyan 'bum gyis bskor/ /'dir byon= las mkhan klu bdud nag po yang*/ /phyag na ru mtshon zhags pa thogs/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po zhon/ /bdud dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /'dir byon dam dgongs 'phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ dpal gyi lho mo 'khor bcas ni/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /srung ma'i tshogs bcas sku bzhengs la/ /mi mthun bar chad bzlog par mdzod/ / bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun bcas/ /rgyu sbyor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ / rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa dang*/ /gnod byed rdul phran tsam du rlog /yas kyi bdud g.yos mas kyi sri langs dang*/ /sde brgyad kha zugs dam sri'i bar chad bzlog /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ltas ngan pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi cho 'phrul gtong ba thams cad bzlog /rab byung sngags pa mu stegs bon sogs kyi/ /mthu gtad byad kha rbod gtong thams cad bzlog /sngags dang phyag rgya 'khrul 'khor ngan pa dang*/ /zor dang smod pa ngan byed rigs kun bzlog/ mtshon cha dug dang me chu'i gnod pa dang*/ /gros ngan bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad bzlog /gdon bgegs nad rims yams nad gtong ba sogs/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /mi mthun gnod pa thams cad phyi la bzlog /bde legs dngos grub stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / bar 'dir yig brgya gang nus bzla/ bshags pa ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' sdod nye ba'i nye snying ma/ /lha mo 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'da' dka' rdo rje dam tshig brtan gyi gnyer/ /yongs su mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid kyang*/ /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs phyung ba dang*/ /lta ba dpangs dma' chos nyid don ma rtogs/ /sgom pa yun thung lha mo'i sku mi gsal/

/snying po grangs nyung gra chag zur nyams dang*/ /nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyes sbyangs byas pa dang*/ /dam nyams gtam byas kha gros 'dres pa dang*/ khas blangs dam bcas dus las yol ba dang*/ /dam rdzas ma tshang gtor ma'i phud nyams dang*/ /sgom sgrub mi brtson le lo rnam g.yengs dang*/ /gsang ba'i man ngag gzhan la spel ba sogs/ /gnong 'gyod 'thol bshags bzod par gsol lags na/ /thugs rje chen pos tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig 'gal 'khrugs thams cad so sor bshags/ /mthol bshags phul nas tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes bya'o//shes shing spro na yig brgya'i gong ngam/ bshags pa'i 'jug 'di gang rung du/ dpal lha mo'i spyi bstod dang*/ 'di nyid kyi sgos bstod gang 'grub byed dgos pa yin no/ /de nas drag tu bskul zhing dgra la rbad pa mdor bsdu ba ni/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /na rag dmyal khams yan chad du/ /gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ / mchog gsum gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /lha dang 'byung po mthu bo che/ /lha srin sde brgyad dpang mdzod cig /zhal lce snang srid lha 'dres chod/ /nga yi ma nyes ma yo'o/ /sdig can 'di yis nyes kun byas/ kha smras srung ma gnyan pos thogs/ /dam nyams sdig can gshed ma 'dis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshig /dkon mchog dbu 'phang 'di yis smad/ /bla ma'i bka' dang dam las 'das/ /srung ma khyod la bdo phod btsugs/ /rig 'dzin rnams la do bdos so/ /bdag ni srung ma khyod la 'bod/ /lha srin sde brgyad ram zla bzlog /srid gsum mthu chen khyed rnams kyi/

/las kyi pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /dam can tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs/ /bka' sdod tshogs ni glog ltar 'khyug /dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /da lta nyid du 'dir khug cig /gnam gyi 'ju thag skya bo chod/ /sa yi lte phur nag po phyung*/ /las kyis rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /dus kyi mun pas mdun nas bsus/ kha nas zungs khrag skyug tu chug khong pa'i nang nas snying phyung zhig /dpral pa'i dbyings nas mig phyung zhig /ltag pa'i phyogs nas bdud chod cig /rgyu ma nang khrol thang la pho/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa myur du chod/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ ma mo 'khor bcas dgra la bh+yoḥ sde brgyad dam nyams dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra bo bla tshe thum ril bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i bla srog thum ril bh+yo/ /dgra bo'i dbugs rngubs thum hril bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs srog la breng breng rgyug /dgra bgegs snying la rbad shaka bh+yoḥ zhes pa dang*/ rol mo drag tu bya'o// gtor zor 'phen na'ang bskul ba 'di nyid byed pa yin/ dus rgyun gyi bskang ba la drag bskul med kyang chog go /de nas thun gyi mthar thun gtor 'bul ba'am/ gtor sgrub grol ba'i tshe 'dzin gtor 'bul na/ gtor ma khang steng du bsgrigs te/ sman rag gis bran/ rol mo byin dbab/ mtshan mo yin na gtor ma la me sgron 'dzug bh+yoḥ chos dbyings dbang phyug ma gcig bdud kyi yum/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /sde brgyad dbang sgyur dpal ldan gshin rje'i lcam/ /bka' sdod pho nya brag g.yog 'khor dang bcas/ /srin po 'bum dang ma mo bye ba'i tshogs/ /bdud dang srin mo gshin rje'i tshogs dang bcas/ /lang ka'i bdag mo zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /'dab chags gcan gzan sprul pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /dgra srog dbang byed bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ / 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig

/sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /dam rdzas sna tshogs mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan po 'bul/ /phye bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs gnyan po bzhes/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi phyogs med 'grub pa dang*/ /nges don bstan pa phyogs bcur dar ba dang*/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ de ni dam nyams dgra la bh+yoḥ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la bh+yoḥ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dgra la bh+yoḥ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la bh+yoḥ sha za khrag 'thung thams cad dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i srog la rol cig srin mo'i tshogs/ /dam nyams dgra bo da lta nyid du sgrol/ /thugs dam dus la bab po sa mā ya/ / drag rol yun ring du bya/ shis brjod cung zad cig dang bcas te nang du 'ongs/ slar yang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ / zhes pa man chad gtor chog bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar na 'di gtor ma la brten pa'i bskang ba yin la/ mdos bskang ni/ se mkhar ma sogs yi ge rnying pa bzhin du byed pa yin pa las/ gtor bskang 'di dang sbrel te byed na/ bde legs dngos grub stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ces las bcol song mtshams bshags pas sngon der mdos bskang bya/ gtor bskangs mi byed par mdos bskang logs su byed na/ /bskang rdzas byin rlabs yan chad gong bzhin byas nas/ de man chad mdos bskang kho na gzhung bsrangs pas chog blo shin tu gzhan na mdos bskang la bklags chog byed pa'i srol yang gda'o/ /dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang ba'i cho ga tshig cha mdor bsdus shing*/ cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang ba med pa 'di yang*/ don gnyer mang pos bsku' ba'i ngor/ tā ra nā thas bar skabs su smras pa'o/ /tshig 'byams ches pa las snying po bsdus pa cung zad dang*/

kha skong tshig re tsam dang*/ go rim bde bar bsgyur ba re re tsam ma gtogs phal cher gzhung dang yig rnying bzhin du bris pa'o/ / gcig zhus// maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor chog ngag 'don bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'am rdo rje gshog rgod ma'i mtshan du gsol ba 'di la/ gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul zhing bsnyen par 'dod na/ gtor ma snying gzugs ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa ji ltar 'os pas kyang rung la/ 'khor las mkhan gnyis la bshos phran zur bzhi sbrul thod can re/ gtso mo'i gtor ma'i mdun du bshom pa'ang 'dug pa rung mod/ la las gsum po sdams pa la 'theb kyus skor ba'i lag len byed pa'ang 'dug ste/ de ni mi legs par mngon no// las mkhan gnyis kyi gtor ma logs su byed na/ snod logs par bcug ste 'og tu bshams na legs/ 'on kyang bskang ba'i skabs yin na ma gtogs/ rgyun gyi nyams len dang bsnyen pa'i skabs/ de gnyis la logs su gtor ma bsham mi dgos zhor byung gis chog go /de'i mdun du nang mchod dang rak+ta bsham/ chu dang nyer spyod sogs spyi dang mthun par bsgrig /yang rgyun khyer shin tu bsdus pa'i skabs gtor ma gru gsum rang zhig bcas te/ de nyid 'dod yon kun 'dus yin pas mchod pa gzhan ma bsham kyang bsngo ru rung ngo*/ /de nas yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ yi dam gang yin de ka'i lugs kyi gtor ma dang nang mchod lhan cig byin rlabs byas pas rung la/ rak+ta yang nang mchod kyi zhor la 'grub pa'i lugs sam/ yang na a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ gsum las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi steng du raṃ gsum las me'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du a gsum las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba gsum/ gtor ma'i gnas su bza' ba dam rdzas kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa thams cad sha lnga'i rnam par gyur te/

dbus su mi sha hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ shar du ba lang gi sha oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ lhor khyi'i sha traṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ nub tu rta'i sha hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ byang du glang po che'i sha aḥljang khus mtshan pa/ bdud rtsi sman gyi gnas su btung ba dang baṃ rdzas kyi bye brag rnams bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus su byang sems muṃ yig sngon pos mtshan pa/ shar du dri chen maṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ lhor dri chu maṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ nub tu rak+ta paṃ dmar pos mtshan pa/ byang du sha chen gyi dwangs ma tāṃ ljang khus mtshan pa rnams su gyur/ rak+ta'i gnas su dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag phung por raṃ yig gis mtshan pa ste/ de thams cad la rang dang 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ thams cad kyi steng du oṃ dkar po re re/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs te oṃ la thim/ oṃ yig rnams 'od du zhu nas rdzas la thim pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ mahā ba ling ta te dzo ba lang ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūṃ hrīḥtha/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la hūṃ hrīḥtha/ oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hrīḥtha/ zhes byin gyis brlab bo/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i skabs gtor ma dmar gyi rgyan dang myos byed kyis sbran pa nyid la gtor sman rag gsum tshangs pa yin no/ / a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang lcags ris bskor ba'i nang*/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang bse mkhar dmar po gru bzhi pa/ ngos bzhi gser dang*/ zur bzhi mchong las grub pa/ rmangs gzhi lcags las grub cing*/

shel gyi : skras [ skas ] btsugs pa/ de'i dbus su mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa'i gnas la/ nyi ma'i steng du kaṃ las ral gri kaṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ sku mdog smug nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar bas bstan pa bsrung zhing gdug can tshar gcod pa/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser spyi bor 'khyil ba/ mi'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ ba glang gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ re lde'i sham bu can/ sbrul rigs bzhi'i ske rags bcings pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang*/ spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ khrag zhag gi thig les brgyan zhing sku las me 'od 'phro ba/ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus na drel rta rkang gsum la chibs pa'o/ / 'dir lha mo 'di rdo rje'i gshog pa can du byed pa'i lugs gcig kyang yod pa shin tu legs pa zhig kyang yin no/ / 'khor las kyi lha mo chu srin gdong can dang*/ ba laṃ ma drel sna dang*/ khri sman sa le dang*/ las bzhi'i lha mo dang*/ dus bzhi'i rgyal mo dang*/ ma mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ / de tsam gyi kyang chog la/ las mkhan gnyis bskyed par 'dod na/ phuḥtri dzaḥ 'og phyogs g.yas zur du ming po klu chen thod dkar sku mdog dkar po/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ g.yas khram shing dang*/ g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ klu rta sngon po la zhon pa/ du tri dzaḥ g.yon zur du las mkhan klu bdud nag po/ g.yas ral gri'am ru mtshon/ g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ bdud rta nag po la zhon pa'o/

/ zhes bskyed do/ / ye shes lha mo'i sku'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum nas/ /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od zer 'phros/ /nag mo mi bzad cho 'phrul can/ /ming pos 'bod kyi da tshur byon/ khyod kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ / 'dod khams ma mo stong stong 'gyed/ /ma yi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ / las kyi ma mo stong phrag 'gyed/ /ma yi zhabs mthil g.yas g.yon nas/ /pho nya 'bum dang nyi khri 'khyed/ /bdud dang lha 'dre ngan sems can/ /dgra bo kun 'dul gnas 'dir byon/ / : nag mo £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· raka mo £© du ra dun ting bh+yoḥ kha kha du ra dun ting bh+yoḥ he ra du ra dun ting bh+yoḥ e a ra li hraṃ hriṃ dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ'adod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ /bdag ni brda yi phyag 'bul lo/ /ma mo nag mo raka mo sa ma ya a ti pū ho/ pra ti pū ho/ sa ma ya phu ho/

zhes phyag btsal/ mahā kā li de bi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag bh+yoḥ srid gsum dbang bsdud nag mo re ma tī/ /mthing nag ral pa sprin spungs 'thibs pa 'dra/ /ti ra'i gnas nas byis pa'i dur byed ma/ /mi dur gcod byed nag mo bzhugs su gsol/ /ma mo nag mo sa ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ gnyis su med par bstim/ tad+ya thā/ ru ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si/ ma mo raka mo tsit+taṃ kha rag ma bh+yoḥbh+yoḥswāhā/ zhes bzlas pa cung zad bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes gtor ma byin rlabs kha gsos la/ sngags snying po de nyid tshar gcig gi rjes la 'di 'dogs te/ oṃ ba ling ta kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ yo gi nī kha raṃ khā hi/ ḍā ki nī kha raṃ kha hī/ s+t+waṃ pa bha ga ta a ka sa la ho/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ de bzhin du snying po'i mthar/ oṃ pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ yo gi ni sogs gong bzhin/ lan gcig gam gsum gyis bdud rtsi phul/ de bzhin du oṃ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ sogs sbyar ba lan gcig gam gsum gyis rak+ta phul/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ mahā kā li re ma tī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo 'i bar dang*/ pād+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis 'don pa spo/ bsdus na sngags tsam gyis chog / bh+yoḥ lha la dbang bsgyur lha mo dpal 'bar ma/ /dbang phyug chen mo sras mo gzi ldan ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi bdag mo ste/ /lha mo re ma tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud la dbang bsgyur bdud mo dpal 'bar ma/ /re ti mgo yag bu mo re ma tī/ /nag mo rtse dgu'i gnas kyi bdag mo ste/ /bdud mo re ma tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu la dbang bsgyur klu mo dpal 'bar mo/ /gtsug na rin chen bu mo yid 'ong byams/

/rol mtsho bdun gyi gnas kyi gtso mo ste/ / klu mo re ma tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnod sbyin dbang bsgyur gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma/ /gang ba bzang po'i bu mo sham sham ma/ /nag tshal dra ba can gyi gtso mo ste/ /gnod sbyin re ma tī la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag chen po la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis ne'u le 'dzin/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /lha mo rdo rje dbang sgrub ma/ /'phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /nyin gsum khra ltar 'khyug cing byon/ /mtshan gsum glog ltar 'khyug cing byon/ / bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /dgra bo 'joms pa'i dus la bab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje re ma tī// rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa gsol/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shig khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bsam pa sgrubs/ / de rjes/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang mthun par yang 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o// dpal lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor chog ngag 'don 'di yang don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /'di'i gtor chog ngag 'don phyis bsgrigs pa 'ga' re 'dug kyang*/ rnying ma la gsar ma bas dbang bzas pa'i stabs dgos ngos shes pa 'ga' re chad 'dug pa skabs 'dir cha 'grig par byas sa ོ/ / gcig zhus// maṅga laṃ//

༄༅/ /yas gtam dang bsngo ba mdor bsdus bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ yas gtam dang bsngo ba mdor bsdus pa ni/ 'di ltar dngos grub 'byung gnas rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma/ don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas/ sgrib gnyis mun sel skyob pa dam chos/ rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ skyabs bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams na bzhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ sgos bkra shis kyi gtsug lag khang 'di nyid na zhes sam/ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i pho brang 'di nyid na zhes skabs dang sbyar/ ngo mtshar gzi 'od 'phro ba'i nor bu/ byin rlabs chu brgya 'bab pa'i gangs ri/ nyon mongs dri ma 'khrud pa'i dag byed/ mchog gsum gyi rten rmad du byung ba rnams/ bdud dpung ri bo 'joms pa'i gnam lcags/ bstan pa gangs ri skyong ba'i seng ge /bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba'i srung ma/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang bcas te bzhugs/ de rnams kyi skabs 'og nas/ deng 'dir 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu mngon du gyur pa la/ bstan pa'i srog shing yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ mi che bar gyur pa rnams kyis gral gyi gzhung srang*/ yon tan mkhas par sbyangs pa rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas brgyan/ bsod nams dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i yon bdag rnams dang*/ bya ba byed pa phyag len pa dang bcas pas gral gyi mtha' nas brgyan te/ rten 'byung zab mo'i dbang las gdan 'jom par bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar 'tshogs pa thams cad dkar ba las kyis gzhi bzung*/ dag pa smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ chos dam tshig gi sgo nas 'brel ba zab/ rnam grol thar pa'i gling du/ rnam dkar dge ba'i bya ba khyad par can la 'tshogs pas/ tshogs pa yang bzang*/ skabs 'dir lo rgyus cung zad zhu 'tshal na/ /spyir lo rgyus la/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus dang*/

rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi lo rgyus dang*/ byas shes bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus te gsum las/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus la/ steng du rje'i gdung rab/ 'og tu 'bangs kyi mi rabs/ stong sde : sa'i £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· srid pa'i £© chags tshul/ /'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag ste bzhir dbye ba las/ dang po ni/ bskal pa 'di la rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po nas bzung*/ shākya'i rgyal po don thams cad grub pa yan chad du/ shākya'i rgyal brgyud sa ya chig 'bum nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya dang bcu bzhi byung ba lags/ gzhan yang*/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po/ ko sa li'i rgyal po gsal rgyal/ 'bang sa'i rgyal po 'char byed/ 'phags rgyal gyi rgyal po rab snang la sogs pa dang*/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal mya ngan med la sogs pa/ 'jig rten bde bar skyong ba'i rgyal po mtha' yas pa byon/ bod zal mo gangs kyi ra ba 'dir/ mi rje lhas mdzad pa la snga ba/ rje gnyan khri btsan po nas bzung ste/ gnam gyi khri bdun/ sa'i legs drug la sogs pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan pa ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po du ma byon pa las/ lha tho tho ri'i gnyan btsan gyi dus su dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus su srol bstod/ khri srong sde btsan gyis dus su dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ khri ral pa can gyis bla sgo dang po dge 'dun la 'bul ba sogs/ chab srid dam pa'i chos su bsgyur/ phyis de dag gi brgyud las byung ba'i/ lha bla ma khu dbon dang*/ mnga' bdag /rtse lde la sogs pas kyang*/ 'khor 'bangs bde bar skyangs shing*/ dkon mchog gsum la rgya cher mchod pa lags/ gzhan yang rgya nag dang rgya nag chen po la sogs par/ sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po dpag tu med pa byon pa lags kyang*/ skabs 'dir de tsam las gleng ba'i sngo ma thogs lags/ /gnyis pa ni bskal pa dang po'i dus su gtso bo dang*/

'khor 'bangs kyi dbye ba med/ de nas rim gyis rigs rus cho 'brang gi dbye ba tha dad par gyur pa las/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mi rigs bzhi ma 'chol bar gnas/ spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ mi rigs bzhi'i dbye ba med kyang*/ mi'u thung gdong drug la sogs pa rus kyi dbye ba du ma yod par sogs/ zhes pa tsam gyi yang chog la/ skabs 'dir yon bdag sogs dmigs gsal rigs rus nges pa can yod na/ rus kyi sde tshan de lta bu yod pa las/ deng yul khams 'di zhes bya ba nas/ rus 'di zhes bya ba'i rgyud la/ yab du btsun la yum du mdzangs pa/ dad pa dang 'byor ba dang blo gros phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa'i/ yon bdag gam dge bshes sogs 'di zhes bya ba byon pa lags/ zhes sam/ rten bzhengs pa'am/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur sogs tshogs gsog byas pa'i rigs la/ rnam dkar dge ba'i las 'di dang 'di lta bu mdzad pa lags/ zhes skabs dang sbyar te brjod/ bya ba 'gangs che ba med na brjod mi dgos/ /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten gdags pa la sogs pa chos mngon pa las/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten dang*/ khams gsum gyi rnam gzhag sogs mang du gsungs/ ji skad du/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang*/ /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ba'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ de ltar na phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang*/ 'dod khams gnas rigs nyi shu/ gzugs khams rigs bcu bdun/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi la sogs pa mtha' yas pa yod par gsungs shing*/ de bzhin du theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang mngon pa rnams las kyang mang du gsungs/ khyad par/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/
