'byung ba chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ ri rgyal lhun po sogs/ ri bdun/ gling bdun/ mtsho bdun/ 'dzam gling chen po las kyi sa dum bu bcu gnyis pa dang*/ srid rtse'i gnas gyi mthar thug par 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gsungs shing*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang*/ nam mkha' la khyim gyi 'khor lo/ gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa'i 'gros dang bcas pa/ sa gzhi dum bu bcu gnyis la/ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba sogs 'khor zhing*/ dus bzhi che chung gi rnam par bzhag pa la sogs pa dang bcas pa rgya cher gsung pa lags na'ang*/ mkhyen pa can klad nas bzhugs pas rgyas par zhu mi 'tshal/bzhi pa ni mi chos bcu drug dang*/ sgyu rtsal drug cu la sogs te/ 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams las kyang*/ rgya cher gsungs pa lags shing*/ mdor na/ 'jig rten ya rabs kyi spyod tshul la brten pa ni/ 'di dang pha rol kyi dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba lags te/ ji skad du/ mi'i chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*/ /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ / 'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs pa ltar lags/ /gnyis pa rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi lo rgyus la/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshul/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi byon tshul gsum du gleng bar gda' ba las/ de dag mdo tsam zhig snyan tu gsol na/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul la/ spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ mkha' mnyam du bzhugs pa las/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyal ba shākya seng ge 'di nyid/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs pas sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor ba yin te/ ston pa 'di sngon rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/

de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po'i drung du thugs bskyed par bshad pa dang*/ /bskal bzang las kyang*/ da ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la/ /'jam gang zhig ni rab tu phul nas kyang*/ /dang por byang chub tu ni thugs bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs/ tshogs bsags tshul yang*/ theg pa thun mong gi lugs ltar na/ ji skad du/ rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi mtha' mar byung*/ /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /kun la thams cad snying rje yis/ /sbyin par byed pas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /chags bcas yan lag bcad kyang ni/ /mi 'khrugs bzod dang tshul khrims kyi/ /skar rgyal bstod pas brtson 'grus kyi/ /de ma thag tu ting 'dzin blo'i/ /zhes gsungs te/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la rim pas/ sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong dang*/ bdun khri drug stong dang*/ bdun khri bdun stong gi bar mnyes par mdzad ces gsungs/ theg pa chen po las ni/ lam lnga dang sa bcu yongs su rdzogs par bgrod dgos pa yin pas/ 'phags pa'i sa brnyes nas/ skad cig re re yang*/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med tshad med dag yongs su mnyes pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa bsags shing rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can grangs med pa yongs su smin pa dang*/ zhing khams tshad med pa yongs su sbyangs pa yin zhing*/ sa bcu bgrod pa'i mthar 'og min gyi zhing khams su/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing*/ gzugs kyi khams dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling rnams su/ sprul pa'i sku ston par mdzad pa yin te/ ji skad du/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang*/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa dang*/

/nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ / byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ / yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ ces gsungs/ sngags kyi theg pa las ni/ ri rab kyi rtse mo dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang*/ 'og min la sogs par dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad pa mdzad pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ tshangs pa'i gnas su dus kyi 'khor lo rgyal ba mchog bcas lha yi tshogs kyis yang dag bstod pa ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ston pa byon zhing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam gzhag thun mong ma yin pa du ma byung zhing*/ gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul ni/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ 'khor lo rim pa gsum dang*/ mthar thug rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ste rim pa bzhi gsungs/ bstan pa dam chos dang*/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun 'byon tshul ni/ 'od srung chen po dang*/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo la sogs pa/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang*/ gzhan yang dgra bcom chen po rnams kyis bstan pa yun ring du skyangs shing*/ de rjes 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug la sogs pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi don la rang dbang thob pa'i/ slob dpon mtha' yas pa rnams kyis gtso cher pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gsal bar mdzad/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis/ gtso bor theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ skal ldan dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod/ de las kyang khyad par du/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dus 'khor zhabs dang*/ tsi lu pa la sogs pas/

sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzhugs gnas/ byang sham+bha la chos kyi pho brang nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang*/ sems 'grel skor gsum la sogs pa/ chos zab cing rgya che ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ sems can dpag tu med pa byang chub mchog gi lam la bkod/ bod yul 'jig rten mgon po'i zhing khams 'dir dang por chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag rkyen mdzad pa la brten/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ 'dul 'dzin dzi na mi tra la sogs pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub ches mchog tu gyur pa rnams dang*/ ska cog zhang gsum la sogs pa/ lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis chos bsgyur bshad lag len gyi sgo nas gtan la phabs/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus 'dir/ g.yo dmar gtsang gsum las/ bla chen dge ba rab gsal gyi sdom pa blangs shing*/ 'dul mngon gyi bshad pa dang lag len ma chad par mdzad/ de las brgyud nas bod yul thams cad du dge 'dun gyi sde dpag tu med pa dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang*/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab dang*/ 'brog mgos mar gsum la sogs pa/ lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams dang*/ de dag gi rjes su 'brang pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi skyes bu dam pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis/ bstan pa rin po che sgo mtha' dag nas nam langs pa dang*/ nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ khyad par rang re'i chos brgyud 'di la/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ tshig don lag len byin rlabs kyi bka' thams cad tshang bar bzhugs pa yin la/ de las khyad par du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs bcud/ grub thob thams cad kyi nyams su myong bya/ mkhas pa thams cad kyi legs par bshad pa'i snying po/ gzhan stong dbu ma che po'i lta sgom dang*/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyi lam zung du 'brel ba/

rgyal tshab 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ rgyal sras 'phags pa thogs med la sogs pa'i gzhung dang man ngag rnams dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rngog btsan gzu gsum las brgyud pa'i bshad sgrub nyams myong byin rlabs lag len rnams bka' ma chad pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'di 'gyur byed mkhan po bcu drug tsam gyis bsgyur ba las/ gyi jo rwa 'bro tsa mi sogs byin rlabs kyi bka' ma chad pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i bka' srol la/ grub thob brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i zhal gyi rim pa rnams/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa/ shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chos bdag po'i tshul gyis/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel bar mdzad pas/ byang phyogs kha ba'i ljongs 'di skal pa bzang por mdzad pa lags/ de nas spro zhing shes la dgos par yod na/ dgon sde sogs rang rang so so'i chos brgyud bla brgyud rnams kyi che ba ci rigs pa brjod/ mi spro na sngar bshad pa de tsam gyis chog go /

gsum pa byas shes bka' drin che ba'i dbang du byas na/ spyir khams gsum gyi sems can dug gsum gyi nad kyis gzir ba rnams la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ sgos mi mjed 'jig rten khams pa rnams la/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ yang sgos 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la/ 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams dang*/ sa bcu'i mgon po rnams kyi rnam 'phrul/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ nying sgos bod kha ba can pa rnams la/ dang por byon pa'i chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum/ bar du byon pa bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal mkhan brgyud dang bcas pa/ tha mar byon pa jo bo mar me mdzad dpal ye shes dang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la sogs pa/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi paṇa chen de rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par nges don snying po'i bstan pa ma nor ba gsal bar mdzad pa la/ dpal jo nang pa chen po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ sgos rang rang so so la/ lus bskyed cing 'jig rten ston par byed pa la pha dang ma/ sems bskyed cing thar lam ston par byed pa la/ bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon mkhan slob dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na/ gdugs de ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ mang ja 'dren 'gyed la sogs pa skabs su gang bab kyi tshig dang sbyar te/ dper na/ mang ja gang la bzang ba dge 'dun so so la grwal 'gyed bsngo ba'i rten dang bcas pa/ zhes pa'am/ bzang ngan rgya che chung dang bstun pa'i tshig gi brjod tshul shes na bya ste/ dper na mang ja mang po dang*/ 'gyed sogs mang ba'i skabs che ba brjod na/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ gsol ja'i bsnyen bkur grwal 'gyed kyi dngos po 'bul ba bsngo rten dang bcas pa rgya cher bshams pa ni/

bdud rtsi'i mchod yon rgya mtsho ltar bskyil/ 'bul ba'i dngos po ri ltar spungs/ mchod sbyin gyi dga' ston sa steng thams cad khyab par brdal/ rdzogs ldan gyi dpal 'byor la 'gran bzod pa lta bu sgrub par gda' zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gang ltar yang 'jug tu 'di skad ces bya ste/ de ltar legs par sgrub pa'i skabs don/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i don dang sgos su bla ma'am/ yon bdag 'di zhes bya ba'i sgo gsum gyi zhes sam/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba'i don dang*/ ji ltar bsam pa'i don nam/ de ltar bzhed pa'i don yid bzhin du 'grub cing tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor pa rnam dkar dge ba' ི mdzad pa rnams gong 'phel du 'grub pa'i don dang*/ zhes pa'i/ sku tshe brtan cing 'phrin las rnam par dkar ba gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i don du/ phyag len pa rnams kyis phyag len dag cing gtsang sbras thon par sgrub par snang bas rjes su yi rang*/ rgyu de dag las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba bkra shis kyi mtha' brten dang bcas pa'i mthun 'gyur rnams rim pa bzhin du thugs la 'dogs pa zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas bsngo ba dngos la 'jug /lo rgyus mi byed par mtshams sbyor bsdus pa tsam byed na/ khyad par can la tshogs pas tshogs pa yang bzang*/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na zhes pa man chad kyis chog /yang gtam bshad byed la/ cung zad bsdus par byed pa'i skabs yin na/ mi chos kyi lo rgyus bzhag kyang chog ste/ de ltar na 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag ste bzhir dbye ba la sogs pa mang bar gda' na'ang*/ rgyas par zhu mi 'tshal zhes bsdus nas/ gnyis pa rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi lo rgyus la zhes pa man chad gong bzhin bya/

/de yang mdo tsam du bsdu na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor bas/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya grangs med pa thar pa la bkod/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i tshul bstan/ de ltar ston pas gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyis 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring du rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/ rgyal tshab bstan pa'i gtad rab bdun/ 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug /grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyis/ 'phags pa'i yul du rgya cher dar bar mdzad/ rgyal khams gzhan rnams su yang*/ mang du dar ba dang*/ khyad par kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams dang*/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi zhes pa man chad gong bzhin sbyar bas legs par 'gyur ro/ /gshin bsngo'i skabs kyi mol gtam yin na/ gong du bstan pa dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ gral gyi mtha' nas rten te gdan 'dzom par bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dir/ lo rgyus cung zad zhu 'tshal na/ zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin du/ blo gros phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa'i yon bdag gam/ dge bshes 'di zhes bya ba 'di/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par can bsags pas/ dal 'byor gyi rten phun sum tshogs pa lugs gnyis dang rjes su 'brel ba'i legs lam phun sum tshogs pa/ skye bos smon pa'i gnas su yod pa lags kyang*/ 'dus byas spyi'i mtshan nyid la/ rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis kyang 'da' bar mi spyod na/ gzhan gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi/ / mdun na gnas pa'i 'chi ba ste/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ 'jig rten pha rol la mngon du phyogs song ba der gda' na'ang*/

dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che phyi rjes su sgrub par gda' na/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i them skas la 'dzeg bzhin pa lta bur song bas/ rjes na yod pa gzhan rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde'i gnas ma lags so/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar legs par sgrub pa'i skabs don/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i sgrib gnyis kyi phung po myur du zad pa dang*/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par can phyi bzhin du 'brangs te/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don du/ phyag len pa rnams kyis phyag len dag cing*/ zhes sogs gong bzhin brjod/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs byas pa'i ston mo dang*/ bshad ston la sogs pa'i skabs su/ gzhan spyi 'gro dang 'dra ba las/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na/ dge bshes 'di zhes bya ba sogs rang rang gi skabs dang bstun pa'i che ba brjod la/ 'di zhes bya ba 'di/ sngon dge ba khyad par can bsags pas tshe 'dir rigs kyi nus pa sad/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskul nas/ mngon mtho nges legs kyi phan bde thams cad kyi gzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dag pa'i tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs blangs/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob tu gyur pa'i dga' ston chen po bgyis pa la/ gdugs de ring gi zhes sogs mtshams sbyar ba'am/ yang dag par bskul nas thos bsam la rtag 'grus su bgyis pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa las brtsams te/ gzhung lugs zab mo la legs par bshad pa gsar pa rgya cher spel ba'i dga' ston no zhes mtshams sbyar ro/ /de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/

'di ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nyid mtshon byed du byas/ rang dang gzhan gyi 'khor 'das dus gsum dang mngon par 'brel ba'i tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho chen po rnams phyogs gcig tu sdom pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /da ltar zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las dang 'gro don phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cigaphyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa la sogs pa/ chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa khyad par can gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /thos bsam gyis 'khor los bstan pa'i sgron me yun ring du 'bar ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sgrub pa'i 'khor los rgyal ba'i gdung chad pa med par 'dzin pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig/de ltar bshad sgrub rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyin pa po rnams kyi yon yongs su sbyong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rab tu byung ba rnams lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad pas mi mthun par 'gyur ba spangs te/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas par gyur cig / rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi mthu la brten nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di zhes bya ba'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig

/mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /tshe dang bsod nams ye shes 'byor ba thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo lta bur rgyas par gyur cig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa mtha' dag dang bral bar gyur cig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /bde ba dang yid bde ba dang mi'i mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang yang ldan par gyur cig /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/cung zad spro na ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du yang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis srog gi dbang po yongs su rgyas par gyur cig longs spyod mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin myur du thob par gyur cig khams gsum dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug dam pa myur du thob par gyur cig /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis skyong bar gyur cig /dkar po dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cigabyang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyis rang rgyus yongs su gang bar gyur cig /gsung rab sde snod gsum gyi don la rang byan chud pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rnam dag bslab pa gsum gyis rang rgyud mdzes pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / lam lnga dang sa bcu'i mngon rtogs thams cad rgyud la skye ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/

ji ltar smon lam btab pa thams cad de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang*/ kha don gyis rgyas legs gnas shog /rtag par dge 'dun mthun pa dang*/ /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang*/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig / ngan 'gro thams cad dag tu stongs bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang na sar bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed par shog /bzang po spyod cing de 'dra'i sa thob nas/ /kun nas kun kyang bzang por red gyur cigaces pa tsam gyis kyang chog /de las kyang cung zad rgyas par spro na/ gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'di nyid kyis gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ char chu rnams dus su 'bab par gyur cig /lo phyugs rnams rtag tu legs par gyur cig /mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /yams nad dang rim nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /'thab rtsod dang 'khrug long thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /dus kyi 'khrug pa dang mtshon gyi bskal pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /sems can ma rungs pa rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad rang rang gi rdzas dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug gi chog shes par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phan tshun du pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig

/lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*/ /lo thog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed gyur cig /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang*/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ sa phyogs 'di skor na gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis/ tshogs rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs par gyur cig /sgrib pa rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu byang bar gyur cig /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu dang nus pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar sogs/ tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sogs/ ston pa 'jig rten khams su sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ sbyin pa gtong zhing sogs/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba sogs/ lo brgya thub cing sogs/ 'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i sogs/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das sogs/ zab cing rgya che

sogs/ de dag la sogs pa bkra shis rgyas bsdus skabs su gang babs dang sbyar la/ mjug tu/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog / ces so/ / de dag las rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po zhes pa'i tshab tu/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di zhes bya ba'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di zhes bya ba la/ sogs mi che chung gi rim pa dang ldan pa'i tshig brjod/ chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma yin na/ dgongs gsol gyi skabs dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ bdag cag rnams kyi gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol zhes brjod/ bla ma'i mtshan mi smos/ bsngo ba dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang*/ de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi mthu la brten nas/ mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ mtshan 'di zhes bgyi ba'i/ sku tshe 'phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /gzhan snang du bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /bzhed don thams cad dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sku'i rgyal mtshan lhun po ltar brtan par gyur cigagasung gi nyi 'od phyogs thams cad du 'char bar gyur cig /thugs kyi rgya mtsho rab dga' bdud rtsis gang bar gyur cig /'phrin las kyi nyi 'od nam yang mi nub cing srid zhi kun tu rgyas par gyur cig /thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel bar gyur cig /gzhan snang du rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo sku nyams su bstar ba la rnam g.yengs dang bar chad kyi mtshan ma nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /gdul bya rnams bslab pa gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gegs med du 'god par gyur cig /'gro ba'i don du bsnyun pa mi mnga' zhing sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig

/sa dang lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la mngon du mdzad nas/ bdag cag gdul byar gyur pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgyal thabs la 'god par gyur cig ces pa tsam gyis kyang chog la/ rgyas par byed na sngar gyi bsngo ba'i sham bu rnams sbyar bas rung ste/ ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du zhes pa'i tshab tu/ gzhan yang bdag cag gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ gnas skabs thams cad du/ mi dang mi ma yin pa zhes pa man chad do/ /yang bsngo ba bsdus pa byed na/ dgongs gsol song ba'i rjes la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang rang gzhan gyi dge ba thams cad gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu las/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di zhes bgyi ba'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig / ces pa'i bar dang*/ sems can thams cad bde dang sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur brtan pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab pa 'grub par shog /nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod do/ /༈ tshe 'das 'ga' zhig gi don du bsngo ba byed dgos na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ dmigs yul 'di nyid kyi gtso byas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ tshe 'das 'di zhes bgyi ba'i/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ sbyin sogs dkar po dge ba'i las ci dang ci bgyis pa thams cad dang*/ slar yang mngon par sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag thams cad/ dmig yul gyi 'gro ba 'di nyid/

kham gsum skye gnas bzhi 'gro ba rigs drug srid pa bar ma gang du gnas sam skye bar yang 'gyur ba'i las can yin na yang*/ dge ba 'di kun dmigs yul 'di'i khong du chud cing*/ phyi bzhin du 'brang ba dang rjes su 'jug par gyur cig /de ltar zhugs nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ rigs drug po so so'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung mtha' dag las myur du thar bar gyur cig /bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul mtha' dag las myur du thar bar gyur cig /ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba rnams su nam yang mi skye bar gyur cig /skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig /rten de la mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan par gyur cig /legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang zhal mjal ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /bdud dang sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi 'gro ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /byams sny-ing rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i skal ba dang ldan= 'dul ba dang mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde snod mang du thob pa'i= tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i= rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /phar phyin drug la bsdus pa byed na/ rang don pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa la gnas pa'i gzhan don bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas/ sems can gyi don rgya cher byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cigazhes dang*/ /'bring du byed na/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi don rgya cher sgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / brtson 'grus dang bzod pa'i sgo nas bdag nyid kyi don mchog tu sgrub pa'i=

bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi sgo nas gnyis ka'i don sems nyid rnam par grol ba la 'god pa'i= sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don mthun pa dang*/ don spyod pa ste/ bsdu dngos bzhi la brten nas 'gro ba kun byang chub kyi lam la 'god pa'i= zhes dang*/ /cung zad rgyas par byed na/ lan dang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa rlabs po che gtong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /yang srid la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par srung ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can rnams la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa bla na med pa sgom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /dkar po dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su bsdud pa'i brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rtsom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams las 'das pa'i bsam gtan bla na med pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'i skul ba dang ldan par gyur cig / thabs snying rje chen po dang ya ma bral ba'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skyed pa'i skul ba dang ldan par gyur cig /zang zing gi sbyin pas sems can rnams tshim zhing mgu par byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /chos kyi gtam snyan par smra bas mos pa khyad par can bskyed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /pha rol du phyin pa la don mthun pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa rnam par dag pa la 'god pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /don spyod pa'i sgo nas slar mi ldog cing lam rnam par sbyong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / ces so/ /de ltar tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong zhing*/ /dka' ba spyad pa med par yang*/ /lha las lhag pa'i lus thob nas/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog/mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag

/bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar shog/ skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab rdzogs nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing sogs brjod/ 'di la yang mthun 'gyur byed mkhan dge 'dun yod na/ bsngo ba'i mgor skabs 'dir mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes brjod dgos/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po sogs la dge rtsa rgya chen dang 'brel ba'i dus/ gtam bshad dgos na bya zhing*/ de nas gshin don gyi bsngo ba byed na/ nye du sogs shul gyi mi yod na/ de rjes gson bsngo rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa rdzogs par bya zhing*/ de 'dra med na'ang*/ gzhan yang 'di ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nyid mtshon byed du byas zhes pa nas/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bar dang*/ phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas cig pu man chad bkra shis kyi bar rdzogs par bya/ yul khyad par can la mchod bsngor byed na/ dgongs gsol gyi skabs bla ma'i mtshan nas mi smos te/ gson bsngo'i skabs dang 'dra/ 'di ltar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/ skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong*/ zhes sogs de skabs kyi dge ba sgrub pa'i skabs dang sbyar la/ gzhan yang thos bsam sgom gsum la sogs pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i phung po rgya chen po 'dis/ yongs kyi dge ba'i gshes gnyen chen po zhes sam/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'di zhes bya ba la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /phul ba de thams cad gzhan don du bdag gir mdzad nas/ thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /gang du bzhugs pa'i zhing khams der/ mtha' yas mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar gyur cig /sku gsung thugs dang mdzad pa 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa skad cig kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /sa lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig

/myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa'i rim pa mtha' dag bstan nas/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad theg pa rnam pa gsum gyi byang chub la 'god pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /dge ba 'di'i skye bo kun/ /gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du/ /yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yi/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes byed shog/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs/ de tsam mam cung zad rgyas par spro na/ gson bsngo'i skabs su bshad pa'i spyi'i bsngo ba sogs ci rigs pas kha bskangs nas brjod do/ /gson gshin gang la sbyar kyang chog pa'i bsngo ba shin tu bsdus pa ni/ dgongs su gsol sngar bzhin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig tu sdom pa'i mthu las/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug dang shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes dang tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa'i tshogs kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /de ltar sgrib gnyis sbyong ba dang*/ tshogs gnyis gsog pa la bar du gcod pa skad cig kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /sdug bsngal gsum gyis gtses pa'i sems can thams cad zag med kyi bde ba mthar thug pa la 'god pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /de na gshin don yin na/ ngan song sdug bsngal sogs dang*/ gson bsngo yin na/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i sogs dang*/ bkra shis gyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par brjod do/ /gzhan yang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas pa'am/ bshad ston la sogs pa'i skabs su bsngo ba byed na/ gson bsngo spyi dang phal chen 'dra ba las/ dgongs gsol gyi rjes su/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/

dge bshes 'di zhes bya bas/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung*/ dam pa'i chos thams cad kyis rtsa ba so so thar pa'i sdom pa blangs/ ngur smrig gi brtul zhugs bzung bas bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan par byas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'di dang 'brel bar/ zang zing gi mchod pas kyang mchog gsum la bsti stang du byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang zhes sam/ 'di zhes bya bas/ dang por dad pa brtan pos dam pa'i chos la zhugs/ bar du shes rab dang brtson 'grus zung du sbrel bas gzhung lugs mchog la sbyangs/ da ltar rang gi rnam dpyod dang blo gros rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ dge 'dun gyi spyan sngar mchod rdzas su phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang*/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ 'khor 'das dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i zhes pa man chad gong bzhin la/ skabs su gang bab tu 'di skad ces bya ste/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa la nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thabs la mkhas pas yongs su bzung bar gyur cigarig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa las dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub myur du thob par gyur cig /lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas rgyud yongs su phyug par gyur ciga'aphags pa nye bar 'khor ltar 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog tu lung ston par gyur cig /mkhyen pas shes bya ma lus pa mkhyen pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal lta bur gyur cig /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rjes mkha' khyab kyi sems can sdug bsngal las skyob pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /gang la gang 'dul gyi mthu stobs thogs pa med pas/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i 'phrin las sgrub pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i mdzad pa dang mnyam par gyur cig /ces pa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par sbyar ro/ /'dir smras pa/ gtam bshad bsngo ba'i bye brag la/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i blo gsal rnams// tshogs pa'i dbus su gzengs mtho zhing*/

/blo ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i gzhi/ / zhes bya'o/ /mol gtam dang bsngo ba'i brjod pa/ mdor bsdus su sbyar ba 'di yang snga phyir don gnyer du mas nan tan du yang yang bskul ba'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / bkra shis par shog/ ༄༅/ /smon lam dgos pa kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ thog med dus nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dge ba gang dag bgyis dang bgyid rtsal dang*/ /yi rang bsngags pa brjod pa'i legs byas sogs/ /mdor na bdag gi dus gsum dge ba kun/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i dge rtsa mtha' yas dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs kyi// rnam dkar 'phrin las legs byas rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdaums pa'i mthu stobs las/ /smon lam 'di kun nges par 'grub pa dang*// myur du 'grub cing gegs med 'grub pa dang*/ /mchog tu rgya chen stobs ldan 'grub par shog /skye ba kun du bla ma dkon mchog la/ /mi phyed dad pa rnam gsum 'bral med ldan/ /bcos ma min par snying rje byang chub sems/ /nam yang rgyun mi chad par skye bar shog /rtag tu rab byung dge slong gnas thob ste// nyis brgya lnga bcu la sogs bslab pa'i gnas/ /'dul ba rgya mtshor ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /cung zad tsam yang ma nyams bsrung bar shog

/byang chub sems dpa'i bslab gzhi mtha' dag la/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad bzhin spyod/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog /khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor kun du zhugs shing mthong*/ /rmad byung dbang gi rim pa kun thob nas/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon mtha' dag gsos 'debs shog / dam tshig mchog la nyes ltung dri mas dben/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'da' bar mi dpyod pa'i/ /blang dor dgag sgrub mnyam bzhag rjes spyod kyi/ /dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /rdo rje slob dpon kun dang khyad par du/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po khyod nyid dang*/ /rtag tu mi 'bral rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing*/ /rten 'brel legs phyogs kho nar 'grigs par shog khyed la mos gus gdung shugs 'bral med dang*/ khyed dang rten 'brel nam yang mi 'chug cing*/ khyed kyi bka' las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin/ /dga' zhing spro ba'i yid kyis bsgrub par shog /bka' bzhin bsgrub tshe mnar med gnas su yang*// 'jug par spro na gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rang 'dod med par khyed kyis ci gsungs dang*/ /thugs su ci dgyes thams cad bsgrub par shog khyed ni 'khor 'das kun khyab mdzad pa can/ /gang 'dul lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las te// snang ngor spyod tshul bzang ngan ci ston yang*/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kho nar rtogs gyur cig /log lta'i dri ma tsam yang mi skye zhing*/ /mdo rgyud kun nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar/ /sgo gsum longs spyod bya ba thams cad kyis/ /bla ma dam pa rtag tu mnyes byed shog /skye ba kun du khyed kyi dgongs pa skyong*/ khyod kyi gsung 'dzin khyod kyi 'phrin las bsgrub/ /'gro kun khyod kyis rjes su 'jug pa dang*/ khyed kyi bstan la bya ba byed par shog khyed gsung chos kyis sa gsum kun khyab nas/

/mi dang mi min thams cad der rjes 'jug /rnam dag grub mtha' lta spyod bzang po 'di/ /phyogs dus kun du spel bar bdag gyur cig khyaud kyi thugs dgongs ji bzhin rtogs pa dang*/ /gsung gi gsang ba mtha' dag legs bzung nas/ /dgongs don ji bzhin shes la 'khrul ba'i dri/ /til gyi zegs ma tsam yang spangs bar shog /skye zhing skye bar 'bad med lhun grub tu/ / chos kun 'dzin pa'i shes rab mchog thob cing*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob brtson 'grus mchog dang ldan/ /dam pa'i chos bzhin rtag tu spyod par shog /bdud dang mu stegs lta ngan log lta can/ /thams cad tshar bcad chos la 'god pa dang*/ /ma dad pa rnams dad pa'i gnas la 'god/ /de 'dra'i thabs tshul mtha' yas 'grub par shog /nad med rigs gzugs longs spyod dbang thang grogs/ /'khor g.yog la sogs thams cad phun tshogs shing*/ /rtag tu dge ba'i chos la spyod pa yis/ /rang gzhan don gyi mchog kun 'grub par shog /rje btsun khyod kyi bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /ma lus skad cig re rer phyir bsal nas/ /rgyal khyod bstan pa'i nyi 'od phyogs kun du/ khyab par byed pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par shog /sdig grogs log 'tsho 'gal rkyen kun spangs shing*/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyod kyang yid mi g.yo/ /rtag tu mtha' yas 'gro ba smin par byed/ /rgud par gyur kyang chos bzhin spyod par shog /myur du ting 'dzin chos kyi stobs thob nas/ /la lar mkhas dang la lar grub pa dang*/ / rgyal po rgyal phran blon po pho nya 'khor/ /sna tshogs sprul pas bstan pa gsal byed shog /bla med byang chub myur du thob pa dang*/ /de srid du yang srid dang zhi ba yi/ /phun tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab rtag par 'byor/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub par shog /bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor brtan pa thob/ /rig sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa mthar phyin nas/ /zhi sogs las kun thogs med 'grub pa dang*/

/thun mong 'jig rten dngos grub kun thob shog /lhan skyes ye shes rdzogs pa'i rim pa brtan/ /ye shes smra ba po la ye shes nyid/ /gcig pus 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten 'das pa phyag rgya che thob shog /ji skad bshad pa'i lam gyi yon tan rnams/ /bar chad med par myur du mthar phyin nas/ /ye shes lnga dang sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje 'chang chen myur du thob par shog /khams gsum skye 'gro kun yang de la 'god/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /thugs gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig 'jug pa la/ /glo bur dri ma'i 'khrul ba sangs bar shog /smon lam de kun 'phral du 'grub par shog /ji bzhin 'grub cing rgya chen 'grub par shog /gegs med 'grub cing 'bad med 'grub par shog /bkra shis dge legs phun sum tshogs par shog / ces pa 'di yang dad ldan kun dga' lhun grub gyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / maṅga laṃ/ / oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes shing sems can kun/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs dpal la 'god pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung rab dpag yas la/ /nyams len bde bar byed thabs smon lam 'di/ /par du sgrab sa brag dmar bla brang yin/ /'di yi legs spyad bdag gi 'brel can sogs/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba dam chos sgor zhugs te/ /myur du byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po chen po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ // bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ mgon po rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog sna tshogs kyi skor bzhugs/ -PAGE 324--PAGE 323--PAGE 146-
